Own the project execution strategy and governance, manage internal and external interfaces (client, class, vendors, subcontractors), and ensure disciplined risk and change control while driving predictable delivery and strong financial outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Policies, processes \& procedures:** 




  




* Develops and oversees the implementation of department policies, procedures and controls covering all areas of finance functional activity so that all relevant procedural/legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality, cost\-effective service to customers.
* Maintain compliance with all company policies, procedures, and codes of conduct, including strict adherence to the Zero Tolerance to Alcohol policy at all times.



  





**Budget/Financial** 




  




* Prepares and recommends the department budget by preparing analysis and data related to specific elements as directed.
* Monitors the financial performance of the section against budgets so that areas of unsatisfactory performance are identified and rectified promptly and potential performance improvement opportunities are capitalized upon.



  





**Project Specific Responsibility:** 




  




* Responsible for leading assigned project project including liaising with the client; coordinating and leading partners; supervising members of the project team and project managers; and overseeing project implementation.
* Establish the Project Execution Plan (PEP), organization, governance cadence, decision gates, RACI and reporting aligned to contract and company standards.
* Lead the integrated EPC delivery team across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning and Marine operations.
* Set clear delivery priorities and standards; build a high\-performance culture focused on safety, quality, and on\-time delivery.
* Financial and administrative oversight, reporting, and monitoring and evaluation of the project.
* Demonstrate leadership in making critical decisions, operating at a strategic and tactical level.
* Receive regular reports from project managers or team leads. Thereafter, report directly to senior management and JV board.
* Manage Engineering, Procurement, Construction and handover process with required quality within the allocated budget.
* Making strategic decisions and providing leadership and direction to project managers to implement those decisions.
* Meeting with clients, stakeholders and project managers to report on project progress.
* Liaising with clients and building strong working relationships.
* Devising cost\-effective plans to enable effective project completion.
* Managing risks to avoid delays, cost increase or reputational damage. Convert risks and treats to opportunities.
* Ensuring compliance with rules and regulations governing the project.
* Moving with the project team during execution phase from engineering office to construction site.
* Ensure the design is safe and principles of ALARP and Safety in Design are adhered to.
* Endure the project is executed to highest HSE standards.
* Deliver the project within the allocated budget with required quality on time.



  





**Safety, Quality, Environment \& Information Security Rules:** 




  




* Ensuring suitable resources are available to achieve satisfactory OHS compliance of all work within their responsibility
* Ensuring that there is a documented Risk Management process for all work within their responsibility
* Driving continuous Safety improvement through setting, monitoring and reporting on safety performance against objectives within their department
* Ensuring identified corrective actions assigned to their department are closed out by agreed due dates
* Demonstrating desired behaviors and leading, encouraging and communicating on safety issues when interacting with the workforce
* Meeting all responsibilities as outlined in the DDW OHSMS
* Participating in any training and safety initiatives implemented by the Company
* Complying with all Safety directives, and work instructions
* Immediately reporting any incident or potential hazard to their Supervisor or Safety Dept
* STOP the task if you feel yourself or others may be harmed.
* Device and implement controls to ensure no violation of ISR regulations in order to protect the company information / intellectual properties



  





**Leadership and People Management:** 




  




* Supervises the activities and work of subordinates by providing formal and informal feedback to ensure that all work within a specific area is carried out in an efficient manner and in accordance with set individual targets.



  





**Change Management** 




  




* Support the management of change through continuous improvement of departmental systems, processes and practices taking into account ‘international best practice’, changes in international standards and changes in the business environment which demand proactive action plans.



**Continuous improvement** 




  




* Stimulates subordinates and contributes to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of systems, processes and practices taking into account ‘international best practice’, improvement of business processes, cost reduction and productivity improvement.



  





**Reporting** 




  




* Supervises the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet company and department requirements, policies and standards



  





**Related Assignments:** 




  




* Performs other related duties or assignments as directed.



  





**Technical competencies:** 




  




* Broad Engineering knowledge in O\&G topsides facilities, offshore construction including EPC / FPSO projects.
* FPSO EPC execution strategy and stage gates
* Systemization, MC/commissioning/handover governance
* Interface management (engineering–procurement–construction–marine)
* Contract administration, variation/claims management
* Project controls (schedule, cost, risk, progress measurement)
* Class/regulatory compliance awareness; FAT/SAT and vendor coordination
* Strong background with resolution of technical issues during planning and execution phases.
* Demonstrated ability to handle multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to organize, prioritize and successfully execute tasks in accordance with business objectives.
* Project management skills.
* Fully trained and knowledgeable with relevant Safety and Occupational Health \& Safety standards.



  





**Behavioral Competencies:** 




  




* Strong coordination and stakeholder management across disciplines and construction teams.
* Analytical problem\-solving with practical, buildable solutions.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and quality mindset.
* Coaching/mentoring capability and willingness to develop team capability.

data.jd_text:
**ROLE PURPOSE:**




 The Group Head of Performance and Rewards is responsible for designing, implementing and continuously evolving Arada’s global performance and total rewards strategy. The role ensures that compensation, benefits, performance management, and recognition frameworks are aligned with the company’s business strategy and support the attraction, motivation, and retention of high\-performing talent across all divisions.
 



  





 This position will establish a high\-impact Centre of Excellence for Performance and Rewards, ensuring that all reward and performance frameworks drive business performance, reinforce the organization’s culture, and support Arada’s growth across its diversified portfolio of businesses including real estate development, hospitality, entertainment, industrial operations, fitness, wellness, and medical services.
 



 The role balances both intrinsic and extrinsic motivators to create a high\-performance culture supported by fair, competitive, and transparent reward practices. The role will collaborate closely with PX Business Partners and Talent teams to ensure effective implementation across all business units.
 



  





**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




**Global Total Rewards Strategy** 




 Develop and lead a global Total Rewards strategy aligned with Arada’s growth plans and workforce strategy.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Designing a globally consistent but locally adaptable compensation framework
* Ensuring reward strategies support talent attraction, retention, and performance outcomes
* Aligning reward philosophy with Arada’s Employer Value Proposition (EVP)
* Creating reward frameworks appropriate for multiple business models including:



 \-Real estate development
 



 \-Hospitality and Entertainment
 



 \-Industrial and Manufacturing Operations
 



 \-Fitness and Wellness services
 



 \-Medical and Longevity services
 


* Ensuring reward programs remain cost\-effective, sustainable, and competitive



  





**Performance Management Strategy** 




 Develop and embed a modern performance management framework that supports a culture of accountability, feedback and high performance, linked to total rewards.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Designing Arada’s global performance philosophy
* Implementing goal setting frameworks aligned to business strategy
* Driving clear objective alignment from leadership to frontline teams
* Designing annual performance cycles
* Embedding continuous feedback culture
* Developing frameworks for performance improvement planning
* Coaching leaders on effective performance conversations
* Integrating performance management with reward and career progression



  





**Employee Benefits Strategy** 




 Lead the design and management of Arada’s global employee benefits programs to ensure they support employee wellbeing and market competitiveness.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Designing global benefits strategy aligned with our people’s needs
* Managing benefits across diverse sectors including operational and corporate roles
* Ensuring benefits reflect wellbeing, financial security, and lifestyle needs
* Vendor management for benefits providers
* Benefits optimization and cost analysis
* Development of benefits communication and marketing strategies
* Continuous evaluation of benefits effectiveness and personalization of benefits



 Programs include:
 


* Medical insurance
* Short and long term disability cover
* Life insurance
* Wellness and preventative health programs
* Retirement planning
* Lifestyle benefits



  





**Long\-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) Strategy and Design** 




 Lead the design and implementation of Long\-Term Incentive Plans that align senior leadership and critical talent with the long\-term value creation of the organization.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Designing LTIP frameworks for senior executives and key leadership populations across Arada’s global businesses.
* Developing incentive structures that align leadership behavior with long\-term strategic outcomes, profitability, and enterprise value creation.
* Creating tailored LTIP models for different business lines, including:



 \-Real estate development
 



 \-Hospitality and Entertainment
 



 \-Industrial and Manufacturing Operations
 



 \-Fitness and Wellness services
 



 \-Medical and Longevity services
 


* Determining the most appropriate incentive instruments, which may include:



 \-Cash\-based long\-term incentives
 



 \-Phantom equity
 



 \-Share appreciation rights
 



 \-Equity participation programs (where appropriate)
 


* Establishing clear performance metrics linked to enterprise and business unit performance, such as:



 \-EBITDA growth
 



 \-Revenue growth
 



 \-project profitability
 



 \-return on invested capital
 



 \-strategic milestone delivery
 


* Ensuring strong governance around LTIP eligibility, vesting schedules, performance conditions, and payout mechanisms.
* Partnering with Finance and executive leadership to ensure alignment with capital structure and long\-term value creation objectives.
* Designing communication strategies so that LTIP programs are clearly understood and motivating for participants.



  





**IPO Readiness and Executive Reward Structuring** 




 Support the organization in building reward frameworks and performance governance structures that prepare the business for a potential future Initial Public Offering (IPO) or other liquidity event.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Designing reward structures that align with public market governance standards and investor expectations.
* Establishing executive compensation frameworks appropriate for a public company environment.
* Developing incentive plans that support long\-term shareholder value creation.
* Ensuring reward frameworks are structured to withstand scrutiny from:



 \-institutional investors
 



 \-compensation committees
 



 \-regulators
 


* Supporting the development of transparent pay governance frameworks, including:



 \-executive compensation disclosure readiness
 



 \-performance\-based remuneration structures
 



 \-pay\-for\-performance alignment
 


* Partnering with Finance, Legal and the Executive Team to ensure reward frameworks align with capital strategy and shareholder value objectives.
* Creating scalable reward governance models suitable for a listed entity environment.
* Preparing the organization for potential Remuneration Committee oversight structures.



  





**Technology and Digital Enablement / Performance Analytics and Insights** 




 Lead the adoption of modern technology to enable performance and reward programs and establish strong data and reporting capabilities to evaluate the impact of reward and performance programs.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Implementing performance management technology platforms
* Leveraging HRIS and Total Rewards technology
* Using analytics and automation to improve decision making
* Ensuring seamless integration between HRIS, performance systems, and reward management tools
* Developing reward and performance dashboards
* Monitoring compensation competitiveness and pay equity
* Measuring the impact of reward and performance programs on business outcomes, including metrics on productivity indicators talent retention performance distribution and reward effectiveness
* Using workforce analytics to inform strategic decisions
* Delivering executive\-level insights and reporting



  





**Governance, Compliance and Risk** 




 Lead the development of a fair, transparent and competitive global compensation architecture.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Global market benchmarking and salary competitiveness analysis
* Development of salary structures, pay bands and job architecture
* Annual salary review frameworks and merit processes
* Design of short\-term and long\-term incentive plans
* Executive compensation design and governance frameworks
* Sales incentive structures for commercial teams
* Variable reward frameworks for hospitality and operational environments
* Oversight of compensation governance and approval frameworks



  





 Ensure compensation programs remain:
 


* Competitive within regional and global markets
* Equitable and transparent
* Linked directly to business performance
* Compliant with international and local labor laws across operating regions
* Aligned with financial and audit requirements



  





**Stakeholder Engagement and Leadership** 




 Partner closely with senior leadership to ensure reward and performance frameworks support business objectives.
 



  





 Key stakeholders include:
 


* CEO and executive leadership
* Finance leadership
* Business unit leaders
* People Experience leadership team
* Regional PX Business Partners



  





 The role will:
 


* Provide expert advisory on reward and performance matters
* Support leadership decision\-making on organizational performance
* Ensure consistency across global operations



  





**EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**



* Experience in a senior executive performance and total rewards role and proven track record of leading global reward strategies
* Experience across complex, multi\-sector organizations
* Strong understanding of reward governance and executive compensation
* Experience implementing performance frameworks in high\-growth companies
* Strong data analytics and strategic decision\-making capability
* Expertise in LTIP design and IPO preparedness
* Experience in real estate, hospitality, healthcare or lifestyle sectors
* Experience in Middle East and international markets



  





**Key Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
* Strong stakeholder influence at executive level
* Analytical and data\-driven decision making

* Strong governance and risk awareness
* Ability to build scalable global systems

data.jd_text:
Filtrona is the only global, independent market leader in the design, testing and manufacturing of specialist filter solutions and related scientific services. With a head office in Singapore, Filtrona has 9 manufacturing facilities across Europe, America, and Asia, together with 2 innovation centres, an accredited laboratory and a Centre of Excellence focused on sustainability. The company has 2,000 employees serving customers across 120 countries.
 



  





 Our purpose is to support partners to transform and benefit from business growth; we succeed when they succeed. Our mission is to be a responsible, customer\-focused innovation leader creating excellence in sustainable solutions for today and tomorrow.
 



  





 For more information, please visit www.filtrona.com.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Manager, Customer Support drives service excellence by leading and driving continuous improvement initiatives, strengthening KPI performance, and optimizing processes to deliver an agile and high‑quality customer experience. S/he will lead and develop a collaborative, customer‑focused team grounded in accountability, teamwork, and a continuous improvement mindset.
 



  





 This role can also be based in Singapore, Bangkok (Thailand), or Surabaya (Indonesia).
 



  





**Customer Relationship \& Service Management** 



* Serve as the primary contact for assigned customer accounts, managing enquiries, requests, demand management, pre\-onboarding and communication to ensure timely and professional responses.
* Build strong relationships with customers through a deep understanding of our brand and their needs.
* Represent Filtrona in customer meetings related to products, delivery performance, service levels and quality performance KPIs.
* Manage and resolve customer issues and escalations, including delivery delays, quality concerns and service disruptions by working closely with internal cross\-functional teams to ensure timely resolutions.
* Lead continuous improvement and customer satisfaction initiatives (Voice of Customer survey). Review, develop, and implement strategies to enhance the customer experience. Monitor and analyze trends in customer feedback and behavior to identify areas for improvement. Conduct regular reviews of customer interactions to ensure quality and consistency.
* Ensuring contract execution and commitments (customer's and Filtrona's) are managed on a timely basis.



  





**Commercial Performance Management** 



* Coordinate closely with cross\-functional team such as Production, Supply Chain and Sales team to ensure smooth order processing, delivery fulfilment, and accurate communication with customers.
* Monitor and track customer purchase trends to provide reliable forecast, manage order phasing, identify churn risks and promote upselling/cross\-selling.
* Work closely with Sales \& Key Accounts Manager and contribute to sales and business development activities.
* Develop and implement standardized manuals and procedures for the customer support team to ensure efficient, consistent and high quality service delivery, improve response time and minimize number of escalations.
* Minimization of leakages and obsoletes at plant level, control over extra\-costs to be re\-invoiced to customers/improvement of cost leakage through internal CI management.
* Formulate guide, conduct and track detailed account analysis and planning on customer’s data, track and present KPIs using internal systems such as SAP, Salesforce and Power BI, etc to ensure both customer and Filtrona performs Contractual commitments.
* Oversee the onboarding of new customers, including KYC and profile setup in relevant systems (FS/SAP, etc).
* Manage accounts receivable and credit limits, including communication of letter of credit information provided by the Order Management team.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Management** 



* Lead, manage and develop team members, ensuring high level of performance, engagement and service quality.
* Recruitment and onboarding of newcomers, elaboration of job descriptions with clear cut roles and required skills.
* Identify and develop talent, not limited to succession planning.
* Act as a player \- coach to provide guidance and support to team members to drive customer centricity.
* Set clear objectives, performance expectations and KPIs aligned to customer satisfaction, response time, OTIF and Contractual/Internal service guidelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service level to customers, and operational efficiency by incorporating customer feedback and VOC.
* Advocate system usage and storage of data on relevant system.



  





**What we are looking for** 




 We are seeking an experienced professional with a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience). The ideal candidate will bring 8–10 years of relevant experience in customer support, commercial operations, or a related discipline, including at least 2–3 years of team leadership.
 



  





 Success in this role requires excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, patience and positivity in customer interactions, and strong product knowledge. We value individuals who are proactive, adaptable, and skilled in conflict resolution, negotiation, and relationship building. Strategic thinking, account management expertise, and effective time management are essential, along with a collaborative spirit that contributes to a positive team environment.

We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Marketing
   

  

 Marketing is at the heart of Reckitt. We pride ourselves on our unique way of driving growth for some of the world's most loved and trusted health, hygiene and nutrition brands. Our purpose and fight are what motivates us to design and deliver distinctive communications throughout our consumer funnel, so that we deliver category growth as well as a positive impact on society. With extensive media and digital teams embedded throughout the organisation, we measure both our business and our societal impact. Our global teams lead on our overarching brand strategy, brand guardianship and innovation pipeline in close partnership with R\&D. Leaving our local marketing teams to deliver on our regional goals in partnership with our Sales teams. With the scale of our 2500 marketing community \- alongside our leading\-edge Marketing Academy \- your opportunities to grow and upskill will be extensive.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Head of Media \- MENAP role leads the end to end media strategy, investment, implementation, and performance measurement across all channels. The role ensures cohesive media planning aligned with brand, business, and commercial objectives, while driving innovation, efficiency, and excellence across markets.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the long term media strategy for the MENAP region across all channels.
* Develop full funnel media investment priorities across platforms and equity and performance executions.
* Manage regional media budgets, ensuring transparency, governance, and accountability.
* Act as senior advisor to C suite and business leads on media impact and opportunities.
* Ensure cohesive collaboration across brand, digital, analytics, procurement, and market teams.
* Lead annual media planning, budgeting, and optimization cycles.
* Oversee development and delivery of annual and in\-year media plans.
* Ensure consistency in media architecture, audience targeting, and channel mix across all markets.
* Ensure dashboards, analytics reports, and insights are actioned by agencies and teams.
* Oversee relationships with global and regional platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, etc.).
* Lead the relationship with media agencies—performance evaluation, scopes, KPIs, commercial models.
* Manage the media team ensuring clear direction of work, priorities of tasks, capability development, work life balance and mental wellbeing.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* A proven ability to lead, inspire, and mentor teams, driving toward success.
* Strong interpersonal abilities, paired with excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Skilled in data analysis, adept at translating insights into strategic actions.
* A strategic thinker, proficient in evolving insights into effective, actionable plans.
* Building Business / Customer Relationships.
* Educated to minimum bachelors degree level in a business or communications related subject \- from a recognised University.
* 10\-12 years of media experience, with good understanding of national media / new media experience.


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




 A global cryptocurrency exchange offering a comprehensive suite of trading products, including spot, derivatives, and Web3 services. The platform serves millions of users worldwide and is expanding its Web3 product ecosystem encompassing wallet, DEX, and perpetual trading products.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on, execution\-driven Director of Operations to lead and grow our Web3 product lines — specifically our Wallet, DEX, and Perpetual (Perp) products. This is not a strategic\-planning\-only role; we need someone who has been in the trenches of exchange operations, understands how crypto growth actually works, and can move fast when the market moves.
 



 The ideal candidate comes from a small\-to\-mid\-size exchange where they personally drove operational results without relying on the platform's brand or organic traffic. You know how affiliate programs, BD partnerships, and campaign execution work — not in theory, but because you've built and run them yourself.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end operations for the Web3 product suite (Wallet, DEX, Perp), including user acquisition, engagement, and retention.
* Design and execute go\-to\-market campaigns that respond to real\-time market conditions with speed and precision.
* Build and manage affiliate/referral programs, BD partnerships, and KOL collaborations to drive product adoption.
* Identify and capitalize on trending narratives (e.g., new chains, token launches, airdrop seasons) to generate traffic and engagement.
* Develop and optimize operational playbooks for growth in a low\-organic\-traffic environment — resourcefulness over resources.
* Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate user and market feedback into product improvements.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a lean operations team with a bias toward action and accountability.
* Monitor competitive landscape across wallets, DEX aggregators, and perp platforms to identify opportunities and threats.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of operations experience in the cryptocurrency/exchange industry, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
* Proven track record at a small\-to\-mid\-size exchange where personal initiative — not platform traffic — drove results.
* Deep, hands\-on understanding of wallet products (gas sponsorship, DApp browsers, on\-chain interactions), DEX mechanics (aggregation, liquidity, incentive models), and perpetual/derivatives trading.
* Strong command of exchange growth levers: affiliate/rebate programs, BD pipelines, event\-driven campaigns, and community operations.
* Ability to operate at a fast tempo — comfortable launching campaigns in hours, not weeks, when the market demands it.
* Fluent in Mandarin Chinese (written and spoken); English proficiency required.
* Self\-driven, detail\-oriented, and willing to do whatever it takes — this role rewards grit over glamour.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with on\-chain growth tactics (quests, points programs, NFT campaigns) and understanding of their trade\-offs.
* Existing network of KOLs, affiliates, or BD contacts in the crypto space.
* Familiarity with data analytics tools for tracking on\-chain and off\-chain campaign performance.
* Prior experience managing cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.

 Transformation \& Innovation

 Technical \& Digital Skills

 Leadership \& Attributes
 


* Highly commercial, data\-driven, and results\-oriented
* Strategic thinker with strong execution capability
* Ability to operate in complex, multi\-market environments
* Strong stakeholder management and executive presence

**Overview** 




  





 A leading automotive dealership group in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is seeking a dynamic and commercially driven
 **Chief Executive Officer (CEO)** 
 to lead the organization through its next phase of growth, operational excellence, and digital transformation.

**Strategic Leadership** 



* Define and execute the company’s long\-term strategy across vehicle sales, aftersales, and mobility services

* Maintain and strengthen relationships with global automotive OEMs

**Operational Excellence** 



* Optimize dealership operations across sales, service, parts, and logistics

* Build and lead a high\-performing executive team

**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong commercial acumen with deep understanding of dealership economics (sales, aftersales, parts)

* Expertise in turnaround, scaling, or transformation environments
* Strong financial literacy and performance management skills
* Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills
* Visionary yet execution\-focused
* High resilience and adaptability in a fast\-evolving market
* Strong people leadership and cultural intelligence
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a focus on innovation

With deep expertise in digital, cloud, cybersecurity, and enterprise transformation, we help organizations build and scale high‑performing technology teams.
 



 We are building one of the region’s most exciting new IT Services practices. With 800\+ technology professionals already embedded across enterprise clients in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, we’re expanding rapidly into cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, and digital transformation delivery.

You will work across the full pre‑sales and early delivery lifecycle — from leading technical discovery sessions and designing architectures to validating delivery feasibility and ensuring a smooth handoff to project teams.

data.jd_text:
Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management, industrial automation, and digital transformation technologies, operating in more than 100 countries. We believe that access to energy and digital technology is a fundamental human right. Our purpose is to empower everyone to make the most of their energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainability for all.
   

  

**Our mission**

 **Energy Technology Partner** 
 for our customers \- leading the electrification, automation, and digitalization of every industry, business, and home to drive efficiency, resilience, and sustainability. This mission builds on our commitment to act as our customers’ best digital partner for sustainability and efficiency by integrating advanced energy technologies, digital solutions, and domain expertise.
   

  

 We drive digital transformation by integrating world\-leading energy and automation technologies. This includes:
   

  

* End\-to\-end integration, from connected products to edge control and cloud applications.
* Lifecycle services, from design and build to operate and maintain, powered by digital twins and AI\-enabled insights.
* Enterprise\-wide optimization, transforming operations from site\-level to multi\-site organizational performance.
* Integrated platforms, including EcoStruxure™, enabling safe, reliable, efficient, and cybersecure environments across buildings, homes, data centers, infrastructure, and industry
* Description of the role \& responsibilities of the Segment Solution and Technology Lead


 The Segment Solution and Technology Lead is a role, with a specific intent to focus on complex digital building applications in the Healthcare sector. The role functionally reports into the Building Segment Solutions Director as part of the solutions specialist’s team with the mandate to focus on all opportunities involving complex IT/OT architectures across the Healthcare Segment.
   

  

 The role plays a critical role in advancing digital transformation across healthcare facilities by shaping solution architectures, driving innovation with the Line of Business (LoB), and supporting strategic customer engagements. This role blends technical depth, account leadership, and solution evangelism, ensuring Schneider Electric delivers differentiated value in healthcare environments.
   

  

 You will act as a trusted advisor to healthcare customers, guiding them through IT/OT convergence, energy and operational efficiency improvements, and the adoption of advanced digital building technologies.
   

  

 The Healthcare Segment Solution and Technology Lead will be the catalyst and champion of innovation for Healthcare facilities and will be responsible for driving innovation, and influencing and supporting strategic customers in the digitalization of their buildings’ portfolio.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
 Drive Innovation \& Collaboration with Line of Business (LoB)
   

  

* Serve as a catalyst for innovation across healthcare solutions by working closely with LoB leaders, R\&D, offer managers, and solution owners to shape new offers and solution architectures.
* Contribute to the development of healthcare‑specific solution roadmaps, use cases, and reference architectures.
* Advocate for segment needs and ensure healthcare requirements influence future products and platform evolution.
* Participate in solution catalog development, documentation refinement, and strategic solution governance activities.


 Customer \& Account Leadership
   

  

* Act as a trusted technology partner for healthcare customers, advising on digital transformation, modernization, and resilience strategies.

 Solution Architecture \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Lead the definition of end‑to‑end IT/OT architectures for healthcare facilities, including data strategy, integration, system interoperability, and analytics requirements.
* Shape conceptual and high‑level solution designs using Schneider Electric’s digital platforms, energy technologies, software, and services.
* Ensure alignment with healthcare‑specific needs such as critical environments, safety, compliance, and cybersecurity.
* Support complex deals by preparing architectural deliverables, technical value propositions, and solution narratives.


 Workshop Facilitation \& Technical Engagements
   

  

* Facilitate customer workshops covering digital building transformation, energy efficiency, FDD (fault detection diagnostics), IoT, and smart hospital solutions.
* Translate customer challenges into solution requirements and actionable architectural proposals.
* Present demos, reference architectures, and case studies to educate customers and internal teams.
* Bring in best practices from healthcare multi‑system design conversations and Building Advisor use cases mentioned in internal exchanges.
* Training / upskilling zones and country operations teams through healthcare segment specialisation training
* Upskilling teams to deliver partner / EcoXpert training


 Cross‑Functional Collaboration \& Ecosystem Enablement
   

  

* Work with regional and global stakeholders—Segment Leaders, Solution Architects, Marketing, LoBs, and Partner Ecosystems—to ensure solutions land successfully in the field.
* Provide guidance to local teams, acting as an advanced support and coaching resource, particularly in priority growth regions.
* Strengthen relationships with engineering firms, integrators, and consultants influencing healthcare projects.


 Thought Leadership \& Best Practice Development
   

  

* Create repeatable frameworks, templates, and best practices to scale Healthcare digital solutions globally.
* Partner with marketing and the segment team to build training materials, reference architectures, and whitepapers showcasing Schneider Electric’s leadership.
* Contribute content to internal platforms (e.g., Solutions Catalogue, Healthcare Playbooks) and support continuous improvement of documentation processes.


 Opportunity Support \& Deal Acceleration
   

  

* Support the end‑to‑end pursuit lifecycle: opportunity qualification, scoping, solutioning, proposal development, and closing.
* Help prioritize strategic accounts and segment opportunities based on market signals and portfolio strengths.
* Leverage deep knowledge of digital hospitals, energy management, microgrids, and hybrid cloud/on‑prem architectures to accelerate the design of winning offers.
* Requirements for the role
* Customer\-centric mindset: excellent customer relationship skills. Ability to create relationships quickly across customers’ organizations.
* 10\+ years experience within the Healthcare Segment proofing her/his knowledge in this field
* Practical experience working in the Healthcare environment, with experience in deploying complex multi\-site software solutions with a wide range of integrations
* Awareness of RESTful standards and web API's and good knowledge of standard building protocols
* Good understanding of networks and network design

 Role Model \- Demonstrates strong personal leadership in line with Schneider Electric values.
   

  

* 10 \+ years of experience in Healthcare

* Good knowledge of electrical distribution with experience in distributed energy resources and microgrids
* Excellent networking capabilities and the ability to lead other teams and groups.

data.jd_text:
The Customer Intelligence \& Insights is accountable for establishing and leading the enterprise\-wide customer intelligence capability for DIB. This role owns the definition, integration, and interpretation of customer intelligence across all customer touchpoints — digital, branch, contact centre, complaints, social, surveys, and external signals — transforming fragmented data into a single, actionable view of customer reality. The role goes beyond analytics execution to define how the bank understands customers, translating behavioural, attitudinal, and experiential signals into clear customer outcomes (e.g. acquisition quality, activation, attrition, retention, cross\-sell, loyalty) and driving insight\-led actions across Business, Digital, Operations, Service, and Transformation functions. This is a strategic yet highly action\-oriented leadership role, requiring strong judgement, enterprise influence, and the ability to connect insight to decision\-making at scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Enterprise Customer Intelligence Ownership
 



 • Own and define the enterprise Customer Intelligence Framework, setting how customer data is aggregated, synthesised, interpreted, and activated across the bank.
 



 • Integrate multiple sources of customer insight, including:
 



 o Voice of Customer (VOC), complaints, and contact centre interactions
 



 o Digital behaviour and transactional signals
 



 o Surveys, research, social listening, and external benchmarks
 



 • Establish a single, coherent view of customer reality, moving the organization away from siloed, channel\-specific analytics.
 



 • Oversee model development and rules for Next Best Action and Personalized Actions (propensity, eligibility, affordability, suitability) with Data Science and Risk.
 



 • Oversee predictive churn modeling and segmentation (save‑ability, value at risk, reason codes), with governance for drift monitoring and bias checks.
 



 • Supervise CLV modeling and calibration, including back‑testing, stability monitoring, and bias/fairness checks; chair model change control with Model Risk/Governance
 



 • Lead pricing and value‑proposition design for bundles, including benefit tiers, fee waivers, rewards, and thresholds; run A/B and multivariate tests to optimize take‑up and profitability
 



 • Establish experimentation at scale A/B test creatives, timing, channels, and incentives; optimize for incremental lift and CLV impact, not just click‑through.
 



  





 2\. Strategic Insight to Business Action
 



 • Translate customer intelligence into clear implications for customer outcomes, including:
 



 o Acquisition quality and onboarding effectiveness
 



 o Activation and usage behaviour
 



 o Attrition risk and early\-warning indicators
 



 o Retention, engagement, and cross\-sell opportunities
 



 • Drive insight\-led prioritisation for:
 



 o Segment and proposition strategy
 



 o Customer lifecycle design and activation
 



 o Journey redesign and service model improvements
 



 • Ensure insights are decision\-ready, outcome\-oriented, and tied to enterprise priorities.
 



 3\. Enterprise Influence \& Governance
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Business, Digital, Operations, Service, and Transformation.
 



 • Present customer intelligence and implications to senior management and governance forums, influencing prioritisation and investment decisions.
 



 • Embed customer intelligence into enterprise decision\-making, rather than post\-hoc reporting.
 



 4\. Intelligence Frameworks \& Advanced Analytics
 



 • Define standards for customer analytics and insight development, including:
 



 o Predictive and diagnostic modelling
 



 o Segmentation, personas, and value\-driver analysis
 



 o Root\-cause and systemic issue analysis
 



 • Guide the application of AI and advanced analytics to uncover patterns and risks while ensuring interpretability and business relevance.
 



 • Provide oversight in the architecture, development, and ongoing maintenance of CoCE‑specific data schemas and data marts, ensuring alignment with enterprise analytics and governance standards.
 



 • Partner closely with Data Engineering and SPBA teams to ensure data quality, availability, and responsible use.
 



 5\. Data Quality, Governance \& Compliance
 



 • Serve as the data steward for the CoCE team and work closely with the data governance team to ensure adherence to governance standards and compliance requirements.
 



 • Oversee the implementation of data‑quality controls, including validation checks, ongoing monitoring, and exception‑handling processes to ensure reliable and trusted data.
 



 • Ensure full compliance with DIB’s data‑security, privacy, and regulatory obligations, providing oversight and direction to uphold enterprise‑wide risk and control requirements.
 



 • Provide oversight for the continuous curation and maintenance of the CoCE report inventory, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and relevance for business and governance needs.
 



 6\. Leadership \& Capability Building
 



 • Lead, mentor, and develop the Customer Intelligence team, raising analytical maturity and business acumen.
 



 • Build enterprise data literacy and insight adoption, ensuring stakeholders understand and act on insights.
 



 • Oversee the continuous enhancement of dashboards, insight packs, and executive\-level intelligence outputs.
 



 7\. Risk, Ethics \& Governance
 



 • Ensure all analytics and insight activities comply with data privacy, regulatory, and ethical standards.
 



 • Establish governance around insight interpretation and usage to avoid misrepresentation or unintended customer harm.
 



  





**Education \& Work Experience:** 




  





 • Degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related field; MBA preferred.
 



 • 10\-12\+ years of experience in customer analytics, customer insights, strategy, or customer\-led
 



 transformation
 



 • Demonstrated experience operating at enterprise or group level, not function\-specific analytics
 



 • Demonstrated Experience with report and dashboard development tools such as PowerBI, SAP
 



 Business Objects, Tableau, etc
 



 • Proven ability to translate customer insight into business and customer outcomes
 



 • Banking or financial services experience strongly preferred

**Position Overview:** 




  





 The Head of Clinical Applications is a senior technical leadership role accountable for the end\-to\-end ownership, governance, and strategic evolution of the Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium clinical platform, Revenue Cycle Management payment and its integrated application ecosystem. This includes Rhapsody, Synapse RIS, FiveFaces Patient Portal, AI clinical initiatives (eg Ambient Listening, Diagnostic AI) and all relevant clinical applications across the organisation.
 



  





 The role combines deep Millennium platform expertise with enterprise integration architecture capability, providing authoritative leadership across clinical application delivery, HL7/FHIR interoperability, ambient AI adoption, charging, patient billing and clinical data integrity.
 



 The Head of Clinical Applications guides multi\-disciplinary teams of analysts, engineers, and informatics specialists \- serving as the primary bridge between clinical requirements, integration architecture, and digital transformation strategy \- ensuring the organisation's clinical technology landscape is safe, high\-performing, and continuously advancing.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Clinical Application Ownership \& Cerner Millennium Platform Leadership** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end ownership, governance, and strategic roadmap for the Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium platform, including all clinical and operational modules across inpatient, ambulatory, and perioperative workflows
* Serve as the organisation's principal subject matter expert on Cerner Millennium architecture, configuration standards, domain model, and release management \- providing authoritative technical guidance to clinical informatics, IT, and executive stakeholders
* Drive platform optimisation, build governance, and clinical content standardisation across all Millennium domains including PowerChart, FirstNet, SurgiNet, PharmNet, Revenue Cycle, and Results Review



  





**Integration Architecture \& Interoperability Strategy** 



* Architect and govern the end\-to\-end HL7 and FHIR integration landscape connecting Cerner Millennium to downstream clinical, operational, and analytics systems \- including PACS, LIS, MDI/BMDI, pharmacy inpatient and retail, RCM billing solutions and third\-party SaaS solutions
* Lead the design, implementation, and operational governance of the enterprise integration engine (Rhapsody/Mirth), establishing interface standards, message routing logic, and transformation frameworks
* Drive FHIR R4 adoption strategy including SMART on FHIR application enablement, clinical API governance, and interoperability roadmap aligned with regulatory requirements (DHA, MOH, NABIDH)



  





**Clinical Applications Team Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi\-disciplinary team of clinical application analysts, integration engineers, informatics specialists, and build configuration resources
* Establish team operating models, delivery frameworks, and competency standards that elevate the organisation's internal Millennium and integration capability



  





  





**Revenue Cycle Integration \& Clinically\-Driven Charging** 



* Oversee governance and optimisation of clinically\-driven charging workflows within Cerner Millennium, ensuring accurate charge capture is embedded at the point of care across inpatient, ambulatory, and procedural settings
* Lead the integration architecture between Millennium Revenue Cycle and downstream RCM platforms including patient billing, claims processing, and payer adjudication systems — ensuring clean, real\-time data flow that minimises revenue leakage and billing exceptions
* Partner with Finance, Clinical Coding, and RCM operational leads to align system configuration with coding standards (ICD\-10, CPT, DRG), pre\-authorisation workflows, and payer contract logic



  





**Digital Clinical Innovation \& Ambient AI** 



* Guide the evaluation, piloting, and enterprise deployment of emerging clinical technologies including ambient AI documentation, agentic clinical workflows, and AI\-assisted clinical decision support
* Oversee the integration of ambient intelligence tools with Cerner Millennium, including real\-time write\-back architectures, NLP\-to\-structured\-data pipelines, and clinician\-facing AI interfaces



  





  





**Clinical Informatics \& Analytics Enablement** 



* Partner with clinical and operational leadership to design and deliver Cerner\-native and downstream analytics capabilities including Millennium reporting, Oracle ADW/OAC integration, and SAP BusinessObjects clinical datasets
* Lead the PACS and diagnostic imaging platform integration strategy, ensuring seamless clinical workflow across radiology, cardiology, and allied health image management



  





**Stakeholder Engagement \& Clinical Partnership** 



* Serve as the primary technology interface for clinical department heads, nursing informatics leads, and medical directors \- translating clinical requirements into platform architecture and build decisions
* Represent clinical applications and integration at board, committee, and executive governance forums, providing clear articulation of platform health, roadmap, and risk


- 


  





**Vendor \& Contract Management** 



* Own the strategic relationship with Oracle Health, managing support escalations, product advisory engagement, and contract performance against SLAs
* Govern third\-party clinical application vendor relationships including integration engine, ambient AI, CDS, PACS, and specialty application suppliers



  





  





**Performance, Governance \& Risk Management** 



* Define and monitor KPIs for clinical application availability, integration pipeline health, Millennium platform performance, and service desk resolution quality
* Establish and chair clinical application governance committees, change advisory boards, and platform steering groups
* Implement risk frameworks for clinical application dependencies, integration failure modes, and Millennium upgrade readiness
* Report on platform health, programme delivery, and innovation pipeline to executive leadership and the Board of Directors



  





  





**Education \& Qualification, Experience, Training \& Knowledge** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Health Informatics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related clinical or technical field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc Health Informatics) preferred
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in clinical applications management, healthcare IT, or health informatics \- with demonstrable depth in Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium platform ownership
* 5\+ years in a senior leadership role with direct responsibility for clinical application teams, integration architecture, or health IT programme delivery



  





**Cerner Millennium \& Integration Expertise (Essential)** 



* Deep, hands\-on expertise across Cerner Millennium clinical and operational domains \- including PowerChart, FirstNet, SurgiNet, PharmNet, Revenue Cycle, and Results Review
* Proven experience as a Millennium integration architect or senior build lead, with direct accountability for HL7 interface design, domain model governance, and cross\-system integration
* Demonstrated experience with enterprise integration engines (Rhapsody, Mirth, Rhapsody/Mirth equivalents) including interface build, monitoring, and operational governance
* Strong understanding of FHIR R4, SMART on FHIR, and CDS Hooks frameworks within the Oracle Health ecosystem



  





**Clinical Informatics \& Analytics** 



* Understanding of clinical data standards (HL7 v2, FHIR R4, SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD\-10\) and their application within Millennium and downstream analytics platforms
* Experience with clinical analytics platforms (Oracle ADW, OAC, SAP BusinessObjects, or equivalent) integrated with Millennium data feeds
* Knowledge of PACS and diagnostic imaging integration within the Millennium clinical workflow



  





**Regulatory \& Governance Knowledge** 



* Familiarity with UAE healthcare regulatory frameworks \- DHA, HAAD/DoH, MOH \- and their implications for clinical application governance and data exchange
* Understanding of NABIDH interoperability standards and their technical implementation within the Cerner ecosystem is highly desirable

**About Us:** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to ring every doorbell, everyday. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Head of Creative Strategy who can help us move even faster.
 



  





**What you’ll do:** 




 The Creative Strategy function sits at the core of how noon shows up to customers — driving high\-impact campaigns, creative execution, and brand storytelling across all markets and platforms. This role requires someone who can own end\-to\-end creative output, from ideation through to execution, and translate business priorities into campaigns that drive growth.
 



 You’ll work closely with the CEO, acting as a creative operator, strategist, and force multiplier. You will lead campaign development, shape creative direction, and ensure execution across digital, media, and on\-ground channels is best\-in\-class.
 



 This role is built for someone with real creative leadership instinct, sharp thinking, and the ability to operate in fast\-paced, high\-pressure environments. You should be able to develop strong campaign ideas independently and drive them through to execution with high standards.
 



  





**Key responsibilities include:** 



* Lead the development of breakthrough campaign ideas\-from concept through to execution
* Own end\-to\-end campaign delivery across digital ads, media, social, and key commercial moments
* Translate business priorities into high\-impact creative platforms that drive measurable outcomes
* Drive hero campaigns across key moments (Ramadan, sale events, growth pushes)
* Oversee creative production including ad films, digital content, and campaign assets
* Bring strong filmmaking sensibility — storytelling, pacing, and visual direction
* Ensure high\-quality, fast\-moving, performance\-driven execution across all channels
* Shape and evolve noon’s creative direction and tone of voice
* Drive execution across ATL, BTL, digital, and on\-ground activations
* Work closely with internal teams, agencies, and production partners to deliver at scale
* Partner with CEO / GrowCo and business leaders on high\-priority growth initiatives
* Build and lead a culture of creative excellence, ownership, and high standards



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 10–15\+ years of experience in creative strategy, advertising, or campaign leadership roles
* Proven track record of delivering high\-impact, full\-funnel campaigns
* Strong creative instinct and independent ideation ability
* Deep understanding of campaign development across digital, performance, and brand marketing
* Strong production and filmmaking sensibility
* Comfortable operating both strategically and hands\-on
* Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments
* Strong interpersonal skills — able to work across creative, marketing, product, and leadership teams
* High ownership — able to drive ideas from concept to execution without drop\-off
* Comfortable working under pressure with tight timelines and high expectations
* Detail\-oriented, with a strong focus on quality and output
* Commercially aware — understands how creativity drives performance and growth



  





**Bonus Points If You Have:** 



* Experience in e\-commerce, tech, or digital\-first businesses
* Strong portfolio of ad films, campaigns, or large\-scale creative work
* Experience working across multiple markets or culturally diverse audiences
* Prior experience working closely with founders or CEO offices



  





**Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high creative standards who understand that great work requires both ideas and execution.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful, with a strong bias for action and the ability to move quickly from concept to output.
* We value individuals with the confidence to push bold ideas, challenge thinking, and raise the bar on creative quality.
* Success here requires speed, resilience, and the ability to operate in ambiguity while delivering consistently high\-quality work.

 For our business, for clients, and for you

* Develop talent capable of operating confidently across data, AI, and commercial stakeholders.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

data.jd_text:
At RAKBANK, we believe in fostering a culture of innovation, growth, and excellence. We are not just a bank – we are a community that thrives on transformation, operational excellence, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As
 **Vice President \& Head of Branch Transformation** 
 , you will lead the modernization, optimization, and digital evolution of RAKBANK’s branch network. This role is central to shaping the future of physical distribution, driving operational efficiency, re‑engineering processes, enhancing customer journeys, and integrating digital capabilities across all branch formats.
 



 You will act as a strategic architect, transformation leader, and cross‑functional influencer who drives branch innovation, people capability uplift, and governance excellence across the full branch ecosystem.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing** 




**1\. Branch Network Strategy \& Transformation** 



* Develop and execute a bank‑wide branch transformation strategy, aligned to evolving customer behaviours and digital adoption trends.
* Optimize the entire branch network through footfall analysis, format redesign, and performance evaluation.
* Launch and scale digital‑first formats such as smart branches, micro branches, light formats, and full self‑service models.
* Drive cost optimization, leveraging automation, analytics, and process redesign initiatives.



  





**2\. Operations Optimization** 



* Right‑size staffing using traffic patterns, productivity ratios, and capacity models.
* Implement multiskilling, flexible staffing, and cross‑training frameworks to strengthen continuity and operational resilience.
* Standardize branch aesthetics, layouts, queue management, and workflow design to enhance operational consistency.
* Lead branch re‑engineering initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce cost, and improve end‑to‑end process quality.



  





**3\. Customer Experience Excellence** 



* Elevate customer experience across the network by improving NPS, CSAT, CES, and overall service quality.
* Strengthen the integration of digital \+ physical journeys, ensuring seamless movement across channels.
* Deploy and scale ITMs, digital kiosks, appointment systems, self\-service zones, and other assisted‑digital solutions.
* Ensure branches meet or exceed 95% DSES Mystery Shopping standards and uphold ISO Quality benchmarks.



  





**4\. Digital \& Technology Integration** 



* Pilot, validate, and scale emerging technologies such as AI‑powered service tools, biometrics, and digital documentation workflows.
* Optimize the performance, uptime, and customer usage of ATMs, ITMs, kiosks, and other self‑service devices.
* Accelerate digital migration through staff enablement, targeted campaigns, and improved customer adoption initiatives.
* Act as a technology advisor and SME for Retail Banking and branch technology initiatives.



  





**5\. People \& Culture Leadership** 



* Build and execute capability programs covering service excellence, consultative sales, and digital advisory for branch teams.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, and change readiness across all levels.
* Drive change management for all transformation programs, ensuring smooth rollout and staff engagement.
* Lead succession planning, job rotations, performance development, and team learning pathways.



  





**6\. Governance, Risk \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Ensure full adherence to regulatory, operational, compliance, and governance frameworks across the network.
* Strengthen audit readiness by ensuring alignment to OPs, clearing deferrals, and monitoring branch‑level risks.
* Present transformation updates, performance reports, and business cases to senior leadership committees.
* Manage key stakeholders, external vendors, and industry partners while monitoring market and competitor trends.
* Oversee ORM, audit follow‑ups, clean‑up exercises, and timely resolution of fraud/AML alerts.


- 


**What We’re Looking For** 



* A senior transformation leader with deep expertise in branch banking, operations, customer experience, and process re‑engineering.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to interpret data, optimize network economics, and drive large‑scale transformation.
* Proven success in leading digital integration, technology pilots, and operational modernization.
* A people‑centric leader who can inspire, influence, and uplift cross‑functional teams.
* Strong governance orientation with expertise in audit readiness, operational controls, compliance, and risk mitigation.



  





**What’s In It For You** 



* Competitive performance‑linked compensation.
* Medical coverage for you and your family.
* Comprehensive life insurance.
* Opportunity to lead one of the region’s most significant branch transformation programs.
* Fast‑track leadership development and exposure to enterprise‑wide initiatives.
* A collaborative, high‑impact environment that values innovation and transformation.

 Reporting to the Global Head of HR Transformation \& Operations, this role owns HRIS strategy, process transformation, and cross\-system integration. * Work with Global Head of Transformation \& Ops on the HR technology and AI strategy, including selection, governance, and optimization of HRIS platforms and related systems.

* Enable and ensure high quality data governance, building a single HR source of truth that supports reporting and analytics as foundation of business decision making.
* Lead major HR transformation programs, including system implementations, user experience improvement, and employee journey redesign.
* Oversee the ongoing maintenance, configuration, and performance of HR systems, coordinating with software vendors and system integration partners to ensure issues are resolved promptly, releases are managed effectively, and service levels are maintained.
* Partner with IT to ensure HR data flows and process triggers are accurately activating downstream systems and functions, including Payroll, Corporate Directory, and other business\-critical integrations, maintaining data integrity across the full employee lifecycle.

**Success Measures:** 



* Measurable improvement in HR process efficiency and innovation, including reduction in manual effort and processing time across key HR workflows

* HR systems operating within agreed SLAs, with incidents resolved promptly and releases coordinated with minimal disruption to the business.

data.jd_text:
Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United A”rab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organisation to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 The Head of Data Science \& Asset Risk owns the end\-to\-end analytics, forecasting and risk intelligence that protects and optimizes Al\-Futtaim’s automotive and financial services portfolio.
   

  

 This role is accountable for turning data, AI and market intelligence into financial outcomes, ensuring that pricing, leasing, provisioning, capital allocation and portfolio strategy are driven by forward\-looking, explainable and regulator\-ready models.
   

  

 The position operates at the intersection of CFO\-level financial control, CRO\-level risk management and CDO\-level analytics leadership, supporting executive and Board decision\-making across the group.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 The role is responsible for the full lifecycle of assets and market intelligence, from data to financial decision\-making.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Owning all Residual Value, used\-car pricing and market forecasting used across the business
* Maintaining authoritative market indices, price curves and forward\-looking scenarios for all brands, powertrains and segments
* Defining and enforcing the Asset Risk Framework covering market risk, EV transition risk, concentration risk and volatility
* Providing risk\-driven inputs to IFRS9, provisions, ECL and capital planning
* Ensuring all models are auditable, explainable and regulator\-ready


 The Head of Data Science \& Asset Risk acts as the single source of truth for:
   

  

* Portfolio value
* Forward price risk
* Stress scenarios
* Financial impact of market movements


 This role chairs the Residual Value \& Risk Committees, translating complex analytics into clear financial actions for the CFO, CRO and Executive Management.
   

  

**Strategic \& Commercial Impact**
**The Role Directly Influences**
* Vehicle pricing and lease structures
* Portfolio profitability and risk appetite
* Provisioning and capital allocation
* OEM negotiations and product launches
* Remarketing and stock strategy


 Decisions supported by this function materially impact P\&L, balance sheet and return on assets.
   

  

**Technology, Data \& AI Ownership**
 The role owns the group’s AI\-driven asset intelligence platform, including:
   

  

* Data pipelines across Brands, dealers, auctions, web and internal systems
* Forecasting, valuation and risk models
* Executive dashboards and real\-time reporting The mandate is to continuously replace external vendors and manual processes with in\-house, scalable AI, delivering higher accuracy, faster decisions and material cost savings.


**Leadership \& Governance**
**The Head Of Data Science \& Asset Risk**
* Leads a senior team of Data Scientists and Analytics specialists
* Defines modelling standards, governance and validation
* Ensures outputs are trusted by Finance, Risk and Commercial tems
* Acts as the group’s technical authority on asset valuation and risk.


**Required Skills To Be Successful**
* Deep hands\-on technical and analytical expertise, including Python, SQL, large\-scale data extraction, and building advanced statistical and machine\-learning models.
* Ability to turn data into actionable insight, translating complex analysis into clear decisions with measurable business impact.
* Strong data governance and risk discipline, ensuring models are explainable, controlled, and suitable for regulated environments.
* Proven leadership and executive influence, able to build scalable teams and drive adoption at the senior\-management level.


**About The Team**
* You will be reporting to Chief Risk Officer


**What Equips You For The Role**
* 10\+ years in Statistics, Data Science, Risk, Pricing, Forecasting or Financial Modelling
* Experience in automotive, asset finance, banking, insurance or large portfolios
* Proven ownership of P\&L\-critical models
* Strong background in IFRS9, ECL, stress testing or portfolio risk
* Comfortable operating at CFO, CRO and Board level

data.jd_text:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200\+ colleagues in 75\+ countries and very few office\-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
   

  

 The company is founder\-led, profitable, and growing.
   

  

 Global System Integrators (GSI) play a crucial role in Canonical growth plans in the coming 3 years. We are hiring a
 **Senior** 
**Partner Sales Manager** 
 to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long term digital transformation platforms with Ubuntu stacks and services.
   

  

 Working the the Partner Sales Director in their geographic region, the Senior Partner Sales Manager will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.
   

  

**The role entails**
* Build strategic relationships with partners at levels, and stickiness with Ubuntu technology
* Deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
* Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
* Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
* Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
* Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
* Ability to travel \- sometimes internationally \- up to 40% of the time


**What we are looking for in you**
* Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
* Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
* Autonomous, disciplined, hands\-on, get\-it\-done mentality
* Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
* Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
* Comfortable in fast\-paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals
* Excellent communication and presentation skills


**What we offer colleagues**
 We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance\-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
   

  

* Distributed work environment with twice\-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Team Member Assistance Program \& Wellness Platform
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long\-haul company events


**About Canonical**
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open\-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004\. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
   

  

**Canonical is an equal opportunity employer**
 We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
