data.jd_text:
**Job Requisition ID:** 
 176236
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United A”rab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organisation to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
* The Transformation Manager will play a pivotal role in evolving the operating model within Al\-Futtaim Group's Financial Services division, bridging between commercial goals, credit risk, and technology.
* The role involves converting conceptual frameworks into specific use cases and mapping out workflows, contributing to a seamless and profitable lending journey.
* Success in this role is defined by achieving higher conversion rates, frictionless user experiences, faster origination cycles, and maintaining a profitable loan book.
* The role requires dealing with ambiguity, connecting commercial dots, and influencing stakeholders at various levels, from shop\-floor operations to the C\-suite.


**What You Will Do:**
 Product Launch \& Framework Execution
   

  

* Lead the rollout of new lending products from zero to one.
* Lead the end\-to\-end setup of operations for new lending verticals, including underwriting workflows and loan booking processes.
* Translate abstract conceptual frameworks into specific use cases for immediate implementation.
* Guide the selection of the tech stack to make the customer experience instant and seamless.


 Transformation Program Steering
   

  

* Lead the definition, planning, and structuring of complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Actively steer program execution, identifying and resolving roadblocks.
* Support the development of robust business cases by analyzing and testing hypotheses.


 Business Analytics \& Storytelling
   

  

* Run advanced Excel analysis to identify process waste and uncover revenue opportunities.
* Translate data into sharp charts and executive presentations for management decisions.
* Track metrics like conversion rates, CAC, and LTV.


 Change Management \& Hands\-On Delivery
   

  

* Influence and direct operational staff and senior executives to drive immediate change.
* Overcome organizational resistance and ensure smooth transition to Business As Usual (BAU).
* Manage project risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.


 Performance Management \& Value Realization
   

  

* Define, track, and achieve project milestones and target KPIs such as reduced loan approval time.
* Design benefits realization trackers, holding function owners accountable for embedding changes.
* Manage budgets for initiatives influencing P\&L and operational performance.


 Tech and Digital Stack Alignment
   

  

* Partner with tech and digital teams to define business requirements for financial systems.
* Translate commercial requirements into technical specifications for platforms like LMS.
* Work with Risk and Compliance to ensure regulatory standards are met.


 End\-to\-End Process Optimization
   

  

* Map complex financial workflows and identify operational bottlenecks.
* Drive improvements in Turnaround Time (TAT) and Straight\-Through Processing (STP) rates.
* Integrate third\-party service providers seamlessly into the business architecture.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* Advanced Excel proficiency for data analysis.
* Strong communication skills for executive presentations.
* Ability to lead and steer cross\-functional initiatives.
* Deep understanding of consumer finance and lending mechanics.


**What Qualifies You For The Role:**
* 7\+ years experience in consumer finance, retail banking, or fintech.
* Master\-level proficiency in Excel for complex data modeling.
* Ability to create executive\-ready presentations from operational data.
* Proven experience in influencing change at all organizational levels.

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**
**Details of the Division and Team:**
 Deutsche Bank Private Bank is one of the largest wealth managers worldwide. We offer our clients a broad range of traditional and alternative investment solutions, as well as comprehensive advice on all aspects of Wealth Management. As a trusted partner of wealthy individuals and entrepreneurs, family offices and foundations, we create lasting value for clients. We specialize in developing bespoke solutions for our clients around the world, for instance wealth planning across successive generations and international borders, asset management with individual risk management, loans and deposits. All this is possible thanks to our global network, our many years of experience and our close collaboration with the Corporate Bank, Investment Bank and DWS. We aim to become a highly competitive global wealth manager by combining financial strength and stability with trustworthy partnership and forward\-thinking in order to build sustainable and beneficial client relationships. As a growth business for Deutsche Bank, we contribute towards building a more balanced, less capital intense and stable business model for the bank.
   

  

 The Relationship Manager is a primary point of contact for clients to access the entire suite of wealth management capabilities and solutions offered by Deutsche Bank Private Bank. This is achieved by working in close partnership with the Investment Manager in the day\-to\-day planning and servicing for the client. The individual is responsible for acquiring new clients \- which are in line with the business proposition of the bank \- and assets as well as grow existing business relationships, assuring a holistic and high\-standard client experience.
   

  

**What we will offer you:**
 A healthy, engaged and well\-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and well\-being at its center.
   

  

**Your key responsibilities:**
* Develop, manage and maintain overall relationship with the client, providing an holistic client experience
* Be the first point of contact and the overall responsible person with regard to dealing with client complaints
* Develop new business with new and existing clients, spending a great proportion of time focused on bringing in new clients and new assets (prospecting), building and sustaining long\-term relationships
* Work as a team with the Investment Manager (and the Institutional Wealth Partner where appropriate) to build deeper client relationships / involve in origination
* Keep day\-to\-day responsibility for advising clients within the required regulatory framework and keeping abreast of all client\-impacting initiatives from the respective market
* Proactively identifying client lending / financing needs, involving lending specialists to further develop the opportunity
* Perform continuous market analysis to identify potential client leads and opportunities
* Act as the Accountable Client Owner with responsibility for all AML aspects of the client relationship; this includes KYC in good quality and in a timely manner (no overdues) as well as account behavior, i.e. transactions with focus on 3rd party transactions constituting transfers in and out to be in line with purpose and anticipated behavior of the account(s).
* Where clients are not assigned an Investment Manager, own the overall suitability and appropriateness for client investments; taking client execution orders where required and ensuring that all corresponding checks are performed
* Participate in relevant client social events as well as in PR and other marketing activities
* Uphold the team’s operating rhythm (e.g. regular prospect review, pipeline review, account planning, etc.), leading by example and demonstrating role\-model behavior
* Work in close co\-operation with other coverage, product and support functions to deliver DB’s value proposition, leveraging also other DB divisions where possible
* Actively support the business / growth strategy, plans and values, contributing to the achievement of a high performing team
* Act within professional, legal and ethical boundaries and guidelines, observing all internal and external compliance regulations and code of ethics and conduct; flagging and managing reputational risks and conflicts issues


**Your skills and experience:**
* Minimum 7/10/15 years of relevant wealth management experience for VP/Director/Managing Director
* Solid network of clients in the target coverage market is required, specifically Non\-Resident Indians
* Fluency (written and oral) in English and other languages used in the target coverage market required for daily business processing and client communication
* Detail orientation on both strategy and execution
* Excellent communication skills
* Excellent collaboration skills
* Superior investment acumen
* Have a good understanding of the governing regulatory framework (e.g. RDR, MiFID II, etc.), including but not limited to applicable confidentiality / secrecy / data protection regulations and cross border rules where relevant
* Professional integrity
* For experienced hire, solid network of clients in the target coverage market is required
* Self\-starter
* Willing and able to develop other staff, e.g., analysts
* CFA, MBA degree or other advanced degree a plus


**About us and our teams:**
 Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.
   

  

 Our values define the working environment we strive to create – diverse, supportive and welcoming of different views. We embrace a culture reflecting a variety of perspectives, insights and backgrounds to drive innovation. We build talented and diverse teams to drive business results and encourage our people to develop to their full potential. Talk to us about flexible work arrangements and other initiatives we offer.
   

  

 We promote good working relationships and encourage high standards of conduct and work performance. We welcome applications from talented people from all cultures, countries, races, genders, disabilities, beliefs and generations and are committed to providing a working environment free from harassment, discrimination and retaliation.

data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Vice President, Public Sector, EEMEA
   

  

 Location is flexible but must be in EEMEA region.
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard is dedicated to promoting inclusive growth and financial inclusion. The mandate of the Regional Public Sector unit is to build durable, trusted relationships with key government agencies to accelerate their transition to a cashless ecosystem though digitalization, while increasing revenues and seeding new markets for Mastercard. We drive relevance and revenues in the government space by developing effective regional go to market programs supported by clear priorities, success metrics and incentives. We provide expert sales support to both country managers and local sales resources through a solid client engagement playbook approach. We guide the transition from reactive solutions sales to strategic public sector programs. And we ensure alignment between regional demand and our global solutions.
   

  

* The Regional Public Sector Senior Vice President role focuses on aligning Mastercard’s


 product, service and ecosystem capabilities to solve for the challenges government client face today in the areas of financial inclusion, citizen service efficiency, inclusive economic growth and government operational excellence. We do this by engaging, listening and leading. Our regional team is comprised of industry leaders, relationship builders and deal closers. We apply Mastercard’s digital tools, business insights, last mile solutions and market organizing skills to support client success. We also have a passion for learning, exploring new capabilities, and applying the best methodologies and insights to the government business.
   

  

* This role is at the heart of our intent to scale our business across all regions to drive revenue, market


 relevance and social impact. The unit is regionally deployed and focuses on a select number of priority
   

  

 markets, segments and clients, directly agreed with the senior leadership in the region.
   

  

* The Regional Public Sector SVP is accountable for:
* The development of the regional government vision, strategy and execution program including a list of prioritized markets, clients and solution opportunities.
* Identify and pursue opportunities in digitizing big government flows, transformational infrastructure partnerships, major transit and tourism initiatives
* The acceleration of Mastercard’s revenue performance in the region, through a structured and diligent sales excellence approach.
* The effective management of a growing team of senior government specialists across target markets, in a peer alignment to the Divisional Presidents.
* The effective representation of the Public Sector business opportunity within the region’s senior management team, as well as the negotiation of the related revenue and relevance objectives with other members of the management team.
* The alignment of global, regional and local resources to drive execution, in close coordination with the Region’s President, the Divisional Presidents, the regional product and service units and the Mastercard Strategic Growth management team.
* Direct engagement on key government opportunities, at the top civil servant and political government executive level, developing the business opportunities across the region, assisting country managers and helping win strategic deals.
* Capacity building at the markets level by training sales on relevant Mastercard solutions, narrative and client references.
* The establishment and management of a regional community of practice to cross\-fertilize regional and global best practices.
* This position reports directly to EVP, Market Development \- EEMEA with a dotted line reporting relationship into the Global Lead, Public Sector Center of Excellence. Location is flexible but must be in region.


 Role
   

  

* Primary accountability for development and execution of the regional government strategy, starting


**From**
* Develop a deep understanding of regional, national and local priorities.
* Engaging region and division leadership in a peer fashion to prioritize clients and solution opportunities. Negotiate and secure local support of resources, aligning them to execution.
* Securing global and regional resources to execute on the plan and drive marquee wins. Build a region\-wide Public Sector extended steering committee including peers in the Public Policy, Legal, Services, Consumer and commercial products, O\&T and Delivery units.
* Lead a team of segment experts, helping them growing in their roles by active coaching and talent planning
* Accelerate solutions deployment by providing regional trainings to own team and other in market units, provide expert sales support for marquee engagements.
* Liaison with the peers across the five global regions of MA and the Global PS team to represent EEMEA and draw on expertise and market development support
* Personally initiate and drive marquee, commercial deals.
* Represent the Region within Strategic Growth’s management team. Drive strategic alignment with global units.
* Build and curate the regional community of practice. Mobilize the team to act as first line of support for regional \& divisional presidents for thought leadership and strategic engagements.


**All About You**
* Experience working for or closely with government agencies, managing process improvement and


 transformative change initiatives, as well as proven experience in engaging very senior government
   

  

 leaders to build durable relations.
   

  

* Proven track in leading and closing large and complex government deals in the region.
* Consultative selling focused, with deep product, services, and solutions expertise and hands\-on approach
* Adept at interacting with senior Mastercard stakeholders – in terms of engagement, communication and transparency of purpose. Can skillfully lead complex regional initiatives that require collaboration across functional, geographical and cultural lines.
* Demonstrated ability to work across divisional boundaries, within the region, acting as peer to other senior leaders.
* Self\-motivated, thrives in a fast\-paced environment; readiness to take\-on stretch goals.
* Strong gravitas, exceptional relationship management, influencing and communication skills.
* Open to travel across the region and globally
* English fluency is required. At least one other regional language a strong plus.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

data.jd_text:
Dow Jones Energy is seeking a visionary Vice President to lead its energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply business across the Middle East \& Africa. This is a senior regional leadership role responsible for shaping and executing Dow Jones Energy's commercial strategy in one of the world's most strategically important and geopolitically complex energy markets.
   

  

 The role is designed for a seasoned energy leader with deep expertise in global commodity markets, pricing and benchmarks, and the evolving energy transition, combined with the executive presence to operate at the highest levels of government, national oil companies, and multinational energy organizations.
   

  

 Based in Dubai, you will serve as a regional business leader for Dow Jones Energy in the region, with broad accountability across strategy, revenue growth, people leadership, and senior stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insight across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chain. Our offerings support customers across spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the energy transition.
   

  

 Through authoritative data, real\-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables customers to make confident, high\-stakes commercial decisions in volatile and fast\-evolving markets.
   

  

**You Will**
* Define and execute the long\-term sustainable commercial and growth strategy for Dow Jones Energy across the MEA region, driving revenue growth, market expansion and engagement, aligned with global priorities.
* Collaborate with the Consulting function to unlock cross sell opportunities, deepen executive relationships, and drive incremental revenue across the region
* Partner closely with global leadership on forecasting, investment planning, and long\-term growth initiatives.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a multi\-country organization of senior managers, sales leaders, and specialists, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and sophisticated consultative selling.
* Build leadership capability and develop succession across the region.
* Position Dow Jones Energy as a mission\-critical market intelligence partner for the region's most influential institutions.
* Oversee the integrity of the regional sales pipeline, ensuring world\-class CRM hygiene and providing the global executive committee with high\-level forecasting and market risk assessments.
* Represent Dow Jones Energy with C\-suite executives, regulators, ministries, and industry bodies across the MEA region.
* Apply deep subject\-matter expertise across oil, refined products, chemicals, metals, and energy transition markets to identify emerging opportunities.
* Influence global product strategy, pricing, and regional go\-to\-market decisions, ensuring MEA market needs are reflected in Dow Jones Energy's roadmap.
* Operate effectively within a complex global organization, partnering closely with Product, Editorial, Technology, Marketing, and Operations teams to deliver integrated, high\-impact solutions.
* Orchestrate collaboration between News, Product, and Research teams across Dow Jones to deliver holistic, 360\-degree solutions to complex energy conglomerates.


**You Have**
* 15\+ years of leadership experience in energy, commodities, metals, energy data/analytics, or adjacent sectors.
* Proven success driving regional revenue growth and market expansion across complex, multi\-country environments.
* Track record of leading senior commercial teams and closing high\-value, strategic enterprise agreements.
* Deep familiarity with MEA energy markets, regulatory environments, and geopolitical dynamics.
* Executive\-level credibility with governments, NOCs, and multinational energy leaders.
* Strong strategic and commercial judgment.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills.
* Fluency in English required; Arabic strongly preferred.


**Our Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Family Care Benefits
* Access to Dow Jones Products
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program
* Employee Well\-being Support \& Fitness Programs

**Union Status**

 Since 1882, Dow Jones has been finding new ways to bring information to the world’s top business entities. Beginning as a niche news agency in an obscure Wall Street basement, Dow Jones has grown to be a worldwide news and information powerhouse, with prestigious brands including The Wall Street Journal, Dow Jones Newswires, Factiva, Barron’s, MarketWatch and Financial News.

data.jd_text:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 14 offices and 25 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Regional Vice President is a front line sales leader who will leads a team of Enterprise Account Executives. This role will be responsible for running a regional plan, building out the territory, developing Enterprise Account Executives within the region, while implementing a strong sales methodology, working complex enterprise sales cycles, while focused on the Harness software and services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly and yearly revenue targets
* Develop and execute a comprehensive regional plan
* Accelerate customer adoption
* Continually build and grow a robust sales pipeline
* Work with partners to extend reach \& drive adoption
* Lead contract negotiations
* Develop long\-term strategic relationships with key accounts
* Ensure customer happiness and success
* Help to recruit and build west sales team
* Travel throughout predominantly the Middle East but occasionally across Europe and North America.


**About You**
* At least 3 years formal sales leadership experience building and leading high performance sales teams.
* High career trajectory and potential.
* Someone with experience in a start\-up environment.
* Consistent overachievement in previous roles.
* Significant enterprise sales and strategic customer development experience.
* Experience practicing and implementing a sales methodology, such as MEDDIC.
* Track record in closing large, complex deals across verticals in the Fortune 500\.
* History of accurate forecasting and business reporting.
* Experience in working with Salesforce and other sales oriented tracking tools.


**What You Will Have At Harness**
* Competitive salary
* Flexible work schedule
* Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
* Quarterly Harness TGIF\-Off / 4 days


**Work Location**
* This is a hybrid role, based in our Dubai, UAE offer.


**Harness In The News**
* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5\.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale \| Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success


 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
   

  

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
 We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
   

  

 Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
   

  

 If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job\-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

 within the

Working alongside a collaborative team at the Corporate Head Office in Hong Kong, we are seeking a Vice President, Digital Product and E\-Commerce to join our Sales \& Marketing Department.
 



  





  





 In this influential leadership role, you will lead the evolving digital product and CRM platform strategies for The Peninsula Hotels with a focus on driving revenue growth, optimising user experience, integration of core content and commerce platforms, while improving guest retention and enhancing conversion and engagement across critical digital touchpoints. This role will oversee the brand’s primary direct digital channels and associated content and transactional systems, and will also oversee our evolving CRM/CDP platforms leveraging AI driven technology to enable personalised digital and operational experiences.
 



  





  





**Key Accountability** 



* Lead the Enhancement of the Digital Guest Experience \- Systematically map, evaluate, and refine Peninsula's digital customer journey, encompassing initial digital engagement, to inspiration, personalisation, and seamless transactional process.
* Optimise digital experiences across all core revenue driving aspects of the company, including guest room research and bookings, food and beverage (bars and restaurants), meetings \& events, spa \& wellness, as well Peninsula signature event.
* Lead UX/UI enhancements, personalisation, and A/B testing of Peninsula digital products to improve engagement and conversion on Peninsula’s direct digital channels.
* Collaborate with leadership from IT, Brand Marketing, Revenue Management, Sales, Operations and other teams to develop best\-in\-class guest facing digital products, and to support integration with key platforms including Property Management Systems (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), Customer Relationship Management platforms (CRM), Table Management Systems (TMS), Spa Booking Engines, and other backend platforms.
* Lead future planning for evolved content management system (CMS) and headless content strategies, supporting optimal workflows and multi\-channel content distribution.
* Lead evolving CRM, CDP and loyalty\-related technology needs, including guest facing profile and preference management, online spend/tier tracking, etc, as well as supporting efforts to pass relevant guest data points to operational\-level systems for personalisation capabilities with on\-property colleagues.

* Oversee and evolve key relationships with global digital agency partners who support Peninsula with outsourced design and development efforts.
* Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies that can support Peninsula’s digital transformation including practical use of AI for both internal productivity as well as guest facing personalisation.
* Provide data\-driven insights to executive leadership on digital commerce performance and opportunities.
* Oversee complex Digital Product and E\-Commerce budgeting, and support the development of future modelling for sourcing of funds across both Operational and Capital expenditures.



  





  





**General Requirement** 



* University degree or higher in a relevant field.
* Solid experience in digital product and CRM development in a leadership capacity, preferably within hospitality or luxury retail.
* Regional or global experience preferred.
* Strong commercial mindset.
* Proven team development and people management experience.
* Excellent communication skills and socially adept.
* Fluent English with strong presentation skills.
* Passionate about luxury hospitality.



  





  





 We are delighted to receive your CV for further consideration.

 The Maples Group is a global leader in financial services, trusted by many of the world’s largest hedge fund managers, private equity firms, and international corporations. **What is it like to work here?**






  





 We are driven to excel, and collaboration is key to our continued success. We can go further for our clients because we go further for each other too. Our inclusive culture creates an environment where people can be themselves at work while doing their best work. No matter where you work in the Maples Group, you will be part of a global team.
 



  





**The Opportunity**




  





 We are looking for an accomplished Assistant Vice President to join our Fiduciary team as part of our financial services business in Dubai.
 



  





 Established in 2008, our Dubai office is the Maples Group’s regional operating hub in the Middle East. A commitment to service excellence and investment in our people has led to continued growth where our teammates deliver best\-in\-class solutions to clients worldwide alongside our colleagues in legal services.
 



  





 The Assistant Vice President (“AVP”) within the Dubai Fiduciary team report to the Regional Head of Fiduciary are responsible for undertaking a high number of new business/transactions, whether fiduciary or administrative in nature.
 



  





 Your primary responsibilities include:
 



  





*Client Work and Client Service* 




  




* Being the assigned administrator responsible for a portfolio of clients;
* Responsible for preparing management accounts or financial statements from available source documents;
* Correspond with the clients about source documents and other details required for preparing the management accounts or the financial statements;
* Liaise with auditors, lawyers, investment managers or other parties related to the company when required to prepare the reports;
* Assist with Audit of financial statements;
* Assist clients for filing FATCA/CRS, ESR and CIT;
* reviewing transaction documents, providing written comments to parties as appropriate or attending conference calls as required;
* liaising with arrangers, investment managers, lawyers and other relevant parties concerning the setting up of new business as well as acting as a primary point of contact for ongoing issue resolution;
* ensuring files are compliant with MaplesFS procedures and policies;
* ensuring all relevant MaplesFS databases are completed and maintained with accurate information in relation to assigned portfolio of clients;
* ensuring all annual administration in respect of a client is completed in accordance with the MaplesFS policies and procedures and in a timely manner;
* developing effective working relations with assigned portfolio of clients and responding promptly and professionally to client requests;
* assessing and advising clients of compliance requirements and obtaining necessary documentation prior to commencing work and in accordance with all internal procedures.



  





*Billing and Receivables* 




  




* ensuring invoices are raised and disseminated to clients in a timely manner and in accordance with administration agreements; and
* consistently monitoring and minimising receivables, ensuring that no balances over 90 days exist without reason agreed to by.



  





*Risk Management* 




  




* acting in accordance with legal, regulatory and internal risk management requirements, including complying with policies and procedures.



  





*Business Development* 




  




* maintaining active contact with a targeted network in order to create market opportunities;
* helping to win new clients to meet the firm’s growth, revenue and cross selling .



  





**What You Bring**






  





 In addition to a commitment to delivering superior candidate and stakeholder experiences:
 



  




* Significant similar experience ideally gained in financial services, audit or any other similar business;
* Strong leadership skills;
* Qualification in accountancy, finance or related course;
* Exercise professional discretion and observing client.



  





**Benefits \& Rewards**




  





 The most enduring professional relationships are reciprocal relationships. The Maples Group prioritises employee health and wellbeing. Depending on your location, we offer a range of benefits, including:
 



  




* Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental and optical)
* Competitive vacation packages
* Educational assistance and professional development programmes
* Savings or pension plan
* Life insurance
* Travel insurance
* Global mental wellness programme
* Sports clubs and social events



  





 You can learn more about the Maples Group on our corporate website. Experience our culture and our people on our Careers Page or on LinkedIn.
 



 Disclaimer: All personal information collected during the application process will be used for recruitment\-related purposes only. Please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice at maples.com/privacy for details on how we handle personal information relating to job applicants.
 



  





  





 “Please note that it is the Maples Group standard policy to undertake various background screening checks on all applicants to whom a conditional job offer is made. Except for roles based in the Republic of Ireland, the background checks will include criminal records checks when a conditional job offer is made. If you have a criminal record, it does not mean that your job offer will be automatically withdrawn. The Maples Group will make all job offer decisions on a case\-by\-case basis and will take a number of factors into account, such as the role that you are applying for and the nature and circumstances of the past offence. You will have the opportunity to discuss the matter with us before a decision is made. Further details will be provided at the time any conditional job offer is made.”

 • Support the operational efficiency within Emarat to ensure business continuity and minimize disruptions related to the function that may affect business.
 



 • Conduct periodic reviews of financial policies and procedures to identify improvement opportunities, ensuring best practices are implemented across all finance\-related activities.

 • Participate in feasibility studies for new projects, evaluating their financial impact on liquidity and profitability to inform strategic decision\-making.
 



 • Arrange and negotiate loan proposals with banks, ensuring the best financing solutions are secured for the corporation’s needs.

data.jd_text:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 We are seeking a dynamic and enterprise\-minded Director – Finance Technology to lead the evolution of our Finance technology landscape and act as a key partner to the CFO and Technology leadership. This strategic role will enable Finance to operate with greater agility, insight, and efficiency, while ensuring governance and enterprise\-wide alignment. The role will also focus on continuously innovating through the application of the latest technology, including AI\-driven solutions, to address and solve complex business and finance challenges.
   

  

 A core part of this role is to lead the transition and integration of the Finance\-aligned ‘shadow IT’ team into the central Technology \& Data organization, ensuring structure, accountability, and long\-term support models are in place.
   

  

 Additionally, the role will support the SAP S/4HANA “Transform” programme by preparing for and managing the service transition from implementation to BAU operations, including the retirement of Oracle Finance platforms and future enhancement ownership of SAP.
   

  

 In parallel, this role will be accountable for maintaining stability and operational continuity within the Oracle Finance environment until SAP is fully deployed ensuring tight SLAs, clear ownership, and minimal business disruption.
   

  

 You will be responsible for building a scalable, insight\-driven support model for Finance that leverages automation, modern BI platforms, and advanced analytics while ensuring technology investments deliver measurable business value and financial transparency.
   

  

 In their endeavour to excellence, the fundamental values all our employees must possess are Commitment, Integrity, Empathy and Flexibility.
   

  

**Strategic Leadership \& Transformation Partnership**
* Define and drive the Finance technology roadmap aligned with transformation priorities enabling automation, insight, AI\-driven solutions and operational excellence.
* Serve as the strategic liaison between Technology and Finance, ensuring clarity and alignment on transformation initiatives, investment plans, and support capabilities. Continuously explore and evaluate the latest AI and technology innovations to address emerging Finance challenges
* Partner with the CFO and Finance Transformation Office to provide technology support for the “Transform” SAP S/4HANA programme, ensuring post\-go\-live service models are operationally ready.


**Service Transition \& SAP Operational Readiness**
* Lead the transition of Finance support services from Oracle to SAP, ensuring business continuity, knowledge transfer, and platform stability during and after go\-live.
* Establish scalable, structured BAU processes to support SAP post\-implementation, including incident, change, enhancement, and user support workflows.
* Coordinate with the SAP programme team and external vendors to ensure smooth handover into IT operations, and future\-proof support and optimization models.


**Shadow IT Integration \& Organizational Alignment**
* Lead the integration of the Finance shadow IT team into the Technology \& Data organization aligning roles, responsibilities, and capabilities under IT governance.
* Implement operating models, performance metrics, and delivery standards to ensure the integrated team functions as a high\-performing unit within Enterprise Technology.
* Rationalize and modernize legacy Finance tools, ensuring compliance with security, architecture, and data standards.


**Finance Data, BI \& Analytics Enablement**
* Develop and deliver a scalable Finance data and BI support model to enhance agility, accuracy, and decision\-making across the Finance function.
* Drive the adoption of advanced analytics, AI\-driven tools, and self\-service reporting solutions to meet Finance’s evolving needs, including forecasting, scenario planning, and business insights.
* Simplify and standardize data models, promoting a “single source of truth” approach, while leveraging bots, AI\-driven automation, and auto\-reconciliation to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Deliver high\-quality, real\-time financial reporting capabilities to support key stakeholders, including the CFO and Finance leadership, with timely, data\-driven insights.
* Ensure the standardization and consistency of financial statements (P\&L, balance sheets, cash flow reports), meeting both internal requirements and regulatory standards.
* Continuously enhance Finance data and BI solutions to ensure the accuracy and timeliness of financial performance reporting, enabling informed decision\-making across the organization.
* Promote self\-service tools to empower Finance teams to generate customized financial reports, reducing manual processes and improving operational efficiency.


**Financial Governance \& Technology ROI**
* Partner closely with Finance leaders to ensure rigor in ROI analysis, cost\-benefit evaluations, and business case development for technology investments.
* Provide transparency into the cost structure of Finance tech, identifying opportunities for optimization, consolidation, and reinvestment.
* Embed financial discipline into platform management and enhancement prioritization across SAP and other Finance platforms.


**Operational Excellence \& Agile Execution**
* Own the end\-to\-end management of Finance technology enhancements in the Oracle ecosystem, ensuring requests are triaged, prioritized, and delivered through a structured SAFe Agile delivery model.
* Collaborate across Finance, Procurement, and Audit teams to enhance process effectiveness, control, and sustainability
* Implement guardrails to minimize “regret spend” by enforcing clear business cases, ROI thresholds, and traceability of enhancements to strategic outcomes.
* Ensure alignment between product owners, dev teams, and Finance stakeholders to deliver value\-driven outcomes including AI\-driven solutions without unnecessary complexity or cost.
* Establish and embed a similar enhancement governance framework for SAP post go\-live enabling continuous improvement, controlled backlog management, and full visibility on change investment decisions.
* Drive continuous service improvement through AI\-driven insights, data, user feedback, and performance metrics.
* Lead the Major Incident Management (MIM) rota on a rotating basis (approximately 1 week in every 8–10 weeks), providing authoritative leadership during high\-impact events as a core accountability of the Director role.


**People, Culture \& Capability Building**
* Build a high\-performing, integrated Finance tech support team, blending retrained legacy Finance IT talent with strategic recruitment with central IT standards, practices, and a strong culture.
* Support the Finance function’s ambition to close digital capability gaps, enhance analytics maturity, and foster talent development across areas like AI, tax tech, automation, and data.
* Enable a culture of cross\-functional collaboration and shared ownership across IT and Finance teams.


**Finance Technology \& Functional Expertise**
* Deep understanding of Finance enterprise platforms, including Oracle and SAP S/4HANA, with experience supporting transformations, enhancements, and maintaining operational stability.
* Proven expertise in managing technology services for Finance, including system integration, application support, and lifecycle ownership across core functions such as accounting, tax, reporting, financial planning, and procurement.
* Hands\-on experience in implementing and supporting Business Intelligence (BI) and analytics solutions tailored to Finance, enabling self\-service reporting, forecasting, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Familiar with automation and integration tools relevant to Finance, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA), reconciliation systems, and reporting controls to improve process efficiency and accuracy.
* Experience delivering technology enhancements using Agile methodologies (SAFe preferred), managing cross\-functional backlogs, release cycles, and aligning with Finance stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards (e.g., IFRS, SOX, GDPR) across all Finance technology platforms. Collaborate with internal and external teams to ensure auditability and data traceability in Oracle and SAP environments.
* Work with legal and compliance teams to uphold financial data privacy, security, and reporting standards, especially for AI\-driven solutions and automation.
* Accounting: Lead technology solutions for core accounting processes, ensuring alignment with financial reporting standards and integration with broader Finance systems.
* Group Finance \& Management Reporting: Oversee technology solutions supporting financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting, enabling effective management reporting and group\-wide performance tracking.
* Tax: Support the transformation of tax technology to streamline processes, automate calculations, and ensure compliance with global tax regulations.
* Treasury: Enhance Treasury systems to improve cash management, liquidity forecasting, and risk management, with a focus on automating cash position reporting and transaction reconciliation.
* Procurement: Integrate Finance and Procurement systems to optimize purchasing, supplier management, and cost control, driving automation and reporting improvements.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or any related field; MBA or relevant postgrad qualification preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience across technology, enterprise transformation, or Finance systems leadership, with at least 5 years in a senior role.
* Proven experience supporting large\-scale Finance transformations, ideally including SAP S/4HANA implementations and post\-go\-live transitions.
* Deep understanding of AI, machine learning, and emerging technologies in Finance, with a demonstrated passion for exploring, implementing, and seamlessly integrating these advanced tools into innovative business solutions.
* Demonstrated success in leading shadow IT transitions, platform rationalization, and team integrations within a complex enterprise.
* Deep understanding of Enterprise Finance systems (SAP, Oracle), BI tools, and data models.
* Deep functional understanding of Finance operating models and processes, including key domains such as Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Record\-to\-Report (R2R), and Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A). Able to translate business needs into technology solutions and support models that reflect the nuances and dependencies across Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax, Procurement, and Financial Operations.
* Experience in retail, FMCG, or complex operational environments would be a plus.
* Familiarity with ESG, sustainability reporting, or governance tooling is an advantage.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

**Job Description**
**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies to power mobility platforms. Our flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue\-based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.

Today, Moove operates the worlds largest manned \& autonomous ride\-hail fleet, with 38k\+ vehicles across 29 cities, 13 countries and 6 continents enabled by 2\.1k\+ employees – Moove continues to expand through strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Uber. We’re transforming mobility to be safer, more efficient, and accessible to all, while creating economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer who can autonomously design, build, and maintain the critical systems that power our platform. You will think like a product owner, identifying business opportunities and driving technical solutions that deliver measurable impact. This role involves working across the stack, ensuring backend services seamlessly integrate with frontend experiences while maintaining performance, scalability, and reliability.

 This role exists to deliver robust, scalable, and high\-performing backend systems that directly drive business growth and user satisfaction.

**Job Description**
 GEMS Al Barsha National School is seeking an experienced and passionate Head of Arabic Studies from August 2026\. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing school that combines the National Curriculum for England with a strong focus on UAE national values, culture, and identity.
   

  

 The Head of Arabic Studies Department will provide strategic leadership in curriculum development, teaching, and learning, ensuring high standards in Arabic education. With teaching responsibilities, the role focuses on delivering an engaging, research\-driven curriculum that integrates modern pedagogy, technology, and student\-centered learning. The position also involves mentoring teachers, fostering cultural appreciation, and building strong partnerships with educational bodies to enhance student outcomes and uphold national educational standards. o lead and develop high standards of pedagogy and practice across all departments. The successful candidate will support Subject Leaders in decision\-making for curriculum, assessment, and resource development, and will lead intervention and development plans for individual teachers as required.
   

  

* Provide leadership and guidance to Arabic teachers and curriculum support staff, ensuring high standards of teaching, learning, and the integration of educational technology across all phases.
* Monitor the effectiveness of the Arabic teaching programmes, ensuring they are innovative and deliver the appropriate standards, key concepts, and knowledge.
* Set and deliver targets for improvement for students, ensuring staff are fully conversant in the effective use of data to raise attainment and accelerate progress.
* Analyse department data with the team to identify students at risk of underachieving and target intervention effectively to ensure success.
* Identify the training needs for all staff within the team, devise appropriate professional development opportunities, and share best practices.
* Lead the Performance Management process for the team, identifying areas for improvement and producing appropriate staff development plans where necessary.
* Promote the subject area through Open Days, Options Evenings, and develop opportunities to raise the profile of Arabic studies throughout the year.


**Skills**
 Qualifications \& Knowledge
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Arabic Studies plus a recognised teaching qualification/licence
* At least 2 years’ experience of middle/senior leadership with Arabic and Islamic
* Experience in teaching and leading across at least two phases
* A successful track record of planning, implementing, and managing change
* Experience in working in an International setting, with thorough knowledge and understanding of the DSIB inspection framework and UAE National Agenda
* A clear drive and motivation for all students to achieve and exceed their potential


 Skills \& Attributes
   

  

* Proven leadership and management skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative and supportive approach.
* A reflective practitioner committed to continuous improvement and innovation.
* High expectations for academic standards, student achievement, and behaviour.
* Ability to foster a positive learning environment that encourages curiosity, independence, and critical thinking.


**GEMS Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all of its students and staff. A UK\-enhanced DBS or equivalent police check is a pre\-requisite for all appointments.**

**Job Summary**
 This senior leadership position is responsible for providing strong executive presence and strategic direction for Product Support across the Middle East region. The role ensures an outstanding level of customer service while acting as a visible, credible, and proactive member of the regional management team.
   

  

 The Regional Support Manager is accountable for elevating service maturity, delivering modern support practices, strengthening regional leadership cohesion, and driving measurable performance improvement aligned with both global strategy and regional business priorities. This role leads the Support and Services teams and represents Product Support at senior customer and executive forums across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide visible, credible leadership to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, representing Product Support at executive governance forums and acting as the senior escalation point for complex or high\-impact matters.
* Act as an integral member of the Middle East regional management team, contributing to regional strategy, commercial discussions, resource planning, and operational decision\-making beyond functional boundaries.
* Lead, develop, and performance\-manage the regional Support function, establishing clear accountability, measurable objectives, and a high\-performance culture focused on outcomes rather than activity.
* Own the end\-to\-end regional service delivery model across Incidents, Service Requests, Enhancement Requests, and upgrades, ensuring structured prioritisation, demand management, and alignment to contractual commitments and business value.
* Drive disciplined service governance, including KPI definition, SLA performance, backlog management, trend analysis, and executive\-level reporting with clear corrective and preventative action plans.
* Champion a consultative approach to customer engagement, ensuring the team understands the underlying business requirement and defines appropriate, sustainable solutions rather than defaulting to unconditional agreement or tactical fixes.
* Partner with Product, Development, and Services teams to address recurring issues, influence product direction, coordinate upgrade strategies, and ensure regional requirements are effectively represented in global roadmaps.
* Oversee major incident management, change governance, and release readiness, ensuring structured communication, risk management, and minimal disruption to customer operations.
* Lead the continuous improvement and modernisation of regional support practices, incorporating best\-practice service management frameworks, automation, tooling enhancements, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Ensure robust communication and escalation processes across regional and global stakeholders, fostering transparency, alignment, and strong cross\-functional collaboration.
* Develop future regional support leaders and embed a culture of ownership, innovation, and constructive challenge within the team.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Minimum 10–12 years’ experience in Information Technology Support, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated executive presence and experience engaging with C\-level stakeholders and senior healthcare leaders.
* Proven ability to operate as part of a senior regional management team and influence cross\-functional outcomes.
* Experience supporting multiple enterprise applications, preferably in Healthcare.
* Strong track record of driving cultural change, service transformation, and measurable performance improvement.
* Experience managing support from both service delivery and development perspectives.
* Deep understanding of service management frameworks (e.g., ITIL) and modern support methodologies, including automation and data\-driven performance management.


**Education and Training**
* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare, Computer Science or a related field
* ITIL certification (preferred)
* Relevant leadership or management training (preferred)

Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit

 A global data center developer is seeking a senior leader to codify and standardize the end‑to‑end data center development and operations lifecycle. This role focuses

**About us:**

We encourage children to cultivate fulfilling relationships with others and seek meaning and purpose in their own lives.  Where Amazing Happens

 · Medical Insurance for self
 



 · Annual Air\-Ticket and paid vacations
 



 · Tuition Fee Concession for up to 2 minor dependent(s)

 If you have the passion, energy, and commitment to drive accelerated outcomes for young people, we will welcome your application. In return, you will join a rapidly evolving organisation that can offer you a central role in our future growth plans.
 



  





 Candidates are invited to complete our
 **Online Application** 
 by visiting: https://forteseducation.com/Careers/Current\-Openings
 



 Interviews will take place either face\-to\-face in Dubai or by video conferencing if the applicant is not based in Dubai.
 



  





  





 The closing date for applications is the
 **31st March 2026** 
 . Please note that due to the expected volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. The appointment start date will be
 **August 2026** 
 .

**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (with significant international mobility)
 



**Sector:** 
 Energy Infrastructure \& Large\-Scale Logistics
 



**Seniority:** 
 Finance Director / Project CFO (15\+ years’ experience)
 



  





  





 A prominent, privately\-held international energy infrastructure group is seeking a high\-caliber Finance Director to lead the financial architecture for its expanding portfolio of large\-scale infrastructure projects. With active development across multiple high yield geographies, the firm focuses on the deployment of complex, capital\-intensive assets. Operating in a lean, executive\-led environment, this role offers the autonomy to build financial structures for 1B\+ USD projects and direct accountability to the C\-suite.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Project Finance Architecture:** 
 Lead the end\-to\-end financial structuring for large\-scale energy projects. Design and execute SPV/Project Company setups, including the ringfencing of assets to manage risk and optimize capital allocation.



  




* **Capital Structuring \& Debt Management:** 
 Manage the debt\-equity mix for major developments. Engage with lenders, structure non\-recourse project finance, and oversee the financial close of multi\-hundred\-million\-dollar deals.



  




* **Operational Financial Leadership:** 
 Act as the "Project CFO" for designated project entities. Oversee the full financial lifecycle from the development/construction phase through to long\-term operational and revenue\-generating stability.



  




* **Risk \& Compliance:** 
 Implement rigorous financial governance frameworks across multi\-jurisdictional environments (specifically focusing on emerging markets). Ensure compliance with international reporting standards and lender requirements.



  




* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Serve as the primary finance liaison between technical, legal, and operational project teams. Work closely with external financial/tax advisors to manage complex joint venture agreements.



  




* **Reporting \& Strategy:** 
 Deliver high\-level financial analysis and performance metrics to the board and internal stakeholders, providing the narrative that drives future project investment.



  





**Candidate Requirements** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 15\+ years of progressive finance experience in the energy, infrastructure, or large\-scale EPC sectors. Proven track record in managing project\-level financials for assets exceeding 200M\+ USD.



  




* **Technical Competence:** 
 Expert\-level mastery of project finance, financial modeling, treasury management, and corporate structuring. Deep understanding of multi\-currency, multi\-jurisdiction project accounting.



  




* **Project Execution:** 
 Direct experience in taking large\-scale energy or infrastructure projects from Financial Close through to the operational phase.



  




* **Commercial Mindset:** 
 Ability to balance complex financial structuring with the operational realities of working in challenging, emerging\-market environments.



  




* **Communication Skills:** 
 Exceptional verbal and written communication. Must be capable of representing the firm in high\-stakes negotiations with external lenders, equity partners, and government stakeholders.



  




* **Personality \& Mindset:** 
 Entrepreneurial and "hands\-on." Comfortable working in a lean environment where taking direct ownership is expected. Culturally adaptable and resilient.



  




* **Mobility:** 
 Willingness to be based in Dubai or Europe, with an appetite for significant travel and potential relocation to project sites in Africa to ensure on\-the\-ground financial oversight.



  




* **Education:** 
 Strong academic background in Finance, Economics, or Engineering. Professional certifications (CFA, ACCA, CPA) are highly desirable.



  





**Please apply by submitting your CV.**

 So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry\-changing team.

You are a key leader aligning design with business goals and technology innovation, influencing product roadmaps at the executive level and inspiring teams to deliver world\-class, user\-centered experiences.

 This role requires a strategic mindset, strong leadership, deep Web3 and crypto UX expertise, and the ability to operate seamlessly across product, engineering, marketing, and business teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead long\-term UX planning across 1inch products, defining a multi\-year design direction while delivering fast, incremental improvements that balance innovation, scalability, and reliable execution
* Own UX readiness for product launches, ensuring validated end\-to\-end user flows are delivered ahead of engineering milestones and late\-stage UX changes are minimized
* Ensure a cohesive, user\-centric product experience at scale through strong design system adoption
* Oversee the evolution of the design system, brand consistency, and accessibility standards across all platforms
* Manage and grow a team of Product Designers, including hiring, mentorship, performance management, and long\-term career development


**Requirements**
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in UX/UI/Product Design leadership roles, ideally in crypto, fintech, or complex tech ecosystems
* Proven track record of managing and scaling design teams delivering cross\-platform products (web, iOS, Android)
* Proven ownership of design systems and scalable UX foundations across multiple products
* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable business outcomes (conversion, retention, revenue) through design
* Deep understanding of UX principles, interaction design, accessibility, and branding within blockchain/Web3 context
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to balance visionary leadership and operational execution
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills for diverse audiences, including executives and technical teams
* Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken), with the ability to clearly articulate complex design concepts to executive and technical audiences


**Nice to Have**
* Background in cryptocurrency DeFi and blockchain ecosystems
* UX or product design certifications (e.g. Nielsen Norman Group) are a plus


**Why work for us?**
* Join a young, creative team in a fast\-paced and supportive environment
* We’re open to new ideas — if you’ve got a vision, pitch it and make it happen
* Enjoy competitive pay that matches your skills and experience
* Be part of a company that’s shaping the future of DeFi
* Take time when you need it — we offer unlimited vacation days
* Get fully compensated for your work gear — we’ll set you up for success

data.jd_text:
We are a crypto\-native investment fund at the frontier of Decentralized Finance (DeFi). As we deploy capital into the most innovative protocols and infrastructure projects, we are seeking a
 **Head of Legal** 
 to architect our global fund structures and navigate the rapidly evolving intersection of traditional finance and blockchain technology.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Lead the legal design and maintenance of investment vehicles across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring they are optimized for crypto\-native institutional and retail participation.
* Develop and oversee a robust compliance framework that addresses AML/KYC requirements, securities laws, and evolving regulatory mandates in key global markets.
* Manage the legal lifecycle of deal flows, from reviewing SAFEs/SAFTs and token purchase agreements to overseeing complex DeFi\-native investment strategies.
* Act as the primary point of contact for regulators and external counsel, staying ahead of legislative changes that impact DeFi and digital asset management.
* Establish internal legal protocols for treasury management, employee incentive schemes (token options), and corporate governance.


**Who You Are**
* You have extensive experience in high\-level investment management and understand how to bridge the gap between "Code is Law" and traditional legal frameworks.
* You don't just understand law; you understand smart contracts, liquidity pools, and the unique legal challenges of non\-custodial investment strategies.
* You are comfortable making high\-stakes decisions in "grey" regulatory areas, providing clear, actionable advice rather than just listing risks.
* You are adept at managing a network of international law firms to ensure seamless operations across different regulatory regimes.


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of legal experience, with a significant portion spent in Investment Management (Hedge Funds, PE, or VC).
* Proven track record in a Senior Legal role within the crypto/Web3 sector.
* Deep knowledge of global securities laws and the regulatory landscape for DeFi.
* Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent law degree and active bar membership in good standing.
* Experience with cross\-border tax structuring and offshore fund jurisdictions (e.g., Cayman, BVI, Singapore, etc.).

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




 The Landmark Group began its journey in 1973 with one store in Bahrain and has grown into one of the largest retail and hospitality conglomerates in the Middle East, Africa, and India. Currently, the Group operates over 2,200 outlets, encompassing over 30 million square feet across 21 countries.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 A career in our Forensics team offers the opportunity to help identify vulnerabilities and develop strategies to manage the identified fraud risks. We work to prevent, respond to, and remediate a wide range of business threats, risks, and complex issues. The primary purpose of this role is to support the organization in identifying, investigating, and mitigating financial fraud and other irregularities. This role plays a critical part in identifying vulnerabilities within the organization, developing risk management strategies, and ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations, while consistently reflecting Landmark’s core values: LEAD with integrity\- Listen, Empower, Adapt, and Deliver.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Forensic reviews** 



* Managing complex fraud investigation across Landmark Group.
* Conduct investigations of suspected/ alleged frauds as per standard investigation methodologies.
* Work closely with Senior Manager in undertaking investigations to gather forensic evidence, conduct data analytics, in\-depth reviews, and produce investigative findings.
* Maintain continuous and close collaboration with other team members to ensure seamless and effective communication/ inputs throughout all phases of the projects.
* Manage outsourced business partners by directing, supervising, and reviewing investigations undertaken by them, including validation of findings and reporting quality.
* Assisting General Manager and Head \- Forensics in undertaking interviews by preparing Interview strategies, Interview files, etc.
* Prepare detailed investigation reports, Senior Management Updates, Audit Committee Presentations \- outlining findings, conclusions, and remedial action plan.



**Risk assessments and mitigation** 



* Identify vulnerabilities that created fraud opportunities within the organization.
* Undertake proactive risk assessments, process reviews, and develop strategies to mitigate identified risks.
* Develop and implement strategies to mitigate the identified risks and prevent future occurrences.



**Dispute assistance** 



* Work closely with the Business and other teams to take appropriate actions on identified fraud cases.
* Collaborate with legal teams and external advisors to resolve disputes efficiently and effectively.



**Culture building** 



* Fostering ethical culture within the organization by assisting General Manager and Head \- Forensics in providing training, conducting workshops, Townhalls and roadshows.



**Technology expertise** 



* Demonstrate proficiency in leading forensic eDiscovery tools such as Intella, Relativity, or other industry\-standard software.
* Demonstrate the ability to review and analyze complex data, including proficiency in data analytics applications such as MS Excel, MS Access, and IDEA.
* Knowledge of statistical platforms such as Python, R, SAS would be an added advantage.
* Utilize the tools to conduct forensic audits and proactive fraud reviews, tailored to specific case requirements.



**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong academic record, including a degree and a relevant accounting qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA.
* Post qualification experience of 8\+ years in Forensics Investigations Line of Services.
* Investigation experience of retail industry would be an added advantage.
* Experience with a Big 4 accounting firm.
* Experience in effectively managing complex investigations.
* Fluent English communication skills.
* Effective presentation skills.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Investigative mindset: Professionally skeptical attitude to identify and spot documents and statements for alteration, concealment, forgery, etc.
* Communication skills: Strong interpersonal and communication (verbal and written) skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: Data analytics skills and knowledge of advanced data analytical tools will be an advantage.
* Team player: Ability to collaborate and work well in a team.
* Ability to work under pressure: Stringent deadlines may demand extended working hours and might require travel.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Investigation experience of retail industry would be an added advantage.
* Experience with a Big 4 accounting firm.
