data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**الهدف العام**
 المساهمة الفاعلة في رفع كفاءة وفاعلية تنفيذ مشاريع الدائرة ضمن نطاق الاختصاص الوظيفي، من خلال تطوير وتطبيق الأطر والمنهجيات المعتمدة لإدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة التخطيط والتنفيذ الفعّال لها، وربطها بمؤشرات أداء كمية ونوعية لقياس مستوى التقدم وجودة التنفيذ، والمساهمة في إدارة محفظة المشاريع وتحليل أولوياتها والعوائد المتحققة منها، وتقديم الدعم الفني والاستشاري لمتخذي القرار ومسؤولي المشاريع في مجالات إدارة الموارد والمخاطر والتغيير المؤسسي، بما يضمن تكامل المبادرات، وكفاءة التنفيذ، والالتزام بالتشريعات والسياسات المعتمدة، وتحقيق الاتساق مع الخطط التشغيلية والتوجهات العامة والاستراتيجية للدائرة وحكومة دبي
   

  

**المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية**
* الإشراف والمتابعة الفنية على برامج ومشاريع الدائرة ضمن نطاق الاختصاص الوظيفي من خلال وضع الأطر والمنهجيات التي تضمن تحقيق الأهداف الاستراتيجية في مجالات التحول الرقمي، والأنظمة المالية المركزية، واستدامة المشاريع الحكومية ذات الصلة
* الإشراف الفني على فرق عمل المشاريع في مكتب ادارة المشاريع ومتابعة تنفيذ الخطط التشغيلية والموازنات، وضمان الانسيابية في التطبيق بين المشاريع والبرامج المختلفة على مستوى الدائرة
* تقديم الدعم الفني والاستشاري للرئيس المباشر في كافة الجوانب المرتبطة بالتخطيط الاستراتيجي واتخاذ القرارات المتعلقة بالمشاريع الكبرى
* إدارة محفظة المشاريع (Project Portfolio Management) وتحديد أولوياتها بناء على العائد المؤسسي وموائمتها مع الرؤية الاستراتيجية للدائرة واستراتيجية حكومة دبي المرتبطة بهذا الشأن
* تقييم أداء المشاريع الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية من خلال مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) وتحليل الانحرافات، وتقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة العليا تتضمن التوصيات اللازمة للتحسين
* الإشراف الفني المباشر على تطوير سياسات وأدلة إدارة المشاريع وتحديثها بالتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية، بما يتماشى مع أفضل الممارسات العالمية مثل PMI و PMO و COBIT و ITIL
* المشاركة الفاعلة في إعداد دراسات الجدوى الشاملة للمبادرات والمشاريع الجديدة ذات الطابع الاستراتيجي، وتقييم عوائدها (ROI) المالية والفنية، ورفع التوصيات للرئيس المباشر
* الإشراف على إعداد طلبات العروض والمناقصات (RFPs) وضمان مواءمتها مع السياسات المعتمدة، وتوجيه مدراء المشاريع خلال المراحل المختلفة من الطرح حتى الترسية
* تمثيل الإدارة في اللجان الفنية والاستراتيجية المشتركة مع الجهات الحكومية والخاصة، لضمان التكامل بين المبادرات التقنية والمالية على مستوى حكومة دبي
* قيادة عمليات التغيير المؤسسي وإدارة المخاطر على مستوى البرامج لضمان تحقيق أعلى مستويات الكفاءة والحوكمة في تنفيذ المشاريع
* توجيه فرق العمل متعددة التخصصات (Cross\-Functional Teams) في إدارة المشاريع المشتركة بين القطاعات الداخلية والخارجية، وتفعيل التواصل الفعّال بين أصحاب المصلحة
* العمل وبشكل مستمر على بناء وتطوير قدرات مدراء المشاريع والفِرق التنفيذية من خلال التدريب والإرشاد وضمان نقل المعرفة واستدامتها داخل الإدارة
* متابعة وتقييم أداء الموردين والاستشاريين وضمان الالتزام بشروط العقود والمخرجات الفنية المعتمدة ضمن الأطر الزمنية المحددة
* إعداد التقارير الاستراتيجية للإدارة العليا واللجان التنفيذية حول حالة المشاريع، والعقبات، والمخاطر، والتوصيات الخاصة بتسريع الإنجاز وتحسين الأداء المؤسسي
* الإشراف على تنفيذ مبادرات التحول الرقمي في إدارة المشاريع لضمان توافقها مع متطلبات النضج الرقمي الحكومي (Digital Maturity Framework) بهذا الشأن
* تمثيل الإدارة في الاجتماعات الفنية والمراجعات الاستراتيجية الخاصة بمشاريع الأنظمة المالية، واقتراح الحلول المبتكرة لتحسين الكفاءة التشغيلية
* اقتراح واعتماد الأدوات التقنية والمنهجيات الحديثة الداعمة لعمليات إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، بما في ذلك أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليل التنبئي لمؤشرات الأداء
* المساهمة الفاعلة في ضمان التكامل بين إدارة المشاريع والقطاعات الأخرى (المالية، التقنية، التخطيط، الذكاء الاصطناعي، البيانات)، بما يعزز من فعالية منظومة المشاريع الحكومية
* لمتابعة المستمرة لأحدث التوجهات والممارسات العالمية في إدارة البرامج والمشاريع، واقتراح مبادرات تطويرية لتحسين الإجراءات، ورفع تقارير دورية عن تقدم سير العمل، والإنجازات المحققة، والتحديات، وآليات المعالجة المعتمدة
* تأدية أية مهام أو واجبات أخرى تتعلق بطبيعة العمل حسب التكليف

data.jd_text:
**About Revolut** 




  





 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70\+ million customers get more from their money every day.
 



  





 As we continue our lightning\-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000\+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
 



 We're looking for a Technology Manager to focus on technology operations, risk management and resilience, and regulatory readiness.
 



  





 You'll work closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Compliance teams, as well as local regulators, to ensure our platforms operate in line with regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with group standards.
 



  





 Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 




  




* Coordinating UAE infrastructure and network workstreams, such as network connectivity, cloud environments, access patterns, resiliency, and operational readiness
* Supporting the Head of Technology in driving the local data localisation programme
* Partnering with Group DevOps, Network, and product engineering teams to translate UAE requirements into actionable technology tasks
* Running operational governance, including incident management coordination, problem management, change/release controls, service reviews, SLA tracking, and post\-incident actions
* Ensuring regulatory compliance with technology control requirements
* Managing technology risk and compliance execution for infrastructure controls (evidence collection, control tracking, remediation follow\-ups) with Group InfoSec GRC
* Providing technology\-related updates to stakeholders, including risks, decisions required, and timelines
* Identifying technology\-related dependencies, potential impact, and risks, ensuring that they've been satisfactorily analysed, tested, and managed, and escalating risks to internal stakeholders
* Driving continuous improvement post\-launch, including recurring service reviews, incident action tracking, and removal of cross\-region dependencies where they create risk



  





**What you'll need** 




  




* 4\+ years of experience in tech risk, operational resilience, IT project delivery, IT governance, or tech architecture, within financial services, fintech, or a consultancy serving these industries
* An understanding of UAE payment rails and integrations (e.g., card schemes, domestic switches, bank transfers, acquiring networks) and the typical technology dependencies
* Project management and IT project delivery experience
* Experience working in regulated environments, including interacting with regulators, auditors, or supervisory bodies in the UAE
* Knowledge of technology controls across infrastructure, applications, data, security, and third\-party services, and how those controls operate in practice
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and people\-management skills
* A basic understanding of AWS/GCP, networking fundamentals, and SDLC, with the ability to review designs, spot gaps, and drive implementation via Group teams
* Great problem\-solving and decision\-making skills to analyse complex information and identify the key issue/action to drive resolutions
* Exceptional organisational and time management skills
* Fluency in English



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Expertise in AWS and/or GCP (common architecture patterns, core services, and operational trade\-offs) to accelerate design reviews and stakeholder discussions
* Experience in a solution or technical architect role, with an ability to review designs, identify gaps, and influence delivery across engineering teams
* To be comfortable with tooling for delivery and reporting, such as Jira/Confluence, dashboards, and basic SQL queries



  





*Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D\&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard\-working team.* 




  





***Important notice for candidates:***




*Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.* 




*•* 
***Only apply through official Revolut channels.***
*We don’t use any third\-party services or platforms for our recruitment.* 




*•* 
***Always double\-check the emails you receive.***
*Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.* 




***We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.***
*If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.* 




  





*By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice*

data.jd_text:
**Network Director – Global Payments Infrastructure**
**About Thunes**
 Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real\-time in over 130 countries and more than 80 currencies.
   

  

 Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 7 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M\-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.
   

  

 Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super\-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks. Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in\-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection and cost efficiencies when making real\-time payments globally.
   

  

 Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 12 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco, Sao Paulo and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/
   

  

**Context of the role**
 We are looking for a Network Director to lead the development and management of global banking and payment scheme partnerships to strengthen our business payments offering. This role balances strategic expansion with the operational rigor required to deliver critical payments priorities. You will be responsible for driving cross\-functional collaboration and serving as the Network liaison between internal teams and external network partners.
   

  

**Network Strategy \& Development**
* Define \& Execute Roadmap: Deliver the global strategy for banking and payment scheme partnerships, expanding direct access to SEPA, Faster Payments, and emerging real\-time rails in close partnership with regional network teams.
* Scale Connectivity: Drive prioritisation and execution of infrastructure initiatives for virtual accounts, local clearing, and SWIFT integration to strengthen cross\-border payment corridors.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Delivery**
* Business Payments Representation: Represent Network as a senior lead across all business payments strategic forums, ensuring network roadmap alignment with commercial ambitions.
* Cross\-Functional Orchestration: Partner with Product, Treasury, Legal \& Compliance, and Commercial teams to align network capabilities with customer needs and cross\-functional requirements.
* Reporting \& Governance: Own program governance and reporting, providing internal stakeholders with clear visibility into delivery progress, risks, and dependencies.


**Network Operations \& Excellence**
* Quality of Service (QoS): Define and monitor critical performance KPIs (latency, throughput, and success rates). Lead network performance optimization and remediation efforts.
* Outage Management: Lead impact analysis of network disruptions to identify priority areas. Manage critical communications with network partners, drive root cause analysis (RCA) processes, and implement systemic changes to prevent recurrence.
* Credit Terms Management: Partner with Treasury \& regional teams to identify key corridors to negotiate favorable credit terms and post\-funding arrangements with network partners.
* Cost \& Efficiency: Drive continuous improvements in FX competitiveness, settlement speed, and overall network unit costs.


**Professional Experience \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 9\+ years in financial services, payments, or fintech with deep expertise in global payments infrastructure. Leadership \& Execution: Exceptional project management and negotiation skills. Ability to lead multiple, high\-impact initiatives across cross\-functional teams.
* Strategic Problem Solving: A data\-driven mindset with a track record of solving complex cross\-border operational and commercial challenges.
* Operational Excellence: Skilled in managing network quality, outage responses, and liquidity/credit terms.
* Interpersonal: Strong stakeholder management, with the communication skills necessary to bridge technical and commercial objectives.
* Hands\-on approach: Whilst this is a senior position we expect the person taking this role to be willing to roll\-up their sleeves and get involved in the detail
* Fluency in English, both verbal and written

Description du poste :
   

  

 Keolis, groupe international majeur dans le secteur de la mobilité et des transports publics, renforce son implantation au Moyen\-Orient.
   

 Dans le cadre de ses projets de développement notamment dans le ferroviaire, nous souhaitons structurer et professionnaliser davantage la maintenance de l'infrastructure et la gestion des circulations.
   

 Dans ce contexte, nous créons un poste de Chief operating Officer, qui pourra prendre la Direction Générale d'entités dédiée à l'exploitation et à la maintenance de l'infrastructure ferroviaire (à terme plus de 500 collaborateurs)
   

  

 Dans un premier temps, le/la titulaire exercera les fonctions de \*\*Chief Operating Officer\*\* en charge de définir la stratégie et la mise en œuvre d'activités de maintenance des infrastructures et de gestion des circulations.
   

 Le poste est basé aux Emirats et reporte au \*\*CEO Middle East \& Eastern Asia\*\* du groupe.
   

  

 Missions générales
   

 \* Définir la stratégie
   

 \* Mettre en place une organisation efficiente, clarifier les rôles, processus et responsabilités.
   

 \* Accompagner la conduite du changement et de reprise d'activités
   

 \* Accompagner les transformations culturelles et managériales
   

 \* Management des opérations ferroviaires : Superviser la maintenance de l'infrastructure (voies, ouvrages d'art, signalisation, systèmes, etc.) ; encadrer la gestion des circulations (exploitation, régulation, sécurité), structurer la montée en puissance du réseau
   

 \* Garantir le plus haut niveau d'exigence en matière de sécurité ferroviaire.
   

 \* Veiller au respect des standards contractuels et réglementaires
   

  

 Description du profil :
   

  

 \* Expérience confirmée (10\-15 ans minimum) dans le secteur ferroviaire, avec impérativement une dimension exploitation et maintenance d'infrastructures.
   

 \* Expérience significative de direction de site, de BU ou de filiale avec P\&L, idéalement dans un contexte international.
   

 \* Solide culture sécurité, performance opérationnelle et gestion du changement.
   

 \* Leadership reconnu, capacité à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires et multiculturelles.
   

 \* Anglais courant impératif (oral et écrit). La maîtrise du français est un plus, ainsi que toute autre langue régionale.

 Si votre poste est en lien direct avec la sécurité des personnes et des biens vous serez susceptible de faire l'objet d'une enquête administrative.

**The Role** 




 The CFO will build and lead the finance function of ALPHA10X at a critical stage of growth. This is a hands\-on and strategic role for a high\-calibre finance leader who combines strong accounting and controlling fundamentals with private markets capital raise credibility, planning discipline, and commercial judgment. The CFO will own the financial architecture of the business: reporting, controls, forecasting, liquidity, investor readiness, capital raise support, and financial decision\-making. The role requires someone capable of operating in a fast\-moving, multinational environment with high standards of precision, pace, and communication.
 



  





**Core Mandate** 



* Establish robust accounting, controlling, and reporting infrastructure.
* Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and modelling.

**Key Responsibilities** 




 Accounting, Reporting, and Controlling
 


* Build and oversee a rigorous finance / accounting function across a multinational structure.
* Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual close.
* Own financial reporting, reconciliations, controls, and management accounts.
* Coordinate external accountants, auditors, tax advisors, banks, and legal counsel.
* Ensure compliance across jurisdictions and maintain audit readiness.



  





**FP\&A, Business Planning, and Modelling** 



* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long\-range financial planning.
* Develop and maintain operating and financial models with scenario analysis.
* Build KPI frameworks and performance dashboards across the business.
* Translate strategy into operating plans and capital requirements.
* Provide financial analysis to support decision\-making.



  





**Capital Raise and Investor Readiness** 



* Support the CEO in executing equity and debt financing processes.
* Prepare investor reporting, board materials, and diligence documentation.
* Own the financial data room and ensure alignment of numbers and assumptions.
* Support capital structure analysis and financing strategy.



  





**Cash Flow and Financial Discipline** 



* Maintain oversight of liquidity, runway, and working capital.
* Improve financial visibility and operating discipline across the company.
* Ensure robust forecasting accuracy and spend discipline.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* 5—10 years of senior finance experience.
* Strong background in accounting, financial control, and reporting.
* Strong experience in FP\&A, business planning, forecasting, and modelling.
* Experience operating in a multi\-entity, multinational environment.
* Experience supporting or leading capital raises and investor reporting.
* Professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or CA preferred.



  





**Skills and Personal Attributes** 



* Exceptional command of written and spoken French (in addition to English).
* Strong executive presence with investors and board members.
* High analytical capability and attention to detail.
* Strong commercial judgment and strategic thinking.
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced entrepreneurial environment.



  





**What success looks like** 



* Finance infrastructure that is accurate, scalable, and investor\-grade.
* Timely and credible financial reporting.
* Robust financial models and planning processes supporting management decisions.
* Strong investor readiness and capital formation capability.
* Improved financial visibility, discipline, and governance.

 We are partnering with a globally recognised luxury beauty and consumer brand in the appointment of a Chief Financial Officer, based in Dubai.
 



 This is a pivotal leadership role with full financial ownership across the Middle East region. As such, this role requires a highly commercial and forward\-thinking finance leader capable of influencing at the highest level while maintaining rigorous financial discipline.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Chief Financial Officer will be responsible for leading and developing the regional finance function, ensuring robust financial planning, reporting, governance, and control across all markets.
 



 You will play a central role in shaping business strategy, providing financial insight to support decision\-making, and driving performance across retail, distribution, and commercial operations. The role requires a balance of strategic thinking and operational execution, with a strong emphasis on business partnering and value creation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Leadership \& Business Partnering** 



* Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO and regional leadership team, contributing to overall business strategy and decision\-making
* Translate commercial strategy into financial plans, ensuring alignment between growth objectives and financial performance
* Provide clear, data\-driven insights to support key business decisions, including investments, pricing strategies, and market expansion
* Support the development of long\-term strategic plans, including scenario modelling and risk assessment



**Financial Planning \& Performance Management** 



* Lead the annual budgeting process, rolling forecasts, and long\-term financial planning
* Drive performance analysis across markets, channels, and categories, identifying risks and opportunities
* Establish and monitor key financial and operational KPIs to track business performance
* Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting in line with group standards and local regulatory requirements



**Governance, Controls \& Compliance** 



* Implement and maintain robust financial controls, policies, and procedures across all operating entities
* Ensure full compliance with local regulations, tax requirements, and internal governance frameworks
* Oversee internal and external audit processes, ensuring transparency and accountability
* Manage financial risk, including currency exposure, credit risk, and regulatory changes



**Commercial \& Operational Finance** 



* Partner closely with retail, commercial, and operations teams to drive profitability and operational efficiency
* Support pricing strategies, margin optimisation, and cost control initiatives
* Provide financial leadership on key projects, including store openings, refurbishments, and new market entry
* Drive continuous improvement across finance processes, systems, and reporting capabilities



**Cash Flow, Working Capital \& Investment** 



* Optimise working capital across the region, including inventory, receivables, and payables
* Oversee cash flow planning and treasury activities, ensuring effective liquidity management
* Evaluate capital investment opportunities and support business cases for growth initiatives
* Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions



**Transformation \& Change Management** 



* Lead or support finance transformation initiatives, including system implementation, process improvement, and organisational development
* Drive a culture of performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the finance function
* Support broader business transformation initiatives across the region



**Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing regional finance team
* Establish clear structures, roles, and succession plans across the function
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture aligned with company values
* Develop talent and capabilities to support future growth



**Candidate Profile** 



* Proven experience as a CFO, Finance Director, or equivalent senior finance leadership role within a luxury beauty, retail, or consumer\-led organisation
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business performance
* Experience managing multi\-country operations, ideally across the Middle East region
* Deep understanding of financial planning, reporting, and governance within a complex, international business
* Demonstrated track record of driving transformation, improving processes, and delivering measurable business impact
* Experience operating within a matrix organisation and working with global finance teams
* Strong leadership skills with experience building and developing high\-performing teams
* Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; professional qualifications (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent) preferred



**Personal Attributes** 



* Strategic thinker with a hands\-on approach
* Highly analytical with strong problem\-solving capabilities
* Confident communicator with the ability to influence at executive level
* Resilient and adaptable in a fast\-paced, evolving environment
* High level of integrity and professional judgment



**Additional Information** 




 This is a high\-impact role offering the opportunity to play a key part in shaping the future of a leading brand within the region.
 



**We will only respond to those who meet the required criteria.**

data.jd_text:
**The AI\-powered OS** 
**for beauty,**
**wellness** 
**and self\-care**
**About Fresha**
 Fresha is the AI\-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self\-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
   

  

 Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000\+ businesses and 450,000\+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
   

  

 Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all\-in\-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
   

  

 Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point\-of\-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
   

  

 The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for an outstanding General Manager to take full ownership of our MEA business which is one of the most exciting and commercially important regions at Fresha. This is a senior leadership role where you’ll be trusted to shape strategy, drive performance and lead a growing team to new levels of success.
   

  

 You’ll report directly to the CEO and work closely with senior leaders across the company. From setting the commercial vision to executing day\-to\-day operations, you’ll be at the centre of it all \- accountable for delivering results and building a high\-performing, highly motivated team.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who thrives on both strategy and execution. You’ll bring structure, pace and clarity, create a culture built on ownership and high standards, and lead with energy, purpose and visibility. If you’re ready to take on a true leadership challenge in a fast\-scaling tech business, this is your opportunity.
   

  

**Sales Leadership and Culture Building**
* Lead a high\-performing MEA Business Development and Account Management team
* Build an elite sales culture grounded in ownership, accountability and performance
* Establish clear team rituals that drive motivation and consistency


**Team Structuring and Scaling**
* Design and scale the MEA commercial team structure, including hiring and managing through managers
* Implement performance frameworks, operating rhythms, and clear accountability measures
* Create conditions for others to lead and grow, rather than relying solely on ICs


**Commercial Strategy and Execution**
* Define and execute the go\-to\-market strategy for the MEA, aligned with company priorities
* Act on market feedback and business performance to adjust plans and identify opportunities
* Own the sales funnel from prospecting through activation and retention, using tools like HubSpot to manage forecasting and pipeline


**Stakeholder Management and Influence**
* Act as the voice of the MEA region within the business, ensuring local context is well understood
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to shape campaigns, products and initiatives that drive partner success
* Communicate with clarity, challenge constructively and lead through authenticity


**Hands\-On Leadership**
* Lead from the front: join calls, support negotiations, and coach team members through challenges
* Set a tone of urgency, high standards, and practical support — visible, approachable and grounded in action
* Celebrate wins, course\-correct when needed, and hold the team to high expectations


**What We're Looking For**
* Senior leadership experience within a SaaS, marketplace or technology business
* Proven track record of managing and scaling commercial teams, including managing through managers
* Experience leading sales and account management functions in SMB\-focused environments
* Skilled at using performance data to guide decisions, track progress and motivate teams
* Structured and strategic, with the ability to balance long\-term planning and near\-term delivery
* Clear and direct communicator who leads with purpose and clarity
* Comfortable being hands\-on — from coaching teams to joining partner calls when needed
* Embraces a “work hard, play hard” environment with high expectations and strong team spirit


**Interview Process**
* Screen Call \- Video\-call with Talent Team (30 \- 45 mins)
* 1st Stage \- Video\-call with VP of Revenue Operations (45 mins)
* 2nd Stage \- Video\-call presentation with Leadership team (90 mins)
* Final Stage \- Video Call with C\-Suite


 We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 4 weeks
   

  

 Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe
   

  

**Inclusive workforce**
 At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
   

  

 We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
   

  

 We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
   

  

 If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:**




 The Senior Conference Producer will be involved in the development and execution of their own events, to ensure each Strategic and Technical agenda meets dmg’s market leading global standards.
 



  





 Working as part of the global dmg Education team, which comprises of conferences, exhibitions and online products, you will be involved in all aspects of the strategy and execution of your conferences, including support on commercial structure, identifying sponsors, partners, potential hosts, as well as programme creation and development, on\-site management and speaker liaison to ensure the successful smooth running of the conferences, and that exceptional service is delivered to our customers and clients.
 



  





 This role is key to the success of the growth and development of our business, it is heavily focussed on year\-round content and the programme development of our global conferences but also covers other areas of conference management. Working alongside commercial, marketing, PR, data \& digital, operations teams, you will report directly to the VP for Asia, working on a major new business launch that will become an international large\-scale event.
 



  





 This is an exciting and highly varied role that will demand intellectual autonomy, creativity and an ability to think beyond the standard commercial conference ‘conveyor belt’ production cycle. The primary aim will be to help dmg create a long\-term reputation for excellence in the Asian Education market, driving forwards our ambitions to be the most respected provider of Education conferences in the world.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




**Conference Production and Content Strategy**



* Support and manage the strategic conference, from research through to onsite delivery.
* Conduct in\-depth research with senior global public and private sector stakeholders to create compelling programmes at the highest level of commercial viability for both sponsorship and delegate sales.
* Source, qualify and liaise with the Conference Chair/s, Knowledge Partners and Steering Committee members to determine a strategic plan for conference themes, topics, session chairs, and optimum speakers.
* Recruit highly esteemed leading experts, industry representatives, regulators, government representatives, and other relevant speakers to the programme faculty.
* Manage the technical call for papers process, creating topics and managing the execution and delivery of targets with technical committee members and internal teams.
* Work closely with the Marketing team to develop digital content\-marketing campaign ideas.
* Support the VP with content strategy.
* Work with the Event Director to target key industry stakeholders, including Ministers, IOCs, IECs, NOCs, Global Leaders, to positively influence them regarding the value / positioning of our events.
* Assist in the development of effective mailing lists by contacting people both inside and outside the company who have access to the names of potential delegates, and ensure such information is communicated to the marketing team.



**Conference Project Management**



* Establish key relationships with partners and industry stakeholders, develop content strategies in accordance which our partners’ objectives.
* Develop current and prospective customer insights and relationships as part of the overall account management strategy for each event.
* Key account management and customer relationship development, to grow and establish each event as a leading brand.
* Use your industry expertise, industry relationships and Steering Committees to shape our marketing content messaging, brand marketing \& positioning and generate press releases.
* Maintain close links with management to ensure that they are constantly aware of the status of events through weekly reports.



**Product Delivery and Management**



* Conduct telephone and in\-person research with potential attendees within the target market for each event to develop programme agendas.
* Join sales calls and meetings with existing and potential clients to commercially contribute to the growth of the portfolio and find new market opportunities for speakers, moderators, partners.
* Recruit highly esteemed leading experts, industry representatives, regulators, government representatives, and other relevant speakers to your programme faculty.
* Assist in the maintenance of constant, correct and timely liaison with speakers throughout the duration of the event \- onsite conference fulfilment.
* Research and provide strategic information required to market/promote each conference.
* Assist with queries from potential delegates and assist in adopting positive actions to help sell delegate places and sponsorship.
* Work closely with the operations team to ensure delivery of a first\-class onsite conference experience for attendees.



**dmg Asia Portfolio Support**



* Ensure content and associated narrative alignment between Asia’s portfolio and dmg’s flagship events.
* Create a playbook for managing the technical call for papers process across the portfolio, creating topics and managing the execution and delivery of targets with technical committee members and internal teams.
* Prepare speaker liaison playbook to ensure all speaker preparation and requirements are taken care of.
* Work closely with the operations team to ensure delivery of a first\-class onsite conference experience for attendees for all shows.
* Attend conferences to promote Asia’s portfolio, gather market intelligence, as well as network with potential speakers and delegates to establish and maintain relationships pre\- and post\- conference.



**Job Context:**




**Relationships \- Internal:** 




 • Will report to the senior management on day\-to\-day issues.
 



 • Senior management – contact with VP and Event Director to ensure content strategies are fully integrated and all respective staff are aware of processes.
 



 • All internal functions Commercial, Data \& Digital, Marketing \& PR, HR, Finance and Operations.
 



**Relationships \- External:** 




 • Education value chain.
 



 • Event hosts when applicable.
 



 • Senior individuals/C\-suite professionals on Governing Bodies.
 



 • Associations \- Industry and Sector specific.
 



 • Knowledge Partners.
 



 • Steering Committees.
 



 • International government representatives.
 



 • Trade ambassadors.
 



**Qualifications, Experience, \& Skills:**




  





 • Passionate, dedicated, and knowledgeable about developing smart, profitable, and industry\-leading conferences and with a proven and comprehensive experience of applying efficient and effective processes to your own successful conference portfolio.
 



 • You will demonstrate the ability to simultaneously manage a portfolio of international event products.
 



 • You will show how you are able to create leading\-edge marketing and sales campaigns.
 



**Skills and Behavioural Competencies**




 • Minimum 5 \- 7 years conference production experience.
 



 • Excellent networking and information gathering abilities.
 



 • Engaging, professional and diplomatic demeanour.
 



 • Comfortable conducting regular phone calls and meetings with a range of senior industry figures.
 



 • Strong teamwork skills to ensure the efficient running of content team.
 



 • Self\-disciplined and able to work both independently and as part of a team.
 



 • Problem solver with the ability to break down complex concepts, make logical comparisons, and identify underlying patterns and connections.
 



 • Agile learner with the ability to develop in\-depth technical knowledge on diverse topics and an understanding of key commercial drivers underlying your products.
 



 • Resilient, with a strong desire to succeed.
 



 • Experience in the Education industry is a strong asset.
 



 You should be open to international travel, as required by the job role.
 



**dmg events is an equal opportunity employer. If you have not had feedback from us within 14 days, please consider your application as unsuccessful for this round.**

As the Operations Support Executive at the Regional Office, you provide administrative and coordination support to the Chief Operating Officer and Vice President – Operations. The role focuses on supporting operational communication, travel coordination, reporting preparation, tracker management, and general administrative activities for the regional office.
   

  

 You ensure efficient coordination between the regional office and hotel teams, helping facilitate operational follow\-ups, document preparation, deadline tracking, and logistics required for day\-to\-day business activities. The role also supports the consolidation of operational updates across hotel reviews, owner matters, audits, openings, and key operational meetings.
   

  

**Key Role Responsibilities**
* Provide administrative support to the COO and VP – Operations including calendar coordination, document preparation, meeting scheduling, and correspondence.
* Coordinate operational communication, updates, follow\-ups, and action items between the regional office, hotel General Managers, owners, and relevant stakeholders, ensuring timely execution and proper documentation where required.
* Support the preparation and formatting of operational reports, presentations, meeting materials, minutes, owner meeting documents, business review packs, and operational summaries.
* Maintain organized documentation and records related to operational communications, approvals, action logs, and follow\-up records.
* Consolidate updates related to hotel reviews, owner matters, audits, openings, and operational meetings for leadership review.
* Maintain and regularly update operational trackers, action logs, and follow\-up records, ensuring information is accurate, current, and properly organized.
* Monitor deadlines and proactively follow up with hotels and internal departments to obtain pending inputs, updates, and required documentation on time.
* Track outstanding actions and ensure timely closure of operational follow\-ups across properties and functions.
* Escalate overdue items, delays, or missing inputs to the COO and VP – Operations where required.
* Manage travel arrangements for corporate executives, including flights, accommodation, and transportation.
* Coordinate travel schedules for hotel visits, operational meetings, and regional reviews.
* Track travel plans, visit outcomes, and post\-visit follow\-up actions.
* Maintain travel documentation, itineraries, and expense tracking where required.
* Support communication between the regional office and hotel teams regarding operational updates, requests, and follow\-up requirements.
* Assist in drafting and distributing internal operational communications when required.
* Coordinate the flow of information between hotels and the regional office to ensure timely follow\-up on operational matters.
* Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure updates and requested inputs are submitted within agreed timelines.
* Assist in gathering operational data and preparing reports required by the COO and VP – Operations.
* Track operational updates, action items, deadlines, and follow\-ups from meetings, audits, hotel reviews, and property visits.
* Support the consolidation and preparation of operational summaries and supporting documents for leadership discussions and reviews.
* Maintain organized records of operational documentation and internal communications.
* Support operations teams with basic administrative tasks related to systems access requests, documentation, and coordination.
* Assist with maintaining records related to operational processes and reporting requirements.
* Provide general coordination support to help ensure continuity and efficiency across day\-to\-day operational administration.


**Candidate Requirements**
* 2–4 years of experience in operations coordination, executive support, or administrative support
* Previous experience supporting senior leaders such as COO, VP, Director, or General Manager
* Background in hospitality, hotels, or multi\-property operations is strongly preferred
* Strong ability to manage trackers, action logs, deadlines, and follow\-ups
* Confident preparing reports, presentations, meeting packs, and minutes
* Experience coordinating travel, hotel visits, meetings, and logistics
* Strong written and verbal English communication
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to follow up firmly and professionally
* Good working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook
* Able to handle confidential information and work in a fast\-paced regional office environment

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 To Direct, oversee and manage the delivery of construction projects (buildings and fit outs projects) of the group (new/ existing), ensuring completion of projects within the agreed specification/ quality standards, budgets and timelines.
 



  





**Essential Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Provides leadership and strategic guidance, and supporting the development of business strategies to deliver the required levels of productivity
* Contribute to the development of Project Management Department Strategy, in conjunction with Director, ensuring alignment to the objectives and strategy of the organization.
* Participate in the development, review and reporting of the policies and procedures framework (Audit, Document Control, Financial and Accounting, Design Compliance and Corporate Identity, QC, HSE) that allow the function to effectively meet its objectives and targets, in line with Project Management department policies and procedures in line with Group’s strategy and direction.
* Puts resource strategies in place and manages resource costs to overhead budgets.
* Review and report to Director on strategic decisions during the entire lifecycle of the projects.
* Contribute strategic support the group legal department in case of any necessity in terms of claim and disputes with consultants and contractors.
* Provide guidance to other internal business units and departments in terms of budget, timing and strategy throughout the project execution stage
* In conjunction with the other business units, develop a business plan setting out the strategies which will deliver the organizations longer\-term goals.
* Manage the design and project execution of projects with Al Tayer Real Estate, Al Tayer Motor and private projects getting developed by directors, by contracting external designers/consultants/contractors, finalize the same for implementation and ensure that the agreed design and project milestone deliverables are met in accordance with the project program.
* Implement approved procedures for tendering, selection and appointment of contractors, payment terms, dealings and communications between all parties in coordination with group legal functions.
* Implement internal processes and manage, to ensure that all contracts / agreements with contractors, suppliers and consultants are agreed, finalized and signed off before commencement of work, to avoid any legal dispute/claims etc. post execution.
* Oversee the development of project schedules, which include key project milestones and critical paths to ensure adherence and take corrective action as appropriate and work in consolidation with Operations, Business Units, and developer to accomplish its objectives within the constraints of time, quality and agreed cost.
* Liaise with Business units to understand the requirements and specifications of new projects and maintain an awareness of principle requirements in the design of the projects, ensuring they are considered in the execution stage.
* Review designs, recommend ideas/concepts to ensure that layouts effectively maximize functionality and aesthetic expectations of the projects by ensuring HSE compliance as per approved group policies.
* Oversee the Review and approve the drawings submitted by contractors and ensure that they are examined by all parties concerned.
* Manage the tender process effectively to ensure that all contractors, vendors, consultants selected are most capable of carrying out project requirements.
* Ensures that there are effective contract and documentation procedures in place to deliver legally complaint projects and minimize costs and risks.
* Ensure that CAPEX for all new projects are submitted to the business in a timely manner for review and approval.
* Monitors contractors’ work for compliance with schedule, budget, quality, safety, and overall conformance with the contract documents
* Owns the Health and Safety policy for Construction and puts processes and systems in place to monitor its compliance and share best practice.
* Oversee the changes process during project life cycle, which includes identifying, documenting, and controlling changes to the scope baseline, are validated and mechanism for the project management team to consistently communicate and seek approval of all changes from the stakeholders through set policies of using change control forms etc, is being adhered to.
* Identify possible risks for all upcoming and ongoing projects, ensure proactive risk plans to manage and mitigate risks and engage in a proactive communication strategy with clients and stakeholders. Puts in place effective risk management processes to identify, quantify, monitor and minimize risks in projects.
* Resolves field construction problems in coordination with engineering staff, third parties, and other agencies as necessary.
* Maintain updated projects matrix for current and upcoming projects based on agreed project master plan. Conduct quarterly audits on projects processes to ensure compliance and adherence to agreed policies and procedures.
* Identify opportunities to make use of external contractors and subcontractors, establish and maintain relationship with trusted organizations that meet the group requirements.
* Oversee the development of vendor and supplier list in database for the supply of right products for the projects.
* Oversee snagging and handover of projects by consultant and contractor to ensure the overall readiness of the project for commencement of business operations.
* To oversee the co\-ordination of the communication strategy within the project to ensure all stakeholders and interested concerned parties receive the information they want at the appropriate time.
* Establish a culture / process of value engineering within project team and look for more cost\-effective methods to achieve the same.
* Maintain an awareness of legislative and regulatory requirements and ensure conformance to all quality, health and safety regulations.
* Ensure effective and proper contract governance is implemented prior to project completion.
* Provide the director with advice and expertise on critical issues regarding the project, and implementation
* Liaises with the Finance Director to track the financial performance of Construction and ensures that Finance receive accurate information in a timely and organized manner
* Follow up and monitor the external governmental rules and regulations to ensure newly developing rules and regulations are well captured and implemented in projects
* Sets a culture of continuous improvement including the setup of processes and committees to learn and share best practice.
* Provide Leadership and direction to subordinate towards the achievement of goals and objectives.
* Guide and motivate subordinates to enhance performance and produce quality work, and ensure that they are continuously developed for higher level roles.
* Set targets, objectives and clear responsibilities for all supervised staff, progressively monitor individual performance against the agreed criteria and conduct formal appraisals in keeping with time frames
* Prepare performance evaluation and appraisal reports of direct reports to assess subordinates productivity and progress and identify training needs of team members to improve efficiency and ensure conformity with standard procedures and practices
* Provides mentoring support to direct team and other colleagues across the business in line with the succession plans



  





**Education, Skills and Experiences** 



* Degree in Civil Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification relevant to Construction Project Management.
* 15 years of experience in construction field

 **Senior Director Global Procurement**

 On the Indirect Procurement side, the role manages complex and fast\-evolving spend categories linked to brand development, global distribution, and digital operations, including logistics and freight, marketing and creative services, IT and digital solutions, CAPEX\-related sourcing, and professional services.

**Indirect Procurement**

* IT, digital, and software services
* CAPEX\-related sourcing
* Professional and consulting services

* Expertise in strategic sourcing, contracting, and digital tools

data.jd_text:
Drayton are thrilled to be partnering with a high growth, international ecommerce business in the appointment of a Finance Director. This role will be critical in shaping financial strategy, building scalable financial operations, and supporting the business through its exciting next phase of growth across multiple markets.
 



  





 In this role, responsibilities will include:
 


* Leading the overall financial strategy, planning and management of the business across brands and regions
* Partnering closely with the CEO, COO and senior leadership team to support growth, expansion and investment decisions
* Owning budgeting, forecasting and long term financial planning processes
* Delivering timely management reporting, financial analysis and commercial insight
* Overseeing accounting, financial reporting, audits, tax and statutory compliance across international operations
* Managing cashflow, treasury, banking relationships and funding arrangements
* Supporting ecommerce, operations and commercial teams with financial analysis across pricing, sourcing and inventory
* Building and leading a high performing finance team across multiple geographies



  





 Requirements for this role include:
 


* Fully qualified accountant status such as ACA, ACCA or CIMA
* Significant senior finance leadership experience within direct to consumer ecommerce businesses.
* Proven experience operating in high growth or entrepreneurial environments
* Strong technical finance capability across accounting, reporting and financial planning
* A commercially astute individual with a hands on and pragmatic approach



  





 The ideal profile will:
 


* Be a commercially driven finance leader who enjoys operating at both strategic and hands on levels
* Be comfortable building structure and scalable processes in a fast paced environment
* Demonstrate strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills
* Thrive in dynamic, evolving businesses with pace and ambition

We are currently seeking an experienced and talented
 **Project Director** 
 to join an award\-winning building and civil engineering company in Ireland.
 



  





 RIGHT TO WORK IN THE UNITED KINGDOM/IRELAND REQUIRED.
 



  





 Reporting to the Construction Director, the Project Director has overall responsibility for the management and onsite construction of a major/complex contract with value in excess of €100m. The Project Director will be responsible for managing the companies interests, risk \& delivery strategy on the contract to guide the project to Commercial success.
 



  





**REPORTING TO:** 
 Construction Director
 



**LOCATION:** 
 Clondalkin, Dublin
 



**CONTRACT TYPE:** 
 Full\-Time, Permanent
 



  





**Role Responsibilities** 




  




* Provide overall leadership and direction for the delivery of the development from mobilisation to completion.
* Agree commencement date, and arrange for completion of the contract documents
* Ensure that all aspects of quality, the Environment and progress are in accordance with the contracted requirements
* Assist in the selection and vetting of major S/Cs and suppliers (including HSEQS vetting)
* Agree employee resource plan with the Construction Director
* Responsible for setting the design strategy and scope of novated services (If part of project scope)
* Manage S/C including S/C progress meetings and S/C pre\-order meetings
* Manage employee resources, including cover for site when staff are on annual leave or training
* Chair Internal Team Meetings/attend and chair Subcontractor meetings
* Manage Prelims in accordance with PEP and prepare applications for extension of time with SQS/QS
* Review constructability and identify methods of execution with commercial or programme advantage where possible
* Monitor and assist planning team on overall site progress against programme (PEP). Agree programmes with subcontractors and monitor progress with the SM
* Monitor cost, risk, administrative procedures and company correspondence
* Lead the project team, supply chain principals and clients, in the relentless strive for Zero Incidents, Zero Injuries and quality standards.
* Communicate with senior leadership and advise the contract team of any potential legal, IR, safety, environmental, technical or construction items as required
* Monitor interim accounts and payments with Commercial Manager, progress and profitability of the contract and report with the contract team at the monthly cost meetings.
* Monitor with Commercial Manager Final Account and Loss and Expense negotiations. Apply cost\-benefit analysis to all activities, estimates and forecasts overall costs.
* Co\-ordinate the production of the monthly CVR reports, with the commercial and Design manager and prepare/advise on forward strategy.

* Ensure that internal control meetings are held at regular intervals
* Ensure procurement of all relevant certificates including Practical Completion, Partial Possession where applicable, Making Good Defects and Final Certificate

* Mentor, appraise and measure performance of all direct reporting staff and drive actions/activities identified in the individual’s development plan



  





**The Candidate** 




**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* 15 years’ experience in construction with similar contracting organisations
* In depth understanding of the market in Ireland, which the company operates, including an awareness of competitors and new initiatives
* Proven finance control/reporting ability
* Working knowledge of Construction techniques and Design and Build projects
* Familiarity with working on complex residential projects
* Proficient in planning and prioritising daily site tasks
* Commercially proficient with Public works Ireland form of contract
* Comprehensive knowledge and understanding of all the trades required on site, the codes of practice relating to them and the requirements for them, to be able to carry out required self\-delivery works
* Delivery focused and driver of performance
* Good Communication skills
* Strategic Risk Management
* Ability to hold people to account in terms of implementing Safety philosophy
* Academic and/or professional industry related management qualification
* Membership of an Industry related Professional Institution \- such as MCIOB or CEng MICE
* CVRs, PEP and Contract Management



  





**Skills \& Attributes:** 



* The ability to work as part of cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communicator, with ability to convey complex information well.
* The ability to create and maintain good working relationships with colleagues and clients.
* Highly organised in relation to management of tasks and deadlines.
* Good attention to detail.
* Troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Additional information** 



* All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK and in the Republic of Ireland at the time of application. Proof of this will be required for any candidate who is successful in the role.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About us**
 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate, and innovate to build brands consumers love. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.
   

  

 Join us to create a career worth celebrating.
   

  

**About The Function**
 Our Sales team love building relationships, connecting with customers to sell our much\-loved brands in new and vibrant markets where they can thrive. They help sell our iconic brands across 180 countries every year.
   

  

 We’re operating across different markets, channels, and areas of expertise. Using your curiosity and passion, you’ll make the most of consumer insight and digital platforms, reaching new customers, markets, and celebrations to help us achieve our growth potential. We’ll support your learning and growth as you develop your career with us and work with people across our business to realise your fullest potential
   

  

**Market Context and Role Scope**
 The Middle East and North Africa (MENA) is one of the most complex, volatile and opportunity\-rich regions globally, characterised by rapid growth, regulatory sensitivity and significant diversity across markets. The region spans 17 countries, including sanctioned and dry markets, and serves a population of approximately 500 million people with highly diverse cultural, religious and socio\-economic profiles. With around 95% of the population Muslim, the beverage alcohol industry operates in a uniquely sensitive environment where reputation, compliance and stakeholder management are critical to sustainable success.
   

  

 The total beverage alcohol landscape in MENA is shaped by frequent shifts in political, cultural and religious dynamics, resulting in evolving government legislation, changing consumer behaviour and continual Route to Market complexity. Success in the region requires sophisticated RTM design, strong distributor partnerships and the ability to adapt at pace to changing regulatory and market conditions.
   

  

 At the same time, MENA is undergoing a structural transformation. Governments are accelerating diversification agendas most notably through Saudi Vision 2030 and UAE Vision 2030 to reposition the region as a global hub for tourism, hospitality and luxury experiences. This evolution creates significant long\-term growth opportunities for Diageo, particularly across on\-trade, travel retail, luxury, local bottling, non\-alcoholic beverages and emerging alternative channels.
   

  

 Within this context, MENA represents a strategically critical growth engine for Diageo, encompassing developed, emerging and frontier markets, primarily operating through distributor\-led models. The Commercial Director – MENA leads across this breadth and complexity, shaping differentiated market and channel strategies, unlocking growth through premiumisation and innovation, and ensuring Diageo wins responsibly and sustainably across on\-trade, B2B, travel retail and increasingly omni\-channel and e\-commerce routes to market.
   

  

 Within MENA, the Gulf remains the biggest region in terms of NSV mainly driven by the UAE. The region will be driving the growth of MENA in the next 5 years.
   

  

 UAE being the biggest market in the region, it showcases a mix of 4 channels:
   

  

* Very advanced On\-trade where the biggest global groups are operating in Dubai.
* Fast\-growing retail channel which is yet untapped for Diageo although it doubled year on year
* E\-commerce with Spirits now being sold online.
* FTZ Middle East, a strong yet volatile channel that needs close control on pricing and stock movement.


**Purpose of the role**
 The Head of Gulf is a key member of the Commercial Team and reports to the MENA Commercial Director. This highly strategic role will be responsible for driving value market share and best practices in well\-established markets like UAE and build and develop new RTC in markets like Saudi Arabia. The role leads and inspires an international team of 6 FTEs and extended team of Diageo’s distributors in the region.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the development and implementation of the market strategy to optimize growth opportunities, market share win and profit enhancement.
* Create value by locking strategic pricing and trade terms across the value chain and by achieving the triple Win for Diageo, Distributor and Customer.
* Develop an omnichannel strategy ensuring a cohesive consumer experience across all channels (e\-com, on trade and off trade).
* Lead the relationship with key and relevant stakeholders (external and internal), especially distributors while keeping a sustainable, mutually profitable and strong partnership.
* Lead the negotiation with distributors while securing access to depletions and relevant market data to increase action plan and strategies efficiency.
* Lead the RTC agenda by assessing the right distributor model for the right business (Alc and Non Alc)
* Build a strong launch plan for Saudi Non\-Alc Business which will help define opportunity size and build the right RTC to cater market demand.
* Unlock regional deals for Diageo MENA while leveraging on on\-trade groups operating in different MENA countries.
* Overlook relationship with key customers within the region while ensuring strong JUBP and tailor\-made approach based on customer specificity.
* Build, lead and coach a strong team that will enable us to enhance our effective presence in the market.


**Experience / Skills Required**
* 12\-15 years of successful experience in commercial function, with at least six years in a senior role in


 matrixed environments with FMCG blue chip multinationals
   

  

* Experience in leading a big and successful in\-market RTC Change.
* Essential commercial insight and experience. Preferable if gained through cross\-functional working. Demonstrates numerical and financial skills.
* Proven ability to persuade, influence and build credibility with all levels and all functions.
* Strong Analytical, persuasive selling, negotiation and decision\-making skills.
* Experience in planning and orchestrating available limited resources to achieve ambitious growth targets.
* Excellent coaching and relationship building skills. Demonstrates a track record as a valued coach and peer in the business.
* Has held commercial roles with full P\&L accountability.
* Track record in building and executing effective commercial strategy in a competitive environment while ensuring strong brand presence and leadership.


**Diversity statement**
 Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.
   

  

 We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you’ll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more.
   

  

 Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to the next level and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world.
   

  

 Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you. If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.
   

  

**Worker Type**
 Regular
   

  

**Primary Location:**
 Dubai
   

  

**Additional Locations :**
**Job Posting Start Date**
 2026\-03\-30

**Role Overview** 




  





 The Director of Marketing at the Free Zones Authority of Ajman is responsible for leading the overall marketing strategy, driving business growth, strengthening brand positioning, and ensuring the effective execution of all marketing initiatives across the Authority.
 



 The role plays a critical part in attracting investors, supporting economic growth, and positioning Ajman Free Zones as a leading destination for businesses at both local and international levels.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Marketing Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Define and lead the organization’s marketing vision, strategy, and long\-term roadmap aligned with corporate objectives
* Translate strategic goals into actionable marketing plans, initiatives, and performance targets
* Ensure alignment between Marketing, Sales, and Operations to drive business outcomes
* Act as a strategic advisor to leadership on market trends, risks, and growth opportunities



  





**2\. Demand Generation \& Revenue Growth** 



* Build and scale a sustainable demand generation engine across digital and offline channels
* Drive customer acquisition, lead generation, and revenue contribution through targeted campaigns
* Optimize the full marketing funnel (Awareness → Conversion → Retention)
* Continuously improve lead quality, conversion rates, and cost efficiency (CPA \& CAC)



  





**3\. Brand Strategy \& Market Positioning** 



* Develop and manage a strong, differentiated brand positioning in the UAE market
* Define brand messaging, tone of voice, and communication frameworks
* Ensure consistency across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints
* Monitor and enhance brand awareness, reputation, and market perception



  





**4\. Digital Marketing \& Performance Optimization** 



* Oversee all digital channels including SEO, SEM, paid media, social media, and email marketing
* Optimize website performance, user experience, and conversion rate (CRO)
* Implement data tracking systems and analytics tools to measure performance
* Drive continuous improvement through A/B testing and performance optimization



  





**5\. Market Research \& Strategic Insights** 



* Lead market research initiatives to understand customer behavior, needs, and segmentation
* Analyze competitor strategies, pricing models, and service offerings
* Translate insights into actionable recommendations for service development and positioning
* Identify new market opportunities and growth segments



  





**6\. Content Strategy \& Communications** 



* Develop and execute a comprehensive content strategy aligned with the customer journey
* Oversee production of high\-quality content across all platforms
* Ensure all messaging reflects the company’s value proposition and competitive advantage
* Manage content distribution to maximize reach and engagement



  





**7\. Public Relations \& Strategic Partnerships** 



* Lead PR strategy including media relations, press releases, and reputation management
* Build and maintain partnerships with business councils, chambers, and industry stakeholders
* Drive initiatives that enhance brand credibility and visibility
* Represent the organization in key external engagements when required



  





**8\. Events \& Activation Marketing** 



* Plan and execute events, exhibitions, webinars, and roadshows
* Use events as a key channel for lead generation and brand awareness
* Measure event performance based on leads, engagement, and ROI
* Ensure effective coordination with Sales for lead conversion



  





**9\. Marketing Operations \& Technology** 



* Implement and manage CRM systems and marketing automation platforms
* Ensure accurate lead tracking, reporting, and attribution
* Develop dashboards to monitor marketing performance across channels
* Optimize internal processes for efficiency and scalability



  





**10\. Team Leadership \& Organizational Development** 



* Build and lead a high\-performing marketing team across all functions
* Define roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations
* Develop team capabilities through coaching and structured development plans
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and collaboration



  





**11\. Budget Management \& Financial Performance** 



* Develop and manage the annual marketing budget
* Allocate resources based on performance and strategic priorities
* Monitor marketing spend and ensure cost efficiency and ROI optimization
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to leadership



  





**12\. Performance Management \& Reporting** 



* Establish clear KPIs and performance measurement frameworks
* Track performance across all campaigns and channels
* Prepare monthly and quarterly reports for executive leadership
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations for improvement



  





**13\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on latest marketing trends, tools, and technologies
* Test and implement new growth strategies and channels
* Introduce global best practices into marketing processes
* Drive a data\-driven and experimentation\-focused culture



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, or related field (MBA preferred)
* 10–15\+ years of experience in marketing, including senior leadership roles
* Proven success in B2B / services / Free Zone / government environments
* Strong expertise in digital marketing, brand strategy, and growth
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation tools
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Strategic Leadership \& Vision
* Commercial \& Growth Mindset
* Brand \& Market Positioning
* Digital Marketing Excellence
* Market Intelligence \& Analysis
* Stakeholder \& Partnership Management
* Team Leadership \& Development
* Financial Acumen \& ROI Optimization
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
