data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 The
 **Director of Data Science (ML)** 
 leads Careem’s central Machine Learning and Data Science organization — a 30\+ members team driving applied AI innovation across the Everything App. This leader defines and executes Careem’s AI strategy, scaling machine learning capabilities across all verticals, and ensuring AI becomes a core competitive differentiator.
   

  

 You will shape how Careem personalizes user experiences, optimizes its marketplace dynamics, and leverages the latest in Generative AI and Large Language Models to serve millions of customers every day.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
****1\. Strategic Leadership****
* Define and execute the vision and multi\-year strategy for Data Science and Machine Learning across all Careem verticals.
* Closely partner with product, engineering, and business leaders to identify and prioritize high\-impact AI opportunities with measurable business ROI.
* Drive standardization, scalability, and platformization across ML systems to accelerate delivery and innovation.
* Evangelize AI across the company, ensuring alignment between AI investments and Careem’s overall strategic priorities.


****2\. Team Leadership \& Development****
* Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing team of 30\+ ML engineers and data scientists distributed across geographies and domains.
* Foster a culture of inclusion, experimentation, and excellence — empowering teams to take ownership and innovate.
* Ensure clear ownership and accountability across core DS streams, and continuously evolve team structure for scale and accelerating impact.
* Mentor emerging leaders and invest in developing technical and leadership capabilities across the organization.


****3\. Technical \& Operational Excellence****
* Oversee the design, development, and deployment of end\-to\-end ML systems — from data collection and feature engineering to productionized models and monitoring.
* Partner with engineering to ensure robust infrastructure for training, retraining, and serving ML models at scale.
* Define and oversee the technical AI roadmap and direction for the team.
* Lead innovation in Generative AI and LLM applications, ensuring Careem stays at the forefront of applied AI technologies.
* Champion MLOps and automation to reduce experimentation\-to\-production cycle time.


****4\. Product Impact \& Delivery****
* Ensure each Data Science domain delivers measurable impact aligned with company OKRs and product outcomes.
* Collaborate with vertical leaders to embed ML into user\-facing experiences (e.g., personalized discovery, dynamic ranking, ETA prediction, integrity systems).
* Establish clear success metrics and measurement frameworks for AI\-driven initiatives with clear AI impact accounting.
* Champion a data\-driven culture across Careem — ensuring insights and experimentation inform every product and business decision.


****5\. Cross\-Functional Influence****
* Represent Data Science leadership in executive and strategic forums, influencing company priorities and investment decisions.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering Platform, Product Analytics, and Data Platform teams to align on architecture, tooling, and data strategy.
* Serve as a thought leader for AI innovation across the region and strengthen collaboration with academia and research centers.


**What You'll Need**
* 10\+ years of experience in Data Science, ML, or Applied AI, including 5\+ years leading large, high\-performing technical teams.
* Proven record of building and scaling ML systems in production for large\-scale consumer platforms (e.g., personalization, recommendation, search, marketplace optimization, fraud detection).
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex ML concepts into strategic business impact.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non\-technical domains.
* Deep passion for product\-oriented AI — using data and ML to create delightful, human\-centered experiences.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work 4 days a week in office \& 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

**Job Description**
 With a 65\-year legacy of excellence and a global reputation as one of the largest and most awarded private education providers, GEMS Education integrates cutting\-edge advancements through its extensive networks and high\-level partnerships. Join the GEMS School of Research and Innovation, where significant investments in AI, robotics, and state\-of\-the\-art facilities drive exceptional student outcomes in academics and well\-being. As a leader in educational innovation, we offer a forward\-thinking environment focused on personalised learning, holistic development, and the opportunity to shape the future of education.
   

  

 At GEMS School of Research and Innovation, we provide a seamless educational journey from Pre\-Prep \+ Prep to Sixth Form, enhanced by cutting\-edge technology and a forward\-thinking curriculum. In the Pre\-Prep \+ Prep stages, we prioritise personalized learning through gamification and advanced technologies, alongside a strong emphasis on science, computing, reading, writing, and the arts. Our facilities include an innovation lab, specialist IT equipment, and programs in sports such as gymnastics, martial arts, basketball, and cricket. Emerging technologies like robotics, AI, machine learning, and VR/AR are integrated to enhance learning, including advanced Arabic provision.
   

  

 In Secondary and Sixth Form, students benefit from tailored pathways with a wide range of GCSEs, A\-levels in subjects like sciences, business, and fine arts, supported by university\-linked lectures and industry placements. Advanced tools such as Web3/blockchain, drones, autonomous vehicles, and esports labs prepare students for future careers. Sixth Form further bridges school, university, and industry through global partnerships and cutting\-edge technology, ensuring students excel academically while acquiring real\-world skills.
   

  

 The Director of Enrichment will lead and develop the school’s “beyond the classroom” provision, ensuring it aligns with the GEMS School of Research and Innovation’s vision for a holistic, future\-focused education. This role involves designing and delivering a high\-quality programme of co\-curricular activities, trips, service opportunities, and academic enrichment that is engaging, challenging, and values\-driven. The Director will play a key role in shaping the Student Digital Portfolio, supporting students in showcasing their achievements and preparing for university and college pathways.
   

  

 With responsibility for maintaining high standards across all areas of enrichment, the Director will foster a culture of excellence, intellectual curiosity, service, challenge, and wellbeing. They will oversee the development of the Trailblazer curriculum and line manage key coordinators, ensuring strong alignment between enrichment and the academic curriculum to support the development of core skills and values.
   

  

 The role includes leading the academic enrichment programme, working closely with departments to embed meaningful opportunities beyond the classroom, and collaborating with senior leaders such as the Director of Sport and Director of CAPA. The Director will also support staff recruitment, induction, and professional development, including leading CPD linked to enrichment and establishing consistent planning and quality assurance processes.
   

  

 In addition, the Director of Enrichment will contribute to innovation across the school by aligning with research, technology, and innovation initiatives, working closely with the Vice Principal to ensure these elements are embedded within the wider enrichment provision.

 B.Ed. or bachelor’s degree with PGCE/PGDE (or equivalent)
   

  

* Leadership experience at whole\-school level

* Experience delivering staff CPD


 Strong strategic planning and operational oversight capability
   

  

 Experience working with external agencies and providers
   

  

* Experience representing a school at regional or international events
* Experience leading whole\-school or multi\-school group events
* Evidence of delivering and evaluating an effective beyond the classroom strategy


 Commitment to School Culture:
   

  

* Aspiration to contribute to a world\-class school with an innovation\-driven culture
* Commitment to high standards of safeguarding and, health and safety
* Willingness to operate at both strategic and operational levels in a growing institution


 All positions attract an excellent remuneration package including: Competitive tax\-free salary, individual fully furnished accommodation, free schooling, private medical insurance, annual airfares to country of residence and end of Service Gratuity.
   

  

 GEMS Teachers also have free access to our loyalty app GEMS rewards www.gemsrewards.com which provides significant savings on day\-to\-day life in the UAE. We offer thousands of discounts and 2 for 1 offers on everything from flights, hotels, restaurants and retail outlets, making your salary go further and enhancing the opportunity to save whilst working overseas.
   

  

**GEMS Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all of its students and staff. A UK\-enhanced DBS or equivalent police check is a pre\-requisite for all appointments.**

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**

* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.

* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are looking for a high\-impact, business\-driven Head of Marketing to lead Home Box’s next phase of growth and brand evolution. This role requires a leader who has successfully driven brand transformation in a B2C/retail environment, with a strong bias towards digital\-first marketing, performance\-led growth, and omnichannel excellence.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Brand Strategy \& Customer Experience** 



* Define and lead Home Box’s brand positioning, architecture, and communication frameworks
* Drive brand transformation to make HomeBox modern, relevant, and differentiated in the GCC
* Build strong, insight\-led narratives around key life moments (new homes, families, celebrations)
* Ensure a consistent and elevated customer experience across all touchpoints — online, in\-store, delivery, and post\-purchase
* Partner with retail, VM and Ecom Operation to enhance Customer journeys (discovery → purchase → delivery → service) both Offline and Online



  





**Creative \& Content** 



* Lead end\-to\-end content strategy and execution across all channels and touchpoints
* Drive campaign development from idea, manifesto, and storytelling to final execution
* Oversee creation of brand films, digital content, social media (reels, posts, stories), CRM (SMS/WhatsApp), radio, OOH, in\-store creatives, and ecommerce content (PDPs, banners)
* Ensure content is platform\-first, insight\-led, and performance\-optimized
* Build scalable systems for content planning, production, and distribution with speed and consistency
* Work closely with designers, agencies, and internal teams to maintain high creative standards



  





**Trade Marketing \& Omni Growth** 



* Lead trade marketing strategy to drive store footfall, in\-store conversion, and sell\-through
* Plan and execute promotions, in\-store activations, and local store marketing initiatives
* Develop focus store action plans to drive traffic and performance in priority locations
* Drive omnichannel growth (Click \& Collect, App adoption, cross\-channel shopping behavior)
* Manage media planning and budget allocation across digital and offline channels with ROI focus
* Build and manage partnerships, tie\-ups, and PR opportunities to enhance reach and brand visibility
* Collaborate with VM and retail teams to ensure strong in\-store communication and execution excellence



  





**Customer Value Management (CRM \& Digital Growth)** 



* Own the customer lifecycle strategy — acquisition, engagement, retention, and reactivation
* Lead CRM programs across SMS, WhatsApp, and loyalty initiatives
* Drive data\-led marketing, leveraging analytics for segmentation, personalization, and targeting
* Focus on key metrics: Churn, Frequency, repeat purchase, conversion rates, and retention
* Carry out Voice of Customer research, Brand Audits \& Mystery Shopping from time to time



  





**Campaign Planning \& Calendar Management** 



* Own the annual marketing calendar, balancing brand\-building and category\-driving campaigns
* Plan and execute key campaigns across brand moments, seasonal peaks, and category priorities
* Ensure strong alignment between commercial goals, category focus, and campaign storytelling
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration with buying, retail, ecommerce, and operations teams
* Ensure on\-time, high\-quality execution across all markets and channels



  





**KEY SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE** 



* 12–15 years of experience in B2C / Retail / Omni marketing
* Proven track record in brand transformation and scaling growth through digital\-first marketing
* Strong understanding of digital marketing platforms, performance marketing, and ecommerce
* Hands\-on experience in trade marketing, store footfall generation, and omnichannel integration
* Strong understanding of content ecosystems and multi\-channel storytelling
* Commercial acumen with focus on ROI, growth, and profitability
* Experience in GCC or similar markets is a strong advantage

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth, striving to provide best\-in\-class delivery services. Our goal is to ensure that all customers, no matter where they live, can get their orders as quickly, accurately, and cost\-effectively as possible.
   

  

 Our last\-mile delivery team is seeking a dynamic, autonomous, and well\-organized Operations Integration Manager for the Hub Delivery program. This role will drive integration and standardization of Hub Delivery processes across the UAE AMZL Network, partnering with Country ACES, SnOP, Central Operations, AMZL Operations, Product teams, and other key stakeholders.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing environment focused on improving the delivery experience for our customers while driving operational excellence and cost efficiency.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, model, and implement new operations processes for Hub Delivery across the UAE AMZL Network, ensuring scalability and alignment with network capacity planning.
   

  

 Drive improvement initiatives for existing processes to meet cost, quality, and customer experience goals, using data\-driven insights to identify and prioritize opportunities.
   

  

 Gather and analyze operational data to establish network\-wide standards in partnership with cross\-functional teams, ensuring consistency and best practice adoption across all delivery stations.
   

  

 Build strong partnerships with operations field leaders and stakeholders (Central Operations, SnOP, DSP teams, Country ACES) to understand improvement opportunities and remove operational barriers.
   

  

 Analyze and solve operational blockers with a focus on root cause analysis, driving forward sustainable solutions that improve network performance and partner experience.
   

  

 Innovate to continuously improve customer experience while removing cost and complexity from the fulfillment network through process optimization and automation.
   

  

 Partner with Product teams to conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), review launch plans, pilot new features, and manage full\-scale rollouts across the network with clear success metrics.
   

  

 Represent UAE Hub Delivery operations in regional and global forums, providing insights, performance updates, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics in operations or supply chain environments.
* Advanced knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps, complex formulas) and experience with data visualization tools for operational reporting.
* Proven ability using data and metrics to determine root causes, drive improvements, and measure impact of process changes.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with technical and non\-technical teams, including operations, product, and engineering stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to translate complex operational challenges into actionable solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience, including managing multiple concurrent initiatives with competing priorities.
* Demonstrated experience driving end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects and communicating results to senior leadership with clear business impact.

data.jd_text:
一、岗位职责
 



 1\. 战略规划与体系构建
 


* 制定共享服务中心（SSC）中长期战略，明确服务范围（涵盖人事、财务、行政等模块）及数字化转型路径，提升运营效率与成本管控效益。
* 主导跨部门流程标准化建设，包括费用报销、合同管理等核心流程，建立标准化作业流程（SOP）及合规体系，保障流程高效合规落地执行。



 2\. 全球用工合规体系搭建
 


* 牵头搭建并完善全球用工合规体系，梳理不同国家及地区（重点为海外业务所在地）的用工法律法规及政策要求，制定统一的合规指引与实施方案。
* 协同人力资源、法务及海外业务部门，规范全球用工流程，包括跨境人才派遣、劳动合同拟定、工作签证办理等，规避因区域政策差异引发的合规风险。
* 定期跟踪全球用工政策更新动态，组织团队及海外机构开展合规培训，确保SSC全流程全球服务业务严格遵循当地法规要求。



 3\. 团队管理与服务优化
 


* 全面负责SSC团队管理，涵盖招聘配置、培训赋能、绩效考核等工作，提升团队成员专业能力与服务意识，打造高绩效服务团队。
* 搭建服务质量监控体系，建立满意度调研、投诉闭环处理机制，定期分析运营数据（含时效、差错率等核心指标），推动服务体验持续迭代优化。



 4\. 数字化转型与系统落地
 


* 主导SSC数字化平台（含HR系统、财务共享系统等）的选型、实施与迭代升级，推动RPA、AI等智能化技术应用，实现核心流程自动化落地。
* 优化员工自助服务工具，包括员工门户、移动端应用等，提升数据整合能力与系统智能化水平，同时保障数据安全与合规管理。



 5\. 跨部门协作与业务支持
 


* 对接各业务部门需求，提供定制化共享服务方案，包括异地机构服务支持、政策落地配套服务等，强化与人力资源、财务、行政等部门的协同效能。
* 参与公司并购、组织调整等重大项目，提供流程适配、人员信息迁移等专项支持，保障项目高效推进。



 6\. 合规风控与持续改进
 


* 确保SSC运营全流程符合劳动法、会计准则及行业监管要求，防范薪资核算、税务申报等核心环节的操作风险，定期开展内部审计工作。
* 建立PDCA循环改进机制，复盘流程运行效率与服务交付效果，推动SSC从运营支持型职能向战略赋能型职能升级。



 二、任职要求
 



 1\. 核心能力要求
 


* 专业经验：8年以上共享服务、人力资源或财务领域管理经验，3年及以上SSC负责人岗位任职经历；具备金融/交易所行业背景者优先，需拥有大型企业全球化业务海外SSC搭建及全球用工合规体系构建经验。
* 流程管理：精通流程设计与优化方法论（如六西格玛、精益管理），具备跨部门及跨境流程落地实战案例。
* 数字化能力：熟悉HR系统、财务共享平台操作，具备RPA、AI等智能化技术应用经验，能够主导系统迭代与工具创新。
* 合规意识：通晓全球用工法律法规、财税政策及金融行业合规要求，具备丰富的跨境用工风险管控与内部审计经验。
* 语言能力：中英文双语流利，可作为工作语言；掌握其他外语者优先。



 2\. 管理与协作能力
 


* 团队管理：具备完整的团队搭建、培训赋能及绩效管理经验，善于激发团队成员主动性与创造力，打造凝聚力强的高效团队。
* 跨部门及跨境协调：具备优秀的沟通表达与资源整合能力，擅长联动业务部门、技术团队及海外机构，推进复杂项目落地。
* 战略思维：能够从公司整体战略视角规划SSC发展及全球用工合规工作，平衡短期运营效率与长期战略价值。



 3\. 学历与素养要求
 


* 学历背景：本科及以上学历，人力资源管理、财务管理、法学、信息技术等相关专业优先。
* 职业素养：结果导向，抗压能力强，具备创新思维与细节把控能力，能够适应金融行业高频次合规检查及全球业务复杂性需求。



  





 I. Job Responsibilities
 



 1\. Strategic Planning and System Construction
 


* Formulate the medium and long\-term strategy for the Shared Service Center (SSC), clarify the service scope (covering HR, Finance, Administration and other modules) and digital transformation path, and improve operational efficiency and cost control effectiveness.
* Lead the standardization of cross\-departmental processes, including core processes such as expense reimbursement and contract management, establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance systems, and ensure efficient and compliant implementation of processes.



 2\. Global Employment Compliance System Construction
 


* Take the lead in building and improving the global employment compliance system, sort out employment laws, regulations and policy requirements of different countries and regions (focusing on overseas business locations), and formulate unified compliance guidelines and implementation plans.
* Collaborate with HR, Legal and overseas business departments to standardize global employment processes, including cross\-border talent dispatch, employment contract formulation, work visa handling, etc., and avoid compliance risks caused by regional policy differences.
* Regularly track updates of global employment policies, organize compliance training for the team and overseas institutions, and ensure that the entire process of SSC's global service business strictly complies with local regulatory requirements.



 3\. Team Management and Service Optimization
 


* Be fully responsible for SSC team management, including recruitment and allocation, training and empowerment, performance appraisal, etc., improve team members' professional capabilities and service awareness, and build a high\-performance service team.
* Establish a service quality monitoring system, set up satisfaction surveys and closed\-loop complaint handling mechanisms, regularly analyze operational data (including core indicators such as timeliness and error rate), and promote continuous iteration and optimization of service experience.



 4\. Digital Transformation and System Implementation
 


* Lead the selection, implementation and iterative upgrading of SSC digital platforms (including HR systems, financial shared systems, etc.), promote the application of intelligent technologies such as RPA and AI, and realize the automated implementation of core processes.
* Optimize employee self\-service tools, including employee portals and mobile applications, improve data integration capabilities and system intelligence levels, and ensure data security and compliance management.



 5\. Cross\-Departmental Collaboration and Business Support
 


* Connect with the needs of various business departments, provide customized shared service solutions, including service support for remote institutions and supporting services for policy implementation, and strengthen collaboration efficiency with HR, Finance, Administration and other departments.
* Participate in major company projects such as mergers and acquisitions and organizational adjustments, provide special support such as process adaptation and personnel information migration, and ensure the efficient progress of projects.



 6\. Compliance Risk Control and Continuous Improvement
 


* Ensure that the entire SSC operation process complies with labor laws, accounting standards and industry regulatory requirements, prevent operational risks in core links such as salary calculation and tax declaration, and conduct regular internal audits.
* Establish a PDCA cycle improvement mechanism, review process operation efficiency and service delivery effects, and promote the upgrading of SSC from an operational support function to a strategic enabling function.



 II. Qualifications
 



 1\. Core Competence Requirements
 


* Professional Experience: More than 8 years of management experience in shared services, human resources or finance, with at least 3 years of experience as an SSC Director/Head. Background in the financial/exchange industry is preferred. Experience in building overseas SSCs for global businesses of large enterprises and constructing global employment compliance systems is required.
* Process Management: Proficient in process design and optimization methodologies (such as Six Sigma, Lean Management), with practical cases of cross\-departmental and cross\-border process implementation.
* Digital Capability: Familiar with the operation of HR systems and financial shared platforms, with experience in the application of intelligent technologies such as RPA and AI, and able to lead system iteration and tool innovation.
* Compliance Awareness: Well\-versed in global employment laws and regulations, fiscal and taxation policies, and financial industry compliance requirements, with rich experience in cross\-border employment risk control and internal auditing.
* Language Ability: Fluent in both Chinese and English, which can be used as working languages; proficiency in other foreign languages is a plus.



 2\. Management and Collaboration Capabilities
 


* Team Management: With complete experience in team building, training and empowerment, and performance management, good at stimulating team members' initiative and creativity, and building a cohesive and efficient team.
* Cross\-Departmental \& Cross\-Border Coordination: Excellent communication and resource integration capabilities, good at linking business departments, technical teams and overseas institutions to promote the implementation of complex projects.
* Strategic Thinking: Able to plan SSC development and global employment compliance work from the company's overall strategic perspective, balancing short\-term operational efficiency and long\-term strategic value.



 3\. Educational Background and Quality Requirements
 


* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or above, major in Human Resource Management, Financial Management, Law, Information Technology or related fields is preferred.
* Professional Qualities: Result\-oriented, strong pressure resistance, with innovative thinking and attention to details, able to adapt to the high\-frequency compliance inspection requirements of the financial industry and the complexity of global business.

 Project and Design Leadership

 Penultimate or final year students completing a Bachelor's or a Master's degree.
 



  





**Qube Research \& Technologies (QRT)** 
 is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.
 



 Over the years, QRT has invested in a global research and execution platform which has been deployed to cover all geographies and asset classes. This platform covers a broad spectrum from high to low frequency trading systems. We thrive at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology, smart automation, and scalable processes, enabling us to move fast, think big, and deliver at scale.
 



 We are committed to identifying and developing exceptional talent, and are inviting a new cohort of outstanding individuals to join us in the year ahead. Our internship offers a stimulating, intellectually rigorous, and high\-performance environment, where collaboration is key to success. You will work alongside and be mentored by industry\-leading professionals, gaining invaluable experience and positioning yourself for the opportunity to secure a full\-time graduate role upon successful completion of the program.
 



  





**Your future role at QRT** 




 Throughout the recruitment process, we will work to align your skills, interests, and potential with the teams where you can make the greatest impact.
 



  





 As a Quantitative Research Intern, you could contribute in one of two complementary areas within one of QRT's systematic teams \- spanning high, mid, and low\-frequencies:
 



  





**Research** 




 Your core objective will be to develop high\-quality predictive signals. You will leverage access to vast and diverse datasets to identify hidden statistical patterns and market opportunities.
 



 Collaborating with fellow researchers to exchange ideas and refine methodologies. You will be trained to lead the full research cycle \- from idea generation to implementation.
 



  





**Trading** 




 You will contribute to the live deployment of QRT’s research by working on the systematic trading platform itself. This involves monitoring signal behaviour, tracking performance, and improving execution efficiency, while also helping to identify and manage potential risks. Working closely with senior Researchers and Traders, you will focus on refining and scaling systematic processes, applying your quantitative and programming skills to ensure strategies perform optimally in production.
 



  





 We’re looking for interns who are curious, creative, and collaborative. If you’re passionate about learning, excited to take on challenges, and ready to make a real impact, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to grow with us.
 



  





**Your present skillset** 



* Pursuing an advanced degree in a quantitative field such as data science, statistics, mathematics, physics, or engineering
* High level of technical knowledge in statistics, machine learning, NLP or AI techniques is a plus
* Coding skills required in at least one leading programming language (Python and C\+\+ or C\#)
* Experience in exploring large datasets across multiple time frames is a plus
* Capacity to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while keeping strong attention to detail
* Ability to work autonomously, in a collegial and collaborative setting, and with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise.
* Excellent communication skills
* Fluent in English, any other language is a plus



  





**Interviewing:** 



* **Apply online:** 
 applications are evaluated on a rolling basis by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. This is a great opportunity to stand out, as we read every application carefully and look for specific, thoughtful answers that reflect your genuine interests.
* **Interviews** 
 conducted on\-site or through Teams allow us to evaluate your technical abilities and how well you align with our company culture.



  





 We encourage you to take part in one of our Data Challenges, which offer a valuable opportunity to engage with the types of problems encountered in the Quantitative Research role while showcasing your analytical and technical skills. Strong performance may lead to direct follow\-up from our team, making it an excellent way to gain early visibility in the recruitment process: Challenge data (ens.fr)
 



  





*QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work\-life balance*

**Job Summary**
 Standard Chartered Bank is seeking a dynamic and experienced Programme Support Manager. * Support the safe transmission of clients and sensitive data and ensures that this satisfies the needs of the migration process and compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements.
* Collaborates with Program Owner and Product Owners to re\-plan and prioritize Initiatives based on business value and assess impact on cost and benefit.
* Transitions and hands over to the respective new owners as well as implementing the Program closure procedure.
* Supports resolution of customer complaints and service resolution during the project transition period and ensuring oversight of complaints within respective Business through the relevant forum
* Embed the Group’s values and code of conduct and develop a robust culture to ensure that adherence with the highest standards of ethics, and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees.

* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which both the Group and the Programme operate, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Overall record custodian of the Project.
* Coordinate and ensuring Project Governance forum/committee are held as per the defined frequency. Including custodian of all records and decisions made at these meetings.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank.
* This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**

* Key members for business and product team including workstream leads
* Other key members of the project team

* Liaise with regulatory authorities and airport operators to ensure compliance with aviation and infrastructure requirements.
* Prepare regular interface status reports and provide interface ‑ risk updates to the Project Director and leadership team.
* Maintain a comprehensive interface register, ensuring risks, dependencies, and actions are clearly documented and managed.
* Support integration between design, procurement, and construction teams, ensuring all disciplines are aligned.


 Promote a collaborative working environment across multidisciplinary teams
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a relevant field.

* Proven track record resolving complex interface issues in fast ‑ paced project environments.

We are looking to hire an ACES Program Manager in Dubai (UAE) to join the team that redefines Ultra\-fast grocery operation and help us build and grow this new service for our customers. This is your chance to make history. Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our customers can find, discover and buy anything online. Whatever our customers want, we will find the means to deliver it. With your help, Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds and implement innovation.

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 3\+ years of data analysis experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

****Job Description****

 We are seeking a Project Director with proven experience in delivering Detailed Design for a project based in Jordan. The position will be contracted in the UAE, with travel to Jordan required as per client requests.

****Key Responsibilities****
**Leadership \& Governance**
* Provide overall leadership and strategic direction for the design scope.
* Define and implement the design management strategy in line with contractual obligations.

**Technical Oversight**

* Validate key technical decisions and ensure multidisciplinary consistency.
* Manage complex technical interfaces between systems and construction packages.


**Schedule \& Performance Management**
* Lead the design schedule in a highly constrained delivery environment.
* Ensure adherence to milestones, budget, and quality standards.
* Implement robust reporting and performance monitoring mechanisms.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for the Client on all design\-related matters.
* Participate in high\-level coordination meetings with authorities and key stakeholders.
* Represent the project at executive and institutional levels.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor discipline leads and design managers.
* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative, and multicultural team environment.
* Ensure strong coordination with construction and site\-based teams.


**Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Railway Engineering, or related field.
* Additional qualifications in Project Management (e.g., MBA, PMP) are an advantage.


****Experience****
* Minimum 15 years of experience in large\-scale infrastructure projects.
* Proven experience in major railway projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects under Design \& Build contracts.
* Prior experience in the Middle East is desirable.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong expertise in multidisciplinary design management.

* Solid experience in risk management, planning, and complex project delivery.


****Leadership Skills****
* Strong leadership and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-visibility international environment.


**Languages**

 As the Lead Data Intelligence Project Manager, you ensure that every project has the resources it needs to take off, you'll orchestrate data operations that power product development across Dyson’s global teams. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between our external project teams and our internal technical departments (Data Curation and MLOps). You will own the "data logistics" for the entire project lifecycle—from initial storage setup to final delivery of high\-quality training sets.
* You will be the strategic lead for our labelling workforce, managing the balance between our in\-house contractors and 3rd party service providers to ensure we never hit a capacity bottleneck.
* Overseeing data storage setup and maintenance to guarantee security, accessibility, and compliance.
* Maintaining rigorous documentation and workflows that ensure project transparency and repeatability.
* Supporting cross\-functional communication between data teams, contractors, and engineering partners.


**About you**
* 8\+ years in Project or Program Management, with at least 2 years specifically in AI/ML Data Operations or Data Management. You’ve delivered complex projects on time and within scope—often in fast\-changing settings.
* Demonstrated success in managing 3rd party vendors or service providers, including contract negotiation, quality assurance, issue resolution, and ongoing relationship management.
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of how data flows from collection → cleaning → labeling → training → deployment.
* Tooling Familiarity: Experience with labeling platforms (Labelbox, CVAT, Label Studio) and project management tools (Jira, Asana, or Airtable).

* A solid understanding of modern data storage solutions (cloud, on\-premises, hybrid), including principles of data security, privacy, access control, and regulatory compliance.
* Able to translate complex technical requirements into clear actions for both technical and non\-technical audiences. You’re adept at influencing and building consensus.
* Confident interfacing with cross\-functional teams—coordinating with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and external stakeholders to deliver smooth handovers and alignment.
* Well\-versed in project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall). Known for driving continuous improvement, clear documentation, and repeatable processes.
* Thorough, highly organized, and relentless in troubleshooting issues and removing blockers before they impact delivery.
* Proactive, accountable, and comfortable juggling competing priorities. You always keep end goals in focus and balance urgency with quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or Information Technology); higher degree or PMP/Prince2 certification is a plus.


 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. data.jd_text:
The Commissioning Manager reports to the Project Director (or his designee) and the EPC Commissioning Manager for Quality Management System compliance.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  




* Responsible for HSE and QAQC compliant approaches to define and execute all scopes of work.
* Responsible for managing and achieving all commissioning, start\-up, initial operations activities and performance tests. This includes all preparatory engineering up to and including handover certification.
* Responsible for commissioning strategies that reduce the risk of interruption of operational effectiveness of the asset from start\-up onwards.
* Responsible to optimize project execution schedule at the right junctures to minimize risk to operational effectiveness.
* Interact with project stakeholders to expedite transfers of custody throughout project execution. Notably construction as a predecessor and operations as a successor.
* Drive all subcontractors, vendors and specialist subcontractors to deliver their scopes of work from mechanical completion up to and including performance testing.
* Provide day to day guidance to the commissioning team and stakeholders to achieve the project schedule.
* Define and execute work packages for Hook\-up (de\-preservation, removal of transportation / sea fastening aids, construction activities) and commissioning scopes of work offshore.
* Ensure offshore work package planning is coordination with persons responsible for onshore logistics and Marine spreads, ensuring that all needs offshore are accounted for.
* Perform the role of Offshore Installation Manager during the Hook\-up and offshore commissioning phase of work.



  





**Training** 




  




* Offshore training for German / EU coastal waters. DDW will supplement training where necessary.



  





**Responsibilities Include:** 




  




* Active leadership in DDWD zero harm ensuring both process and personal safety as well as environmental and health standards are achieved on the jobsite.
* Compliance to the Quality management system and necessary tailoring for project and client needs.
* Own project specific commissioning test procedures ensuring that commissioning leads deliver these procedures to a consistent standard.
* Own all procedures, management related and execution related.
* Contribute to constructability concepts for commissioning by working with Engineering and Construction to realise these.
* Lead the progression through ‘livening up’ and parallel path activities and control the associated hazards.
* Ensure the Permit to Work system is used effectively by the commissioning team for livening up, lock out tag out etc. as part of work planning and execution.
* Develop concepts to reduce punch lists / open items in predecessor and successor activities.
* Interface with Regulatory bodies to ensure requirements are incorporated, planned and adequately demonstrated.
* Directly oversee all commissioning leads at the jobsite.
* Lead the definition of the overall completions and commissioning scope of work, execute and maintain all systems until handover to operations is achieved.
* Facilitate transfers of custody with joint walkdowns and adequate participation of the commissioning team.
* Ensure management of change is adhered to by all commissioning leads and their reports.
* Control the completions and commissioning budget and the mobilization of all identified resources within the budget to execute the project schedule.
* Drive tightness and cleanliness compliance with contractors and Piping Process Service providers.
* Provide assurance and oversight of client contractors.
* Ensure first fills are compiled into a register ready for handover to operations and that all fills are conducted as per Original Equipment Manufacturer Installation and Operation Maintenance Manual requirements.
* Ensure all progress reporting / KPIs are updated per specified frequencies.
* Ensure all completion and commissioning documents are entered into the project completion commissioning management system database.
* Coordinate all matters arising that may require the support of Engineering, suppliers, client and or operations.
* Ensure disposal of hazardous substances or waste generated during all phases of commissioning including waste segregation.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 15 years post graduate or Apprenticeship experience in the Marine or Renewables sector. Oil and Gas experience welcomed.
* 5 plus years in the role of a Lead commissioning engineer or Operation (for e.g. Chief Engineer).
* 5 plus years in the role as Commissioning Manager.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Construction/Construction Director oversees the full execution of the high\-rise development projects in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, from pre\-construction through to handover, acting as the key link between the project site, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders. In addition to technical and construction oversight, the role assumes broad project management responsibilities to ensure timely delivery, budget control, quality assurance, and alignment with MERED’s ultra\-luxury standards.
   





  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Act as the Client’s Point of contact on\-site, representing the company in all day\-to\-day project operations, stakeholder communications, technical decisions, and program management—ensuring seamless execution of the company’s development vision.
* Take responsibility for the execution and monitoring of the project master schedule, overseeing critical path activities and proactively resolving bottlenecks across all trades and work fronts.
* Lead all site\-level decision\-making, interfacing daily with the Consultant and Contractor, while aligning with the strategic objectives of the Executive Management team.
* Coordinate and chair all weekly progress meetings, technical coordination meetings, and task force sessions with internal and external parties; follow preparation of comprehensive MOMs, trackers, and follow\-ups to ensure accountability and implementation.
* Ensure that all procurement, long lead items, shop drawings, and authority approvals are aligned with the schedule and proactively track their timelines with the planning department to avoid execution delays.
* Review and assess contractor’s programs, lookahead plans, recovery schedules, and mitigation plans; reject or revise plans that do not meet MERED's standards or fail to support critical milestones.
* Monitor and supervise site works for full scope disciplines including:
+ Soil Investigation.
+ Enabling Works.
+ Structural: Sequencing, rebar installation, slab formwork, PT works, cast\-in items.
+ Architectural: Blockworks, waterproofing, screeding, ceiling frameworks, partitions, stone and tile installations.
+ Façade: System panels, brackets, brackets coordination with MEP penetrations and PT zones, balcony closures.
+ ID: Joinery, veneer mockups, lighting details, finishing tolerances, and detail verifications.
+ MEP: Shaft coordination, riser alignment, containment readiness, T\&C planning and authority inspections.

* Take charge of all government authority coordination (DDA, DEWA, Civil Defense, DM, RTA), ensuring that submissions, site inspections, approvals, and NOCs are prepared and executed on time.
* Maintain direct oversight of design coordination activities, ensuring all site conditions, RFI responses, and consultant instructions are technically reviewed, confirmed, and closed in collaboration with design managers and consultants.
* Represent the Developer in all commercial and contractual coordination together with commercial team by:
+ Evaluating technical claims, cost implications, and time extension requests.
+ Providing technical input to Contracts/Legal for variation orders, claims rebuttals, and scope clarifications.
+ Assessing additional work justifications and holding the Contractor accountable for scope performance.

* Take full leadership of QA/QC implementation:
+ Approve method statements and ITPs.
+ Review NCRs and ensure rectification with zero recurrence.
+ Verify material submittals, shop drawing accuracy, and as\-built records.

* Manage construction digital tools and systems, ensuring workflows, WIRs, MIRs, and document reviews are completed accurately, with continuous system training and performance follow\-up.
* Support planning department for internal weekly reporting to Executive Management:
+ Progress dashboards, milestone tracking, risk registers, productivity comparisons, and KPI compliance reviews.

* Oversee cost control interfaces with the commercial team by tracking site quantities, abortive works, unexecuted scope, and opportunities for value engineering or savings through optimization.
* Support the tendering process by preparing and coordinating technical evaluations, organizing site visits for bidders, reviewing PTC’s, technical submissions and providing input on contractor selection in coordination with the Commercial and Design teams.
* Support the Marketing team by preparing monthly construction progress updates, facilitating site readiness for content creation activities (photoshoots, videography, walkthroughs), and coordinating materials that reflect the company’s culture, particularly in health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Drive logistics and construction phasing strategies including crane operations, platform reconfigurations, hoist planning, material laydown, storage areas, and emergency access.
* Coordinate with the Contractor and Engineer to uphold a high standard of HSE culture across the project by leading weekly HSE\-focused site walks, enforcing compliance with UAE regulations and MERED’s internal safety policies, and ensuring that all activities reflect a clean, safe, and well\-managed construction environment.
* Spearhead initiatives to elevate site culture:
+ Ensure strict housekeeping compliance.
+ Maintain site readiness for walkthroughs.

* Facilitate pre\-handover activities including testing and commissioning, authority handover, DLP coordination, and unit inspections aligned with project branding and customer satisfaction goals.


 Requirements
   


**Required Qualifications**



* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or architecture.
* 15–20 years of experience in high\-rise construction, including luxury residential towers (experience with offices and hotels is a plus).
* Relevant experience in high\-rise construction projects in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
* Verifiable experience working for Tier 1 contractors or developers.
* Understanding of FIDIC contracts and construction contract administration.
* Knowledge of construction planning and phasing.
* Appreciation for customer care and commitment to handing over projects with a customer\-centric approach.
* Understanding of RERA inspections and approvals for Dubai projects, and relevant authority regulations for Abu Dhabi projects.
* Strong technical knowledge in structural, MEP, façade, ID, and authority regulations.
* Proficient in project management tools (Primavera, MS Project), AutoCAD, and document control systems.








**Preferred Qualifications**



* Professional certification if applicable, PMP certification or equivalent project management training.
* Experience with Dubai development regulations and authorities (DDA, DEWA, RTA, etc.).
* Exposure to design management or contractor\-side execution is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of sustainability certifications (LEED) in construction execution, if applicable.
* Industry\-recognized professional whose expertise and reputation are valued by contractors.



  





**Skills and Competencies**



* Strong leadership and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent coordination and conflict resolution skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail and organizational discipline.
* Proactive problem\-solver with a results\-oriented mindset.
* Comfortable managing complex teams and high\-pressure timelines.
* Fluent in English; knowledge of Russian or Arabic is an asset.



 ·
   




 Benefits
   

* Competitive salary package.
* Annual flight ticket allowance.
* Performance discretionary bonus.
* Comprehensive health insurance.
* Employment visa.

**JOB OPENING FOR DHAKA, BANGLADESH** 




**!!!ATTRACTIVE PACKAGE!!!** 




  





**$8,000 \- $10,000 USD \+ Expat Benefits** 




  





**About the Role:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Construction Technical Director to lead the technical and engineering oversight of a major high\-rise project. You will supervise a multidisciplinary design and planning team, ensuring constructability, coordination, and compliance throughout the design and construction phases. This is a senior leadership role requiring deep technical expertise, strong management skills, and the ability to drive efficiency without compromising quality or safety.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Engineering Oversight** 



* Supervise design managers in coordinating architectural, structural, MEP, façade, and specialist designs.
* Lead the review of Issued for Construction (IFC) documentation across all disciplines.
* Identify and resolve interface conflicts between systems during design and pre\-construction.
* Assess design assumptions against construction constraints (e.g., logistics, crane reach, sequencing) and recommend buildability improvements.
* Oversee contractor submissions (shop drawings, method statements, materials) to ensure compliance with specs and design intent.
* Drive value engineering exercises to optimize specifications and reduce rework risks.
* Interface with client consultants and internal teams to clarify design intent and resolve technical issues.



  





**2\. Construction Methods \& Site Logistics** 



* Define and validate construction approaches for structural works (conventional, jump form, table form), façade installation, and MEP systems.
* Evaluate site logistics plans, including crane placement, hoist routes, material flow, and staging areas.
* Ensure contractor method statements are technically sound and aligned with safety, phasing, and site constraints.



  





**3\. Construction Planning \& Scheduling** 



* Oversee the preparation and maintenance of the master construction schedule.
* Ensure schedule logic reflects approved methodologies and protects critical path activities.
* Coordinate sequencing across structural, façade, and MEP works to minimize conflicts and optimize workflow.
* Monitor schedule performance and lead recovery planning when required.



  





**Required Experience \& Skills:** 



* 15\+ years of experience delivering high\-rise projects with a design \& build contractor.
* Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary coordination from design through construction.
* Experience supervising design managers and integrating design outputs into construction planning.
* Strong working knowledge of BIM processes and using models for coordination and optimization.
* Hands\-on experience in construction method planning, scheduling, and workflow management.
* Technically grounded, pragmatic, and confident in site\-based problem\-solving and executive reporting.



  





**Education:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering (mandatory).
* Master’s degree in Construction Management, Project Management, or related field (preferred).

**About Dubai Holding Real Estate:** 




  





 Dubai Holding’s real estate business has developed strategic destinations and communities that offer unique and attractive lifestyle opportunities to meet the evolving needs of Dubai’s residents and visitors alike. As a master developer, we invest in sustainable infrastructure, accessibility, community amenities and family\-focused facilities including community centers, mosques, schools, supermarkets and landscaping.
 



 Our integrated real estate offering also includes a robust land sales portfolio, project management for large\-scale projects, as well as top\-notch facilities management services.
 



  





**About the Job:** 




  





 An opportunity has arisen for an
 **Associate Director \- Community Management (QA, Handover and DLP)** 
 to join
 **Dubai Holding Real Estate** 
 . The job holder is responsible for overseeing the Community Management function, including handover, Defects Liability Period (DLP), and Quality Assurance (QA) activities across communities, ensuring contractual compliance and service excellence. The role provides leadership to teams and stakeholders to deliver seamless asset handovers and superior customer experience that reflects the value of the client’s investment.
 



  





**The main duties and responsibilities of this role:** 




  





***Master Community Handover \-***




  




* Provide strategic oversight on the use of relevant systems for snagging and inspections done by Company Community Management (DHCM), to ensure compliance with handover standards.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination with the Projects team and contractors to ensure timely, accurate, and complete handover of updated project information to Company Community Management (DHCM) through standardized and approved checklists.
* Conduct pre\-handover inspections and snagging to ensure all amenities and infrastructure are due to be completed by handover dates
* Provide continuous updates and follow\-up on handover, snagging and inspections between projects delivery and Company Community Management (DHCM)
* Oversee and drive follow\-ups with Contractors and the Projects Team to ensure all snags reported by Company Community Management (DHCM) are resolved and de\-snagging is completed in line with quality standards prior to unit handover.
* Provide governance and leadership over daily, weekly, and periodic coordination meetings with Contractors and the Projects Team to ensure timely delivery of all amenities in accordance with the CHO date.
* Initiate a pre\-mobilization plan for Company Community Management (DHCM) including: DLD registration, service charges, staff deployment
* Initiate a risk register for master community infrastructure related risks and ensure close coordination with the infrastructure delivery team to mitigate.
* Implement Quality Management Software: Utilize software tools to track defects, manage inspections, and generate reports.
* Implement Continuous Improvement Initiatives: Develop and implement strategies to improve construction quality, efficiency, and safety.



  





***DLP and Community Handover***
*\-* 




  




* Manage all Defects Liability Period (DLP) requests and provide end\-to\-end for all, ensuring effective coordination with the DLP project delivery team to close tickets within agreed SLAs, and proactively escalate unattended, overdue, or disputed DLP snags to senior stakeholders for resolution.
* Develop and maintain a file of disputed snags for final settlement deductions to the main contractor
* Develop scope of services to engage an external vendor to carry out the required out of scope/ disputed items \& works
* Maintain a comprehensive record of defects, including their location, severity, and required corrective actions. Support with evidence and information in case of a dispute between DLP matters
* Monitor the budget allocated for defect rectification and ensure that costs are controlled. · Identify Automation Opportunities: Assess DLP processes and workflows to identify areas where automation can be applied to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and enhance scalability.
* Select and Implement Automation Tools: Research and select appropriate automation tools or platforms that integrate with existing DLP systems. Implement these tools and configure them to automate routine tasks.
* Develop Automation Workflows: Create automated workflows to streamline tasks such as data classification, anomaly detection, incident response, and report generation.
* Lead the formal receipt of community assets and ensure structured, compliant handover to Company Community Management (DHCM) in line with approved handover protocols.
* Manage DLP process for common area assets, ensuring timely resolution of defects, adherence to SLAs, and protection of asset value.
* Review and ensure all closeout documents are completed prior to handover.
* Initiate the lessons learned project reports and ensure close coordination with design and development team to adhere to, by conducting regular meetings during design stages and conduct a peer review on upcoming projects



  





**About you:** 




  





 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Facilities Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Relevant certificate in Project Management/Asset Management/ community Management – preferred
* Min 8\-10\+ Yrs of progressive experience in community management, property development, facilities management, or asset handover within large\-scale residential or mixed\-use developments.
* Proven experience overseeing handover, Defects Liability Period (DLP), and Quality Assurance (QA) functions, including contract administration and SLA governance.
* Strong track record in delivering high\-quality customer experiences during asset delivery and post\-handover phases.
* Proficient in the use of digital handovers, snagging, and asset management systems, as well as reporting and dashboard tools.
* In\-depth knowledge of construction handover processes, DLP management, QA standards, and community asset lifecycle management.
* Strong decision\-making skills with the ability to assess risk, resolve issues, and drive timely outcomes.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize workload
* Flexible approach to work with the ability to adapt to a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
* Cross functional collaboration
* Ability to multitask and effectively prioritize workloads in a fast\-paced, evolving environment. • Contract management and negotiation skills
* Compliance and risk mitigation.
* Excellent communication and customer relationship management skills.
* Analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage escalations and drive timely resolution.



  





**About the Benefits:** 




  





 At Dubai Holding, we're committed to nurturing the success and well\-being of our colleagues. Join our dynamic and diverse team, and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, career development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We strongly believe in creating an empowered workforce that will help us build a connected city for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing the most pioneering candidates who desire to make a great impact on the future of Dubai.

* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Maintenance Operations for CNS; AGL \& Airfield Civil Works.
* Knowledge of ISO, ICAO and GCAA industrial best practices (CNS, AGL and ACW).
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (projects, civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to audio visual equipment, BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.).

* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems).
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services the company provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation.
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department.
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department.
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented.
* Ensure availability of MS and RA



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, Skills**



1. Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable; Contract Management of size of AED 100 Mi; Staff management of 200 staff; Energy management knowledge; P\&L Management.


* 12\+ Years’ experience in contracts \& operations management including 8 years in a managerial role ; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management especially in the areas of operations planning, HSEEQ, supplier relations management, client relations management, maintenance, and contract management
* Aviation sector is a plus.
