data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 Synechron is seeking a skilled and dedicated PMO (Project Management Office) professional to lead our project coordination efforts. The key purpose of this role is to ensure the smooth delivery of projects through the development, implementation, and management of project management processes, methodologies, and tools. This role is vital in aligning projects with organizational goals, managing stakeholder engagement, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. The successful candidate will contribute significantly to the organization’s ability to deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget, thus supporting business growth and operational excellence.
   

  

**Software Requirements**
* Required: Microsoft Project, Jira, MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), SharePoint
* Preferred: Power BI, MS Project Server, VersionOne, Confluence
* Experience Level: Intermediate to Advanced proficiency, with a strong understanding of project management tools and platforms


**Overall Responsibilities**
* Lead the PMO function to ensure efficient project delivery across all organizational units
* Develop, execute, and refine project management processes, methodologies, and standards to optimize project outcomes
* Manage project delivery teams, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and project scope
* Collaborate proactively with stakeholders to identify potential issues and risks, implementing mitigation strategies
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by integrating best practices and lessons learned into project workflows
* Ensure compliance with PMO governance, quality standards, and regulatory requirements
* Provide regular project status updates, reports, and insights to stakeholders and senior management
* Drive the adoption of standardized project management tools and techniques organization\-wide


**Technical Skills (By Category)**
* Programming Languages: Not typically required for this role
* Databases/Data Management: Basic familiarity with data management principles preferred
* Cloud Technologies: Not required
* Frameworks and Methodologies: Agile, Waterfall, Scrum, PMP standards
* Development Tools and Methodologies: MS Project, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint
* Security Protocols: Not applicable


**Experience Requirements**
* Minimum of 8\+ years of experience in project management roles, with at least several years in a PMO lead or senior project coordination position
* Proven experience managing large and complex projects, ensuring on\-time, within\-budget, successful delivery
* Demonstrated success in implementing and managing project management processes and frameworks
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams across multiple locations and cultural contexts
* Industry experience in finance, technology, or consulting services is preferred but not mandatory


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Develop and refine project management processes, tools, and templates
* Lead and coordinate project delivery teams, tracking progress and resolving issues
* Conduct regular meetings with project teams and stakeholders to review status and risks
* Monitor project performance metrics and generate performance reports for leadership
* Identify areas for process improvement and implement best practices
* Escalate project risks and issues promptly, providing strategic solutions
* Ensure all projects comply with organizational governance and quality standards


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or related field; Master’s degree preferred
* Certification such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent is highly desirable
* Ongoing professional development in project management methodologies and tools


**Professional Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on solutions\-oriented outcomes
* Demonstrated leadership and team management abilities
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels
* Flexibility and resilience to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Commitment to high standards of quality and a continuous improvement mindset
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet strict deadlines

* Represent the Group in meetings with senior stakeholders, including potential partners and the family principals

* Significant investment banking experience whilst based in the UAE
* Strong regional experience in the GCC with a well\-developed network of corporate, advisory, and investor relationships
* Track record leading complex transactions independently
* Strategic thinker with the ability to identify new sectors and build theses from the ground up
* Confident communicator able to engage with C\-suite leadership and family principals

data.jd_text:
Job Position: Project Supervisor
   

  

 Reports to: Projects Engineer and Projects Manager
   

  

 Job Objectives:
   

  

 The Projects Supervisor is responsible for onsite project coordination/activities/supervision within an assigned location. The function is also responsible for ensuring proper technical/quality/timeline scope performance standards and metrics relating to timely completion of projects. Develop and implement detailed project work plans (in line with project work schedule) and review as appropriate to meet project needs and requirements. Identify construction related project risks to be resolved through consistent monitoring. Close onsite visits and coordinate with workers to ensure the continuous flow of work.
   

  

 Responsibilities and duties:
   

  

* Prepares the detailed site Work Plan (WP) together with the Projects Manager (PM); Projects Engineer (PE), Projects Coordinator (PC) and Projects Planning Engineer (PPE) in line with the project work schedule.
* Prepares a weekly progress report to be submitted to the PM, PE and PPE.
* Organizes the installation works on site in line with the WP and makes the necessary adjustments if needed.
* Has a good technical knowledge about the works to be done. Has the WP adjusted in line with technical challenges and if necessary, gets assistance from the PE technical team and PMO.
* Instructs the teams on site in line with the real site requirements.
* Gets the Specialist Supervisor (SS) when required for different activities at the required time.
* Critical when it comes to quality (both technically and aesthetically).
* Responsible of the site HSE and workers' compliance with Adearest and client safety standard.
* Organizes toolbox talks.
* Takes the responsibility on the materials and tools shipped to site.
* Discusses with PC whether special equipment (cranes, scissor, lift, etc.) is required.
* Serves as the link between the PE and the Specialist Supervisor (SS).
* Efficient use of company assets and tools.
* Coordinates site activities with main contractor and sub\-contractors.
* Resolves site issues with main contractor and sub\-contractors. Brings up unresolved site issues to the PE \& PM immediately without delay to find a solution.


 Years of Experience:
   

  

* Minimum of 3 years related experience in project management \& MEP Contracting \& EPC Companies.
* Strong experience in Refrigeration/Cold store insulation.

The role will ensure strong governance, effective risk management, and commercial optimization, acting as a trusted advisor to project leadership and delivery teams.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




**Strategic Contribution** 



* Provide senior expertise on commercial, contract, and cost matters across major capital projects.
* Support governance, standards, and controls across the project portfolio.
* Act as a commercial partner to Project Directors, PMO, Finance, Procurement, and Legal on high\-value/high\-risk projects.



**Commercial \& Contract Management** 



* Manage complex contracts including EPC/D\&C, consultancy, vendor/supply, service, and subcontract agreements.
* Support procurement strategies and provide commercial input into tenders, evaluations, and award recommendations.
* Participate in high\-value negotiations to achieve favorable outcomes while maintaining balanced risk allocation.



**Change, Claims \& Risk Management** 



* Review and advise on variations, claims, and entitlements.
* Identify contractual and commercial risks and propose mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, legal requirements, and company policies.



**Financial Oversight \& Reporting** 



* Support budgeting, cashflow forecasting, and commercial baseline development.
* Monitor financial performance versus budget and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Prepare timely, accurate commercial reports and insights for leadership.



**Stakeholder \& Vendor Collaboration** 



* Collaborate with Project Managers, Engineers, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and consultants on contract\-related matters.
* Maintain strong commercial relationships with key contractors and vendors.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of commercial practices, systems, and processes.



  





  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& COMPETENCIES:** 



* 12\+ years of commercial and contract management experience, ideally in data centers, complex engineering, or construction projects across the full project lifecycle.
* Strong expertise in contract negotiation, commercial strategy, cost management, and risk mitigation.
* Experience working in multicultural, cross\-functional teams and managing external consultants and vendors.
* Proven ability to lead high\-value contracts and advise senior stakeholders on complex contractual and financial matters.
* Strong stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with experience in multicultural project environments.

 We are seeking for a Product \& Deployment Lead, EMEA in charge of a team deploying the Global SMS application across multiple countries.
   

  

 This role ensures that:
   

  

* Deployment activities are delivered on time, within scope, and in compliance with local regulations and organizational standards.
* The deployment framework is always enhanced and scalable for future deployments.


 The position requires:
   

  

* Close collaboration within the team and with cross\-functional teams, including development, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders.
* Analytical skills to identify opportunities (automation, simplifications, continuous improvements, …)


**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead a SMS deployment team
* Execute initial discovery of SMS solution in “MT0” session, identify enhancements and support adequate functional specification requirements definition.
* Prioritize enhancements as pre or post Go Live
* Ensure Pre\-Go Live enhancements are within the allocated budget and timeline
* Lead Data Migration, performance testing, integration testing, business continuity testing, …
* Lead UAT (including Data and integration signoff, performance testing if applicable, business continuity testing if applicable, …)
* Support change management (Lead country Expert/key user training, support/monitor champions training execution)
* Successful deployment within time and budget
* Handover support post go live to sustain team
* Monitor post Go Live adoption and defects
* Monitor team resource allocation with support of project planner to avoid under and over utilization
* Monitor and reconcile weekly progress with the project plan
* Communicate to stakeholders on progress and budget

**Deployment Strategy \& Framework**
* Contribute to designing the deployment strategy.
* Enhance and improve the existing deployment template in order to:
* Reduce deployment timeline and cost.
* Support standard modular approach.
* Optimize the overall process (Country discovery “MT0”, enhancements definition and prioritization, UAT, signoff, …)


**UAT/Test Planning \& Strategy**
* Continuously enhance the Azure DevOps (ADO) structure to efficiently collect, manage, and act on UAT feedback.
* Review and refine existing test plans and scripts, ensuring they reflect current system requirements and user expectations.
* Maintain and evolve testing assets based on:
* Functional Specification Documents (FSDs)
* System updates and enhancements
* Real\-time user feedback during UAT cycles
* Develop testing strategies that align with product goals, emphasizing traceability, coverage, and risk mitigation.
* Collaborate to define and improve the ADO framework for test management and traceability.

**Test Execution \& Validation**
* Lead and execute functional, performance, and user acceptance tests (UAT) to validate system behavior under diverse conditions.
* Monitor and report on test progress, ensuring transparency and timely escalation of issues.
* Drive defect resolution by coordinating with development and QA teams, ensuring root cause analysis and timely fixes.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with country stakeholders
* Support change management
* Partner with CTO teams (build, interface, data load) and PMO to ensure alignment across deployment and testing activities.
* Engage with product design engineers, robust design leaders, and business analysts to ensure test coverage reflects business needs.
* Facilitate cross\-functional workshops and syncs to align on priorities, timelines, and quality expectations.


**Automation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Propose and contribute to the development of automated regression test suites to enhance testing efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for defects and document lessons learned to improve future testing cycles.
* Advocate for continuous improvement in testing practices, tools, and team collaboration.


**Documentation \& Compliance**
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of test results, deployment procedures, and validation reports.
* Support internal and external audits by ensuring traceability, compliance, and quality assurance standards are met.
* Contribute to knowledge bases and training materials to support onboarding and knowledge transfer.


**Governance \& Metrics**
* Define and track KPIs for deployment success, test coverage, defect resolution, and UAT satisfaction.
* Establish governance models for deployment approvals, rollback procedures, and change control.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on deployment health, risks, and improvement opportunities.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business domains.
* Fluent English level, any additional languages being an asset
* Negotiation skills (with partners teams, with country, etc)
* Lead external partners teams
* Objective oriented
* Resilient, adaptative to moving environment, creative and solution finder approach
* Proven experience in deployment architecture, test strategy, and system validation in enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps, test automation frameworks, and quality assurance methodologies.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives and drive strategic outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.


 If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

 Finance Manager (operational and build\-focused role)
   

  

 This role sits at the centre of the business during its setup and expansion phase, with responsibility extending beyond traditional finance into systems, structure, governance, and cross\-functional integration.
   

  

 You will work closely with PMO, Operations, and Central Services, supporting new openings, project delivery, and long\-term scale.
   

  

 We are open to candidates at different levels of seniority, provided they bring strong SME experience, system implementation capability, and hands\-on execution.
   

  

**This Is a Build\-and\-lead Finance Role, Combining**
* Financial operations and reporting
* Department setup and structure design
* Systems implementation and integration
* Project finance and PMO coordination
* Commercial and operational support
* Depending on experience, you will either:


 Lead and shape the finance function at group level, or dive execution, setup, and day\-to\-day operations within a growing structure.

* Ensure alignment between project delivery timelines and financial reporting
* Business Partnering

* Support new openings, commercial decisions, and strategic initiatives

* Finance Function Setup \& Scale

* Establish SOPs, workflows, and approval frameworks
* Set up financial systems, banking structures, and reporting templates
* Recruit, onboard, and train finance and admin teams
* Pre\-Opening \& Launch Support
* Lead financial setup for new outlets (costing, POS setup, reporting structures)

* Scale\-Up \& Expansion

* Support long\-term strategic planning and regional expansion


**Candidate Profile**

data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Managing Consultant, AI Subject Matter Expert \- Advisors \& Consulting Services
   

  

 Managing Consultant – Strategy \& Transformation – AI Specialist
   

  

 Advisors \& Consulting Services
   

  

 Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value\-added services and leverage expertise, data\-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors \& Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.
   

  

 The Advisors \& Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy \& Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Strategy \& Transformation consultants lead clients through impactful decision\-making as they tackle strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational business challenges. They apply a broad set of problem\-solving techniques to improve the client’s overall strategy, performance, and operations.
   

  

 Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. Please review our consulting specializations to learn more about all opportunities and apply for the position that is best suited to your background and experience: https://careers.mastercard.com/us/en/consulting\-specializations\-at\-mastercard
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Consulting Project Manager with deep, hands\-on expertise in Generative AI and Agentic AI systems to lead end\-to\-end delivery of AI transformation initiatives for clients. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, product thinking, and consulting delivery—owning outcomes from use\-case definition through production deployment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has personally built, tested, and deployed LLM\-powered solutions, understands modern agent frameworks, and can credibly engage both C\-suite stakeholders and engineering teams
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead client engagements focused on GenAI and agentic AI solutions, from discovery and architecture through delivery and scale
* Translate business problems into LLM\-driven and agent\-based solutions (e.g., autonomous workflows, AI copilots, decision agents)
* Act as a hands\-on delivery lead, reviewing prompts, agent logic, RAG pipelines, evaluation metrics, and deployment approaches
* Manage multi\-disciplinary teams (AI engineers, data scientists, cloud engineers, UX) using agile delivery models
* Own client communication, roadmap definition, risk management, and value realization
* Ensure solutions meet security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI standards
* Support pre\-sales by contributing to proposals, solution design, and client workshops


**Required Experience \& Skills**
 AI \& Technical (Hands\-On – Mandatory)
   

  

* Strong, practical experience working with LLMs, such as:
* OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source models (LLaMA, Mistral, etc.)
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Prompt engineering and prompt optimization
* RAG architectures (vector databases, embeddings, retrieval strategies)
* Agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, custom agent orchestration)
* Experience building and deploying multi\-agent or tool\-using systems (function calling, APIs, workflows)
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, latency/cost optimization, and hallucination mitigation
* Working knowledge of cloud AI stacks (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern MLOps / LLMOps practices


 Consulting \& Delivery
   

  

* 8–12\+ years of experience in consulting, digital transformation, or AI delivery roles
* Proven track record managing complex client engagements with senior stakeholders
* Strong ability to bridge business strategy and technical execution
* Experience delivering AI solutions in banking, retail, telecom, or regulated industries is a strong plus


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Background as an AI engineer, data scientist, or solution architect before moving into project/program leadership
* Experience defining AI operating models and scaling GenAI across an enterprise
* Exposure to agentic commerce, autonomous decisioning, or AI\-driven operations
* Certifications in cloud platforms or AI/ML (nice to have, not mandatory)


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Clients trust you as a credible AI practitioner, not just a project manager
* AI solutions move from POC to production, delivering measurable business value
* Teams ship robust, scalable agentic systems, not demos
* You help shape the firm’s AI consulting offerings and delivery standards


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 GIG Gulf is an ‘A’ rated regional insurer with a top 5 position in each of its markets (UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain). GIG Gulf has been present in the region for over 70 years with a strategic focus on both growth and investments and is a one stop shop offering a wide range of insurance products and services that cater to a broad variety of needs for corporates, SMEs and individual customers throughout UAE, Oman, Bahrain, and Qatar.  **.**

 As a Healthcare Policy administration assistant, you will perform various tasks daily. And therefore, you should be able to multitask and prioritize.  The role requires a great deal of independent thought or judgment acting within well\-defined policies and procedures.

* To develop and maintain business relationships with SME clients to build rapport and promote company products.

 As
 **Client Partner** 
 , you will be instrumental in the shaping Valtech’s
 **practice in MENA** 
 , driving client success through the facilitation of the strategic relationships with customers.
   

  

 Entrepreneurial in spirit and adept at working in fast\-paced, changing, high\-growth environment, you will unlock opportunities to help the customer achieve their ambitions for bringing innovation to their digital estate.
   

  

 You will develop and nurture our most senior\-level key client relationships, and it will be you who works in close collaboration with a dedicated delivery team to deliver fantastic work and own the longer\-term strategic direction, planning and revenue growth of your accounts.
   

  

 You will be skilled at interpreting and adding value to new client briefs, always thinking about the longer\-term ambition and objectives of your clients and their business, engaging with all teams and disciplines to deliver the best work possible.
   

  

 To be successful in the role you will need to be a digital native who thrives in delivering high\-value digital transformation programs. You will have a natural flair for client interactions, blending high energy with composure, and a demonstrable ability of bringing order to complex solution builds.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to join Valtech during a period of rapid growth, making a tangible impact on both our business and our clients’ transformation journeys.
   

  

**Your Role**
* In your role as a Client Partner at Valtech you can expect to build and nurture relationships with both our clients at executive level as well as your peers across the organisation.
* You will be actively seeking out and developing growth opportunities within your client organisations to bring in our broader specialisms and you’ll be excited about driving our exciting offering.
* You will bring your strategic thinking and considered opinions and recommendations whilst being respectful of others. You’ll challenge thinking and won’t accept the status quo to ensure the right outcome.
* You are accountable for the commercials across your account portfolio \- working with Delivery to ensure account profitability and accurate forecasting.
* You’ll consistently track performance against annual targets and quickly identifying potential areas for account development.
* You will own and lead the account strategy planning across your client portfolio – building on your in\-depth knowledge of your clients and their businesses to identify the right areas of focus and working collaboratively with subject matter experts and senior stakeholders across the business to develop and implement the strategic vision for your accounts.
* A key focus of your role will be on the longer\-term development and growth of your accounts. You’ll be tasked with leading on business development opportunities across your account portfolio. You will develop, own and present plans and proposals that will add more value for our clients and drive additional revenue for Valtech.
* Critically, you will be a team player that genuinely cares about what they do and the people they do it with.

* Experience managing digital transformation portfolios valued at \>5\-7M AED
* Experience working with a broad customer base of travel, hospitality, ecommerce \& retail.
* Ability to inspire and influence working relationships at C\-suite level
* Confident leading the creation and building complex digital products and solutions within an agency environment
* Strong business and commercial acumen, confident looking for opportunities to expand and develop existing client accounts.


**Core Competencies**
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business challenges into digital solutions.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building and scaling practices in a rapidly growing market.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing at all organisational levels.


**Regional Expertise**
* Strong understanding of MENA markets, their unique challenges, and the opportunities they present.


**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

**Your application process**
 Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.
   

  

 ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!
   

  

 We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.
   

  

**About Valtech**
 Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.
   

  

 At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P\&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.
   

  

 At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.
   

  

 Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

data.jd_text:
**About Nintex:**
 At Nintex, we are transforming the way people work, everywhere.
   

  

 As the global standard for process intelligence and automation, we're trusted by over 10,000 public and private sector organizations across 90 countries. Our customers, from industry giants like Amazon, Coca\-Cola, and Microsoft, rely on the Nintex Platform to accelerate their digital transformation journeys by managing, automating, and optimizing business processes quickly and efficiently. We improve their lives through the technology we build.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering a workplace that supports amazing people in doing their very best work every day. Collaboration is constant, our workplace is fun, the environment is fast\-paced, and we value our people’s curiosity, ideas, and enthusiasm. Driven by passion and accountability, we take initiative, measure progress, and deliver results. Our culture fosters innovation and problem\-solving, fueled by curiosity and a commitment to thinking big. Together, we move with agility, prioritize customer needs, and build unity through empathy, leaving a positive impact wherever we go.
   

  

**About the role:**
 As a Business Development Representative (BDR) you will be responsible for effectively qualifying opportunities from inbound enquiries whilst also prospecting and building relationships within current Nintex customers within a defined territory. In this role you will learn how to master the fundamentals and gain experience working collaboratively with our sales team across the entire sales cycle. You will be responsible for identifying qualified prospects, generating appointments, delivering our value proposition and influencing qualified deals to close.
   

  

**Your contribution will be:**
**Performing outbound sales calls.** 
 You will spend your day connecting with prospects using phone, social, and email to engage in a qualification/discovery process. You will be the 1st point of call for live chat sales enquiries. Coordinate closely with internal sales resources to align solution design with customers’ business requirements.
   

  

**Lead qualification.** 
 You will qualify high quality opportunities and arrange follow up meetings with the sales team. To manage this process you will utilize document progress, notes, etc. in the Nintex CRM (SalesForce.com). You will learn and master Salesforce lead management, email management, and lead documentation, follow\-up procedure. You will participate in providing feedback on how prospects are contacting Nintex and how they are reacting to current marketing efforts.
   

  

**Evangelize the Nintex portfolio.** 
 You will gain and maintain up to date knowledge of Saleforce.com, SharePoint, O365, business process planning and Nintex products. Before we let you loose on the phones, you will learn to effectively communicate how all Nintex products are licensed and how they will benefit our customers. Further, you will proactively scope technical solutions using Nintex products required to address customer requirements, assess customers met and unmet needs, and recommend solutions that optimize value for both the customer and Nintex.
   

  

**Fill the top of the funnel.** 
 In order for us to get leads to the buying phase, we first have to get people into the qualified leads funnel. You will provide assistance to existing and prospective customers during product trial periods and enable them, so they get the most out of the trial period. You will opportunistically pursue additional business development opportunities in the field, collaborate with other Business Development Representatives, and Account Managers to ensure these opportunities are advanced.
   

  

**To be successful, we think you need:**
* 2 years' sales experience
* Prior experience with Salesforce CRM (desirable)
* Marketing or Software as a Service (SaaS) sales experience (desirable)
* Ability to work in a fast paced, entrepreneurial, results oriented culture where team members work together collaboratively
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* A positive, self\-starter attitude and desire to exceed expectations at every opportunity
* Strong organizational skills and an absolute focus on quality of work
* Proven ability to connect with people using telephone, email and online networking sites


**What’s in it for you?**
 Nintex has a hybrid working model, enabling us to build culture, learn, and grow together. We intentionally connect and collaborate, while emphasizing flexibility with a blend of at\-home and in\-office work. This role is a hybrid role in our local Nintex office.
   

  

 While our offerings differ from country to country, we offer our entire global workforce an array of exciting perks and benefits, including
   

  

* Global Gratitude and Recharge Days
* Flexible, paid time off policy
* Employee wellness programs and counseling resources
* Meaningful peer recognition and awards
* Paid parental leave
* Invention/patenting assistance
* Community impact, paid volunteer time, and opportunities
* Intercultural learning and celebration
* Multiple tools through which to learn and grow, and an incredible global community


 View more about our benefits here: https://www.nintex.com/wp\-content/uploads/2023/01/Global\-Perks\-and\-Benefits.pdf.

**Who We Are:** 




 GMG is a global well\-being company retailing, distributing and manufacturing a portfolio of leading international and home\-grown brands across sport, everyday goods, health and beauty, properties and logistics sectors. Under the ownership and management of the Baker family for over 45 years, GMG is a valued partner of choice for the world's most successful and respected brands in the well\-being sector. Working across the Middle East, North Africa, and Asia, GMG has introduced more than 120 brands across 12 countries. These include notable home\-grown brands such as Sun \& Sand Sports, Dropkick, Supercare Pharmacy, Farm Fresh, Klassic, and international brands like Nike, Columbia, Converse, Timberland, Vans, Mama Sita's, and McCain.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The BPI Assistant Manager for Process, Policies, and Internal Controls will be instrumental in supporting the design, implementation, and monitoring of efficient processes, policies, and internal controls throughout the organization. The ideal candidate will possess a strong expertise in process optimization, compliance, and risk management, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across business units within GMG. This role requires a highly motivated individual and a change leader who is passionate about driving digital transformation and enhancing operational efficiency while ensuring policy compliance and mitigating risks.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 



* Process Improvement and Optimization:
* Assist in identifying, evaluating, and implementing process improvements to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance service quality.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to map and streamline workflows, ensuring optimal use of resources and compliance with internal standards.
* Conduct process assessments and audits to identify areas for improvement and recommend solutions to enhance productivity and mitigate risks.
* Assist in drafting, reviewing, and updating company policies and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and organizational goals.
* Ensure that policies are consistently applied across departments, and support teams in understanding and adhering to company policies.
* Provide guidance to departments regarding policy interpretation and implementation.
* Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of internal control frameworks to safeguard company assets, ensure financial integrity, and prevent fraud or errors.
* Conduct regular assessments of internal controls, identifying weaknesses or gaps, and working with relevant teams to develop corrective action plans.
* Monitor compliance with established internal controls and provide recommendations for improvements as needed.
* Assist in coordinating internal audits to ensure compliance with financial, operational, and regulatory standards.
* Help prepare audit documentation and respond to audit inquiries in a timely manner.
* Monitor and report on audit findings and assist with the implementation of corrective actions.
* Conduct training sessions for staff on process improvements, policies, and internal controls to promote a culture of compliance and efficiency.
* Provide ongoing support and clarification to departments regarding process and policy changes.
* Prepare and present regular reports on process performance, policy compliance, and internal control assessments to senior management.
* Maintain accurate records of policies, procedures, and control documentation to ensure traceability and accountability.



  





**Skills \& Experience** 



* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with process mapping tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is a plus.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices related to internal controls and process management.
* Must have Business Process Re\-engineering experience in Retail, Pharma Manufacturing and/ or FMCG sectors
* Prefer hands\-on process optimization experience in relevant Business Units / functions
* Implementation of Automation / RPA techniques
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CPA, CIA, CISA, Six Sigma Green/ black belt certified candidates preferred) are a plus.



  





**Why Join GMG?** 



* At GMG, we're dedicated to nurturing a vibrant, inclusive, and engaging work environment that promotes growth, innovation, and well\-being. Join us in our mission to inspire victories that make the world better – for our team, our consumers, and our communities.
* If you're seeking a challenging role where you can make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to become a part of our journey.



  





**What we offer** 



* An opportunity to become part of diverse teams with international exposure
* Comprehensive family medical insurance
* Family residency sponsorship and flight allowances
* Up to 30% discount in our premium retail sports brand stores
* Up to 20% discount in our pharmacy chain

 As a Senior Consultant at FTI Consulting you will play a key role in formulating strategic recommendations and implementing changes to clients by leading individual project modules and workstreams, deploying commercial acumen in performing key analysis, connecting it with the bigger picture and sharing output with clients. You will also have the opportunity to coach more junior staff and interns.

 As a Senior Consultant, you will lead modules of a project or a small workstream in client billable project work.  At FTI Consulting, we believe in an apprenticeship model, where you learn continuously on the job.  Someone who builds good professional and personal relationships with client teams at senior management levels and someone who is a team player and can work in a truly diverse setting, possessing cultural awareness and can influence and add value to the team.

data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose** 




 The S\&OP Manager is responsible for driving the Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP) process to ensure optimal balance between demand, supply, and inventory across all business units. The role ensures accurate demand forecasting, effective production planning and smooth cross\-functional alignment between Sales, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Logistics to achieve customer service, cost, and inventory objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Demand \& Supply Planning** 



* Lead the monthly S\&OP cycle, consolidating inputs from Sales, Marketing, Production, and Finance to create a balanced demand and supply plan.
* Develop and maintain statistical forecasts using historical data, market intelligence, and promotional activities.
* Identify demand risks and opportunities; recommend mitigation or acceleration actions to ensure target service levels.
* Align production and material plans with forecasted demand, taking into account capacity, lead times, and inventory targets.
* Coordinate weekly and monthly review meetings to monitor forecast accuracy, plan adherence, and inventory performance.



**Inventory \& Material Management** 



* Monitor and optimize inventory levels across finished goods, raw materials, and packaging materials to achieve working capital targets.
* Collaborate with Procurement and Warehousing to ensure timely replenishment of key materials while avoiding overstock and obsolescence.
* Conduct root cause analysis for stock\-outs, slow\-moving, and excess inventory, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure system accuracy for master data, material planning parameters, and BOMs within SAP/S4HANA.



**Production \& Capacity Planning** 



* Translate demand plans into feasible production plans in coordination with manufacturing, ensuring optimal utilization of capacity and resources.
* Evaluate constraints and propose alternative scenarios to balance service, cost, and efficiency objectives.
* Support plant scheduling to ensure material and capacity availability for on\-time production and delivery.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to align forecasts with business objectives, promotions, and budget assumptions.
* Work closely with Logistics and Customer Service to ensure smooth order fulfillment and delivery planning.
* Serve as the focal point for the S\&OP process, driving consensus and transparency across all departments.



**Reporting \& Performance Management** 



* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Forecast Accuracy, OTIF (On\-Time In\-Full), Inventory Turnover, and Plan Adherence.
* Develop dashboards and performance reports for senior management highlighting forecast trends, supply gaps, and improvement actions.
* Drive continuous improvement in forecasting models, planning processes, and system utilization.



**Continuous Improvement \& Systems** 



* Support digital transformation and process automation in demand and supply planning functions.
* Leverage analytical tools such as Power BI and SAP to enhance decision\-making and visibility across the supply chain.
* Identify opportunities for process standardization and efficiency improvement in planning and inventory control.



**People \& Capability** 



* Train and coach planning team members on demand forecasting, planning systems, and S\&OP methodologies.
* Collaborate with HR and functional heads to identify skill gaps and implement upskilling programs for planners and schedulers.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* 8–12 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Planning, or S\&OP within the FMCG or manufacturing sector.
* Strong knowledge of SAP (preferably S4/HANA), advanced Excel, and forecasting tools.

**Job Requisition ID:** 
 175863
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
* The Digital Delivery Lead is responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of digital initiatives in alignment with the digital transformation roadmap. The role demands expertise in digital product delivery, agile frameworks, and complex integrations to ensure programs are delivered on time, within budget, and meet expected business outcomes. The role encompasses managing Capex/OPEX, vendor budgets, and safeguarding business continuity. Success factors include achieving delivery velocity, stakeholder satisfaction index, and maintaining a low post\-release defect rate.


**What You Will Do:**
 Digital Transformation Execution
   

  

* Lead the delivery of digitalisation initiatives across onboarding, CRM, data, collections, and omni\-channel experience.
* Implement agile delivery models and manage cross\-functional teams to facilitate agile ceremonies and coaching.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects to ensure alignment with the target architecture and reduce system duplication.
* Ensure business\-as\-usual (BAU) continuity during transformation projects.
* Manage relationships with vendors and partners, ensuring adherence to service level agreements.
* Govern and report project progress through dashboards, maintaining deviation within 5% from the plan.
* Develop and mentor delivery teams, enhancing agile maturity and achieving skill certifications.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* End\-to\-end agile delivery management.
* Cloud (Azure), integration (APIM/microservices), data, and AI enablement.
* Strong stakeholder communication and vendor governance.
* Ability to translate business strategies into executable plans.
* Experience in Core banking, fintech platforms, Full CRM suites and customer experience platforms


**What Equips You For The Role:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
* Certified Agile/Scrum Master or PMP\-Agile; SAFe certification preferred.
* 10\+ years in digital transformation and delivery, with at least 5 years in financial services.
* Experience in managing hybrid delivery teams and large multi\-system digital programs.
* Expertise in Azure DevOps/JIRA, CI/CD, and release management.


**About Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
 The real estate development and operations arm of Al\-Futtaim, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high\-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega\-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
   

  

 Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
   

  

 AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Malls**
 Al\-Futtaim Malls provides development and asset management expertise, specializing in building retail\-led super regional malls in prime locations across MENA and beyond. With a proven track record of creating both sustainable revenue growth and value enhancement for tenants, Al\-Futtaim Malls delivers exceptional experiences and exciting shopping environments for customers.
   

  

 Part of the Al\-Futtaim Group, Al\-Futtaim Malls leadership team brings more than 30 years of experience and a deep understanding and knowledge of the retail sector, both from a shopper’s point of view but as curators of space or landlords to other brands. The company has a directly managed portfolio including over 9 million sqft of retail space across four malls in the MENA region and two under development. Malls under the Al\-Futtaim Malls portfolio include Dubai Festival City Mall and Festival Plaza in the UAE, Cairo Festival City Mall in Egypt, Doha Festival City in Qatar and Zenata Mall, Morocco.
   

  

 Leveraging on the expertise of its parent company, Al\-Futtaim Malls established PLEX Management Services offering a full array of services including asset management and development, leasing, and brand experience expertise to shopping mall landlords and retail organizations globally. Implementing global best practice and deploying Al\-Futtaim Mall’s deep understanding of mall management and retail dynamics, PLEX promises to deliver continuous growth and long\-term value for its partners.
   

  

 For more information on Al\-Futtaim Malls, please visit https://www.al\-futtaimmalls.com/
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies**
 Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies offers customers complete engineering and systems integration solutions.
   

  

 The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
   

  

 The Technologies division provides complete business solutions to large, medium and small customers that include, contact centre solutions, business applications, business intelligence, data management, advanced analytics amongst others. The IT infrastructure portfolio comprises IP telephony, ELV systems, networking solutions, professional audio\-visual solutions and managed services.
   

  

 These solutions are further complemented by services that include project management, installation, testing, commissioning and after\-sales maintenance contracts.

**Job Description**
**About Nintex:**
 At Nintex, we are transforming the way people work, everywhere.
   

  

 As the global standard for process intelligence and automation, were trusted by over 10,000 public and private sector organizations across 90 countries. Our customers, from industry giants like Amazon, Coca\-Cola, and Microsoft, rely on the Nintex Platform to accelerate their digital transformation journeys by managing, automating, and optimizing business processes quickly and efficiently. We improve their lives through the technology we build.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering a workplace that supports amazing people in doing their very best work every day. Collaboration is constant, our workplace is fun, the environment is fast\-paced, and we value our people’s curiosity, ideas, and enthusiasm. Driven by passion and accountability, we take initiative, measure progress, and deliver results. Our culture fosters innovation and problem\-solving, fueled by curiosity and a commitment to thinking big. Together, we move with agility, prioritize customer needs, and build unity through empathy, leaving a positive impact wherever we go.
   

  

**Working In Sales**
 For the Nintex sales organization, the success of our customers and partners is at the center of everything we do. Our dynamic and vibrant team is highly motivated and ambitious, always driven to crush our numbers while having fun. Here, you’ll be a part of a supportive and energetic environment that values your expertise and dedication. We’re seeking experienced sales professionals that are not only driven to succeed but align with our values and culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Account Director you will be responsible for driving revenue growth and market penetration of the Nintex portfolio across the most strategic and complex customer accounts. You will own Strategic Segment opportunities end\-to\-end and are responsible for coordinating resources and managing effective sales campaigns to land the most valuable, high\-value customers Nintex serves. Your primary goal will be to understand customers strategic objectives, align our software solutions with their needs, and ensure the delivery of exceptional service. This role requires a deep understanding of our software products, the ability to develop and maintain long\-term relationships with customer. You will serve as the primary point of contact, ensuring customer satisfaction. Your strategic insights and exceptional communication skills will be instrumental in driving business success.
   

  

**Your contribution will be:**
**Sales Prospecting and Lead Generation:**
* Identify new business opportunities and markets, thinking big to drive revenue growth, developing and executing comprehensive sales strategies that align with company objectives.
* Build and execute on territory plans to drive seamless execution of new logo pursuits.
* Convert leads into opportunities, and subsequently into customers, by utilizing the Nintex sales process and the sales support resources
* Prospect into Strategic companies and close opportunities by effectively and efficiently utilizing all the Nintex resources at their disposal, while also negotiating favorable pricing and terms.
* Work closely with Solutions Engineer during the sales process to provide technical insight and tailored solutions for strategic customers.
* Gain a deep understanding of customers’ internal business operations and the priorities/personas that drive purchasing decisions to connect Nintex’s solutions to organizational needs.
* Identify and leverage compelling new business entryways to facilitate targeted outreach (events, marketing, conferences, groups).


**Account Planning, Management, and Strategy:**
* Develop and leverage relationships within departments at Strategic Accounts to source high\-quality opportunities and build diverse relationships within existing customers.
* Develop and implement account plans that outline objectives, strategies, and action steps to maximize customer satisfaction and revenue growth.
* Detailed account planning and strategy work for every account supported by quarterly business reviews (QBRs)
* Cultivate and nurture relationships with existing customers who can benefit from future solutions on the Nintex product roadmap and identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities.
* Understand customers business goals and challenges and align our software solutions to address them effectively.
* Uncover buyer goals and pain points that can be addressed through Nintex offerings and identify a robust set of business drivers that will help build long\-term relationships with the customer.
* Negotiate and manage contract renewals and extensions.


**Sales Presentations and Demonstrations:**
* Utilize strong product knowledge and technical acumen to conduct effective, high\-level demos before bringing in Solution Engineers, connecting prospects’ business objectives to specific Nintex solutions.
* Draw on value messaging to conduct product demonstrations and presentations to showcase our software, emphasizing their value and benefits.


**Reporting and Forecasting:**
* Maintain accurate account records, activities, pipeline funnel and sales forecasts in Salesforce
* Provide regular reports on account health, performance, and opportunities to senior management.


**Customer Success:**
* Ensure successful implementation and adoption of our solutions.
* Optimize usage of Nintex products and deployment.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and address any issues promptly to maintain high retention rates.
* Act as the voice of the customer, conveying their needs, feedback, and priorities to internal teams, ensuring their needs and concerns are addressed promptly to enhance products and services.


**Market and Industry Knowledge:**
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies, providing strategic insights and recommendations to enable customers to stay ahead in their respective markets.


**To be successful, we think you need:**
* Bachelors degree in Sales, Marketing or Business or a related field is preferred.
* Proven experience in strategic account management in the SaaS industry (3\-5 years).
* In\-depth knowledge of SaaS solutions and their applications.
* Strong understanding of the industry/market and its challenges.
* Excellent with customer relationships and engagement.
* Proficient in value messaging and objection handling.
* Results\-oriented with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Problem\-solving abilities and a customer\-centric mindset.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
* Excellent interpersonal skills; a high level of trust and integrity, great influencer, respected by partners and customers.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Familiarity with CRM software and account management tools.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Nintex has a hybrid working model, enabling us to build culture, learn, and grow together. We intentionally connect and collaborate, while emphasizing flexibility with a blend of at\-home and in\-office work. This role is a hybrid role in our local Nintex office.
   

  

 While our offerings differ from country to country, we offer our entire global workforce an array of exciting perks and benefits, including
   

  

* Global Gratitude and Recharge Days
* Flexible, paid time off policy
* Employee wellness programs and counseling resources
* Meaningful peer recognition and awards
* Paid parental leave
* Invention/patenting assistance
* Community impact, paid volunteer time, and opportunities
* Intercultural learning and celebration
* Multiple tools through which to learn and grow, and an incredible global community


 View more about our benefits here: https://www.nintex.com/wp\-content/uploads/2023/01/Global\-Perks\-and\-Benefits.pdf.

Job Title:Lead Network Architect

**Role Summary:** 




 We are seeking a senior Network Architecture Leader to define, own, and continuously improve the end\-to\-end target network architecture that enables business growth and a high\-quality user and customer experience.This is a strategy, design and design\-authority position (not hands\-on delivery).

* Cisco Meraki Wi\-Fi

* Cisco SD\-WAN
* Cisco ISE (NAC/RADIUS integration patterns and scale considerations)
* Fortinet /Cisco firewalls

* Practical understanding of automation and how to govern it (Terraform exposure required).



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience running architecture review boards / design authorities (beyond presenting into forums).
* Cloud networking depth (Azure/AWS/GCP connectivity patterns, private connectivity, hub\-and\-spoke).
* Strong observability mindset (telemetry/logging standards, SLOs for network services).
* Certifications (CCNP/CCIE, vendor SD\-WAN/SASE/Fortinet), optional.

data.jd_text:
Fuse Energy is a forward\-thinking renewable energy startup on a mission to deliver a terawatt of renewable energy \- fast. We're combining first\-principles thinking with cutting\-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We raised $170M from top\-tier investors including Multicoin, Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, Box Group and strategic angels like Nico Rosberg, the Co\-Founder of Solana and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify, Uber and more.
   

  

 We're creating a fully integrated energy company: from developing solar, wind and hydrogen projects to real\-time power trading and distributed energy installations. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass on savings to customers.
   

  

 But we're not stopping there. We're also building the Energy Network: a decentralised platform of smart devices that rewards users in Energy Dollars for electrifying their homes, shifting usage to off\-peak hours, and helping balance the grid. This network strengthens grid stability \- a critical foundation for scaling AI data centers and other energy\-intensive industries.
   

  

 As the Head of Engineering (Expansion) at Fuse Energy, you will lead the technical strategy and execution for launching our app into new international markets. Your mission is to extend the capabilities of our core systems—adapting them to new geographies, regulatory frameworks, and grid architectures—without compromising performance, reliability, or speed of innovation.
   

  

 This role is both strategic and hands\-on. You'll work closely with product, operations, legal, and regulatory teams to build scalable and flexible systems that support rapid expansion. You'll also lead a team of engineers dedicated to developing market\-specific features and integrations, ensuring Fuse Energy delivers a consistent and seamless experience to customers around the world.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead engineering efforts focused on international expansion and localization
* Build integrations with local grid operators, regulators, and third\-party providers
* Architect scalable systems that can flex to support diverse market conditions (e.g., tariffs, billing schemes, compliance)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to scope and deliver expansion goals
* Establish clear processes to balance core product velocity with expansion requirements
* Mentor and lead a team of engineers focused on growth and new markets


**Requirements**
* Proven engineering leadership experience
* 5\+ years experience as a software engineer, including 2\+ years in a technical leadership role
* Deep understanding of backend systems and distributed architecture
* Strong product instincts; ability to translate market requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and regulatory complexity
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


**Bonus**
* Experience launching technical products in international or regulated markets
* Familiarity with energy systems, market regulation, or utility integration
* Background in building flexible pricing, billing, or compliance architectures
* Experience with multi\-region infrastructure and deployment


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and an equity sign\-on bonus
* Biannual bonus scheme
* Fully expensed tech to match your needs
* Paid annual leave
* Breakfast and dinner allowance for office based employees

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview** 




 The Head of Cataloging will own the end\-to\-end product catalog strategy, operations, and quality for the marketplace across all brands, categories, and sellers. This role is responsible for building a best\-in\-class catalog infrastructure that ensures high\-quality product content, accurate product data, and scalable catalog operations to support marketplace growth. The role is critical in enabling product discoverability, conversion optimization, merchandising efficiency, and operational scalability across a large and growing assortment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain a scalable product taxonomy structure across fashion and lifestyle categories including Apparel, Footwear, Accessories, Baby products, Beauty, Home \& lifestyle
* Establish catalog governance frameworks including like product classification standards, attribute definitions, naming conventions, content standards
* Ensure catalog consistency and data integrity across brands, categories, and sellers.
* Continuously improve catalog frameworks to support better discovery, filtering, and search performance.
* Own the complete catalog lifecycle for all private brands from product creation to live listing. Create master product records for all private label SKUs, define product hierarchy, category mapping, and attribute structures, ensure correct style, color, size, and variant mapping.
* Partner with studio, creative, and styling teams to ensure Image quality, Brand consistency and Marketplace merchandising standards.
* Ensure products are fully cataloged and live ahead of launch events, campaigns, and seasonal drops.
* Lead catalog operations for all marketplace brands and sellers. Manage the catalog creation, enrichment, and validation pipeline. Ensure rapid onboarding of new brands and sellers and implement processes to manage high SKU volumes with high quality standards.
* Establish strong mechanisms to ensure catalog SLAs for New product creation, Product updates and Error correction
* Own the product data quality framework across the marketplace on Product attributes, Size charts, Fabric composition, Product specifications, Variant structures and Brand metadata
* Drive improvements in Attribute completeness and Data consistency to optimize Search relevance, Filtering, Recommendations and Customer decision making.
* Defining image quality standards by ensuring compliance with marketplace visual guidelines and own the complete process for Image uploads, Image validation and Background standards
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to build scalable catalog infrastructure and to reduce manual cataloging effort while increasing speed and quality. The improvements to be driven across Product Information Management (PIM) systems, Catalog Management Systems, Automated attribute tagging, AI\-driven catalog enrichment and Bulk product uploads and validation tools
* Work closely with multiple teams across the organization like Category teams on product launches and assortment planning, Seller onboarding teams on brand catalog onboarding and Operations \& Supply teams on SKU activation and inventory linkage
* Build and lead a high\-performing catalog operations team by defining clear workflows, SOPs, and productivity benchmarks.



 Qualifications
 


* 10\+ years experience in e\-commerce catalog management, product data management, or marketplace operations.
* Strong experience in fashion or lifestyle e\-commerce platforms.
* Proven experience managing large SKU catalogs across multiple brands and categories.
* Experience working with private label product cataloging processes.
* Familiarity with PIM systems, catalog automation, and product data platforms.



 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience in marketplace businesses with third\-party sellers.
* Experience in GCC or Middle East e\-commerce markets.
* Experience supporting private brand launches and seasonal fashion collections.
* Exposure to AI\-driven catalog automation tools.



 Key Skills
 


* Strong operational leadership
* Fashion product knowledge
* Data\-driven decision making
* Attention to detail
* Process design \& optimization
* Cross\-functional collaboration



 Ability to manage high SKU complexity

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 The Solana Foundation is a non\-profit based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the adoption, decentralization, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a high performance blockchain that can deliver a fast and friendly user experience, without sacrificing security. The Solana Foundation is working to realize a world where individuals own their data, use permissionless networks, and transfer information and value freely around the world. We are looking for talented people who are willing to jump right in and use their expertise to help the ecosystem build.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 The Solana Foundation is seeking a Head of Data to own our data strategy and lead the team that powers ecosystem intelligence across DeFi, developer activity, payments, stablecoins, RWA, and network economics.
   

  

 This role is for someone who is as comfortable setting a multi\-year data vision as they are reviewing pipelines or diving deep into the data themselves. You’ll manage a team of subject matter experts across multiple verticals, own the Foundation’s external data partnerships, and ensure that the right decisions are made with the right information.
   

  

 The bar is high: we’re not looking for better dashboards—we’re looking for someone who can make data a true competitive advantage for the Solana ecosystem.
   

  

 To be Successful in this Role
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Define and own the Foundation’s data strategy—what we measure, why it matters, and how it informs decisions across the organization
* Lead a team of analysts and analytics engineers, each owning a specific ecosystem vertical, and synthesize their work into a coherent cross\-vertical perspective
* Own relationships with the Foundation’s ecosystem data providers, ensuring coverage, quality, and methodological rigor
* Work closely with client teams (like Anza, Firedancer, Jito, Temporal, etc.) on data\-driven assessments of Solana protocol upgrades
* Drive the data infrastructure roadmap and make decisions on tooling, gaps, and new partnerships
* Represent the Foundation’s data perspective in executive conversations and external forums


 You will have:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in data, with at least 3 years leading a team or function
* Deep familiarity with on\-chain data—you understand what the metrics mean and where they break down
* Fluency across DeFi, developer ecosystem, stablecoins, payments, and network economics metrics
* Strong technical foundation in SQL and Python, with hands\-on experience managing a big data platform using modern data warehousing tools (Databricks, Snowflake, ClickHouse, etc.)
* Proven track record managing external data vendor relationships—not just consuming outputs
* Strong communicator who can translate complex, multi\-signal analysis for non\-technical stakeholders


 Bonus Points:
   

  

* Prior experience at a blockchain foundation, protocol, or DeFi analytics platform
* Familiarity with Solana’s account model, fee mechanics, and program ecosystem
* Existing relationships with analytics teams and data providers in the Solana ecosystem

**About Us:** 




 KPay Group (“KPay”) is a leading fintech company committed to empowering businesses of all sizes through simple, smart, seamless, and secure technology solutions. Serving over 72,000 merchants across Australia, Hong Kong, Japan, and Singapore, KPay helps unlock growth potential by providing a one\-stop platform for financial management, business operations, and digital transformation. In 2024, KPay raised a record\-breaking USD 55 million in its Series A funding round—the largest globally in the payments sector that year. The company has since been recognised as PayTech of the Year at the Asia FinTech Awards and named to Forbes Asia’s 100 to Watch list in 2025\.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As the first business leader on the ground in the UAE, you will architect and execute our go\-to\-market strategy, build and lead the early BD/sales team, and establish KPay as a trusted partner for UAE merchants. This is a true zero\-to\-one role: you will shape our market entry, define our sales playbook, cultivate key partnerships, and directly drive early revenue—laying the foundation for scalable growth. If you thrive in building from scratch, excel in high\-ambiguous environments, and are motivated by creating something impactful, this is your opportunity.
 



  





**Job Description:** 



* Build \& own the UAE GTM strategy – develop and execute the market entry plan, including target segments, pricing approach, partnership roadmap, and sales model tailored to the UAE ecosystem.
* Lead from the front – personally drive early enterprise and key merchant deals while building, mentoring, and scaling a high\-performing BD team.
* Design \& implement sales operations – establish CRM processes, pipeline governance, performance metrics, and incentive frameworks to ensure transparency, velocity, and predictability.
* Forge strategic partnerships – identify, negotiate, and manage alliances with banks, fintechs, ISVs, and channel partners to accelerate market penetration.
* Own the revenue number – achieve and exceed quarterly targets for merchant acquisition, transaction volume, and revenue growth.



  





**Job Requirements:** 



* 12\+ years in business development, sales, or GTM roles, with a proven track record of building and scaling revenue in early\-stage or high\-growth B2B SME environments (fintech, payments, SaaS preferred).
* Deep understanding of the UAE business landscape – existing network, cultural fluency, and knowledge of local regulations, competitive dynamics, and customer behavior.
* A builder’s mindset – experience designing sales processes, team structures, and partnership frameworks from scratch, not just managing established pipelines.
* Strong leadership presence – ability to inspire, coach, and grow a team while remaining hands\-on in key deals and strategic conversations.
* Excellent communication and relationship skills – persuasive in both one\-on\-one and group settings, able to engage C\-level stakeholders and partners with credibility.
* Resilient and entrepreneurial – thrives in ambiguity, learns quickly, and operates with urgency, integrity, and a merchant\-first attitude.

data.jd_text:
The Division Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day to day operations of a fitness \& Wellness facility within MTM Group in Qatar. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless delivery of a premium member experience while maintaining the highest standards across all operational, commercial, and service functions.
 



  





 The Division Manager will oversee all aspects of the facility, including membership sales performance, retention strategies, staff management, and operational efficiency. They are accountable for driving revenue growth, optimizing member engagement, and ensuring the facility consistently meets both commercial targets and brand standards.
 



  





 A key component of the role involves leading and developing a multidisciplinary team, including sales, front of house, and fitness staff, ensuring high levels of accountability, productivity, and service excellence. The Division Manager must foster a strong performance culture, implement structured processes, and continuously elevate team capability through coaching and oversight.
 



  





 From an operational perspective, the role requires strict adherence to health and safety standards, facility maintenance, scheduling, and service delivery protocols, ensuring a smooth and professional environment at all times. The Division Manager will also collaborate closely with senior leadership to execute strategic initiatives, marketing campaigns, and business development opportunities aligned with MTM Group’s growth objectives.
 



  





 Ultimately, this position demands a results driven, commercially aware, and people focused leader who can balance operational control with customer experience, delivering a facility that is both high performing and aligned with MTM Group’s premium brand and service values.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities\-
 



  





 Operational Management
 


* Oversee all day\-to\-day operations of the fitness facility, ensuring it runs efficiently, safely, and in accordance with MTM Group protocols.
* Ensure all equipment, amenities, and group fitness areas are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness and functionality.
* Enforce compliance with health and safety regulations, facility rules, and hygiene protocols.
* Implement and oversee standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all departments.



  





 Team Leadership \& Staff Management
 


* Lead, supervise, and develop a diverse team of personal trainers, receptionists, cleaners, and group fitness instructors.
* Schedule and manage shifts, leave, and staff rotations to ensure optimal coverage.
* Conduct regular team meetings, performance appraisals, and one\-on\-one coaching sessions.
* Foster a motivating and empowering work culture centered around teamwork, accountability, and customer service excellence.



  





 Member Engagement \& Retention
 


* Ensure a welcoming, professional, and comfortable environment for all members and visitors, with a strong focus on hospitality, inclusivity, and privacy.
* Handle member concerns and feedback with empathy, professionalism, and timely resolution.
* Implement member retention initiatives, including loyalty programs, engagement events, onboarding journeys, and follow\-up processes.
* Monitor member satisfaction metrics (NPS, reviews, surveys) and take corrective actions as needed.



  





 Sales \& Revenue Performance
 


* Collaborate with the sales team to drive membership sales, renewals, and upgrades.
* Track and analyze facility KPIs, including membership targets, attrition rates, group class attendance, and personal training revenue.
* Execute local marketing initiatives and work closely with the Commercial team on campaigns.
* Ensure all team members actively contribute to upselling and cross\-selling of services.



  





 Facility Presentation \& Brand Compliance
 


* Maintain consistently high standards of cleanliness, ambiance, and visual presentation in line with MTM Group brand guidelines.
* Ensure all digital screens, posters, and member touchpoints are current and aligned with ongoing promotions or campaigns.
* Enforce uniform compliance, grooming standards, and service etiquette across all departments.

* Strong analytical mindset with experience in attribution tools, BI dashboards, and performance optimization.
