data.jd_text:
The Intelligence Presales Solution Architect serves as the primary technical authority for ZainTECH's Intelligent pillar, with a deep specialization in the Microsoft AI and Data platform. This role is responsible for designing solution architectures, leading technical discovery, building proofs of concept, developing technical proposals, and supporting deal progression from qualification through close \- working in close partnership with overlay sales specialists, account managers, and delivery teams.
 



 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on expertise across Microsoft's AI and Data stack (Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure OpenAI Service, Copilot Studio, Power Platform) with the consultative ability to translate business requirements into credible, deployable solution designs. They will be the technical voice in customer\-facing engagements, responsible for building confidence that ZainTECH can deliver on the Intelligent pillar promise \- from AI Readiness and Data Governance through Advanced Analytics, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
 



 As a secondary competency, the candidate should be able to position and support technical conversations around two Microsoft\-native areas within ZainTECH's Digital pillar: Process Automation on Power Platform (covering finance, HR, customer service, and compliance automation) and Customer \& Partner Experience on SharePoint and Microsoft 365 (covering employee productivity, partner portals, and mobile\-first experiences). These are natural extension points where the Microsoft AI and Data stack intersects with Digital pillar workloads.
 



 Responsibilities:
 




 Technical Solution Design \& Architecture (Intelligent Pillar \- Microsoft Focus)
 



* Lead technical solution design for AI and Analytics engagements across the full Intelligent pillar value chain: AI Readiness (Data Quality \& Governance, Responsible AI, Organizational Readiness), Advanced Analytics \& Machine Learning, Generative AI (RAG, Co\-Pilots, Content Generation \& Personalization), and Agentic AI (Autonomous Reasoning, Multi\-Agent Orchestration, Agentic Governance).
* Architect end\-to\-end solutions on the Microsoft platform including Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Warehouse, Real\-Time Intelligence, Power BI), Copilot Studio, and the Power Platform.
* Design data platform architectures leveraging Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and Purview to support analytics\-ready, governed data foundations.
* Develop generative AI solution architectures incorporating Azure OpenAI Service, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning strategies, and embedding\-based retrieval using Azure AI Search and vector stores.
* Design agentic AI architectures using Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and multi\-agent orchestration patterns with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop governance and safety controls.
* Produce technical solution documentation including architecture diagrams, solution design documents, bills of material, sizing estimates, and implementation roadmaps for customer proposals and RFP responses.
* Define non\-functional requirements (scalability, security, performance, compliance) and incorporate them into solution architectures aligned with Microsoft Well\-Architected Framework principles.




 Customer\-Facing Technical Engagement
 



* Lead technical discovery workshops with customer IT, data, and business teams to assess current\-state architecture, data maturity, technology landscape, and AI readiness.
* Conduct solution presentations, architecture walkthroughs, and whiteboarding sessions with CTOs, CIOs, Chief Data Officers, Heads of AI, and enterprise architects to validate proposed designs and build technical confidence.
* Design, build, and deliver proofs of concept (PoCs) and proofs of value (PoVs) that demonstrate tangible outcomes \- such as a working RAG pipeline, a predictive analytics model on customer data, or an automated workflow using Copilot Studio \- to de\-risk the buying decision, when necessary.
* Support the AI Sales Overlay Specialist and account teams by providing technical depth during stakeholder conversations, helping quantify the technical effort and translating customer pain into architecture requirements.
* Deliver executive technical briefings and AI Readiness assessments that provide customers with actionable findings on their data governance posture, platform landscape, and AI adoption roadmap.




 Presales Process \& Deal Support
 



* Own the technical win strategy for AI/Analytics opportunities, defining the proof points, demonstrations, and reference architectures needed to secure technical selection.
* Develop scope definition, resource plans, and pricing inputs for professional services proposals in coordination with delivery and PMO teams.
* Author technical sections of proposals and RFP/RFI responses, ensuring accuracy, feasibility, and differentiation of the proposed Microsoft\-based solution.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable solution assets including reference architectures, PoC accelerators, demo environments, and technical battle cards for the Intelligent pillar on Microsoft.
* Participate in deal reviews and architecture review boards to ensure solution quality, deliverability, and margin protection.




 Process Automation on Microsoft Power Platform
 



* Design and demonstrate process automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power Pages) and AI Builder, addressing use cases across Finance \& Accounting Automation (invoice processing, reconciliation, expense management, month\-end close acceleration), HR Optimization (digital onboarding workflows, HR virtual assistants, automated offboarding), and Intelligent Customer Service Operations (omnichannel routing, agent assist, AI\-driven case deflection).
* Architect end\-to\-end automation workflows that combine Power Automate cloud and desktop flows with Dataverse, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Services to deliver intelligent process automation (IPA) that goes beyond simple RPA \- incorporating document intelligence, natural language understanding, and decision automation.
* Support presales engagements for Automated Compliance \& Governance scenarios, designing solutions that leverage Power Platform, Microsoft Purview, and SharePoint to enforce policy workflows, audit trails, and regulatory controls.
* Identify and articulate the natural progression from process automation to AI \- for example, surfacing data quality issues during a finance automation engagement that create demand for an AI Readiness or Data Governance workload, or embedding predictive models into an automated supply chain workflow.




 Customer \& Partner Experience on SharePoint and Microsoft 365
 



* Design modern intranet, employee productivity, and knowledge management solutions on SharePoint Online and Microsoft Viva, addressing pain points around information fragmentation, context switching, disconnected hybrid culture, and uncontrolled tool proliferation.
* Architect Partner Portal and channel collaboration solutions using SharePoint, Power Pages, and Dataverse, enabling structured deal registration, content distribution, partner enablement, and pipeline visibility for customers managing indirect sales channels.
* Design Mobile\-First Experience solutions leveraging Power Apps, SharePoint, and Teams to digitize field data capture, enable mobile approvals and notifications, and extend enterprise system access to frontline and deskless workers.
* Position the natural integration between experience platforms and AI capabilities \- such as embedding Copilot for Microsoft 365 into employee productivity solutions, integrating Azure AI Search into SharePoint\-based knowledge portals, or layering RAG\-powered chatbots on top of partner and customer content repositories.
* Collaborate with Digital pillar presales engineers on joint solution designs where Microsoft 365 and Power Platform workloads create the foundation for downstream Intelligent pillar opportunities.




 Partner Ecosystem \& Continuous Development
 



* Serve as ZainTECH's primary technical liaison with Microsoft's AI and Data specialist sales teams, participating in joint technical briefings, partner technical workshops, and co\-sell engagements.
* Maintain deep currency with the Microsoft AI and Data platform roadmap, including new releases across Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, and Azure OpenAI Service, and translate these into updated solution patterns and customer recommendations.
* Pursue and maintain relevant Microsoft technical certifications and contribute to ZainTECH's Microsoft AI specialization and competency attainment.
* Mentor junior presales engineers and delivery consultants on Microsoft AI solution design patterns, architecture best practices, and customer engagement techniques.
* Contribute technical content for thought leadership purposes including architecture blogs, solution briefs, and reference implementation write\-ups.


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of experience in presales, solution architecture, technical consulting, or hands\-on delivery of data and AI solutions, with at least 4 years focused specifically on Microsoft Azure AI and Data services.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline (mandatory).
* Deep hands\-on expertise across the Microsoft AI and Data platform, specifically:
+ Azure AI Services (Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Speech, Vision, Language)
+ Azure Machine Learning (Designer, Pipelines, MLflow integration, Managed Endpoints, Responsible AI dashboard)
+ Azure AI Foundry (prompt flow, model catalog, evaluation, deployment orchestration)
+ Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Data Engineering with Spark, Data Warehouse, Real\-Time Intelligence, Power BI)
+ Copilot Studio and Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) for agentic and workflow\-driven AI solutions
+ Data governance tooling: Microsoft Purview (data catalog, lineage, classification, sensitivity labeling)

* Proven experience designing and delivering Generative AI solutions including RAG architectures, embedding pipelines, prompt engineering patterns, fine\-tuning workflows, and grounding strategies using Azure AI Search or equivalent vector retrieval systems.
* Strong foundation in data engineering and analytics architecture: data lakehouse patterns, medallion architecture, ETL/ELT pipeline design, dimensional modeling, and real\-time streaming.
* Hands\-on proficiency in Python, SQL, PySpark, and at least one ML framework (scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) for building and demonstrating ML solutions.
* Experience producing presales deliverables including solution architecture documents, effort estimates, technical proposals, PoC plans, and RFP responses.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical conversations with senior technical stakeholders (CTOs, CDOs, Enterprise Architects) and translate complex architecture into clear, outcome\-focused narratives.
* Current Microsoft certifications, particularly: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI\-102\), Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP\-203\), Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP\-600\), or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\). Power Platform certifications (PL\-200, PL\-600\) are a strong plus. Multiple certifications strongly preferred.
* Experience with agentic AI frameworks and patterns including Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain, and multi\-agent orchestration with human\-in\-the\-loop governance.
* Familiarity with secondary cloud AI platforms (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Google Vertex AI) and cross\-cloud data integration scenarios.
* Experience with Dataiku DSS platform for visual ML, MLOps, and enterprise AI governance.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate cloud and desktop flows, Power Apps canvas and model\-driven apps, Power Pages, AI Builder, Dataverse) and SharePoint Online development (modern sites, SPFx, search configuration, Viva modules) for Digital pillar solution positioning.
* Experience with Responsible AI frameworks, model explainability tooling (e.g., Azure Responsible AI dashboard, Fairlearn, InterpretML), and regulatory compliance considerations for AI in MENA markets.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific AI and digital use cases in Telecom, Financial Services, Government, Healthcare, Retail, or Energy sectors.
* Experience working in systems integration, professional services, or consulting organizations serving MENA markets, with understanding of regional data sovereignty requirements.
* Fluency in English (spoken and written). Arabic language proficiency is a strong advantage.

Faculty in Industrial Engineering
   

  

 Artificial Intelligence, Digital Systems, and Industrial Analytics
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Department of Industrial Engineering invites applications for a faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Professor from outstanding candidates with expertise at the intersection of Industrial Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, software\-driven systems, optimization, and data analytics. We seek a highly qualified and forward\-looking academic who can contribute to teaching, research, graduate supervision, and industry collaboration, while helping shape a modern Industrial Engineering department aligned with Industry 4\.0, smart systems, digital transformation, and applied research excellence. The candidate is expected to have an exceptional track record in artificial intelligence and machine learning, including demonstrated expertise in large language models and robotics\-oriented applications. The successful candidate is expected to develop an exceptional teaching and research portfolio that strengthens the department’s undergraduate and postgraduate offerings, with a particular role in supporting and expanding the MSc programs through advanced teaching, thesis supervision, interdisciplinary research, and curriculum innovation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to:
   

  

* Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in Industrial Engineering and related areas.
* Develop and deliver advanced courses in areas such as:
+ Artificial Intelligence for Engineering Systems
+ Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics
+ Optimization and Decision Support Systems
+ Simulation Modeling and Digital Twins
+ Operations Research and Intelligent Systems
+ Industrial Software Applications and Data\-Driven Decision Making
+ Smart Manufacturing and Industry 4\.0

* Supervise MSc students and contribute actively to graduate research, thesis development, and program growth.
* Establish a strong, externally visible research agenda leading to high\-impact publications, funded projects, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
* Integrate AI and software tools into Industrial Engineering education, research, and real\-world applications.
* Contribute to curriculum development, accreditation, quality assurance, and continuous program improvement.
* Participate in departmental, college, and university service activities.
* Support the development of research labs, graduate pathways, and innovation initiatives that position the department as a regional and international leader.


**Required Qualifications**
 Candidates must have:
   

  

* A PhD in Industrial Engineering or a closely related field from a recognized and reputable institution.
* Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas:
+ Artificial Intelligence
+ Machine Learning
+ Optimization
+ Data Analytics
+ Industrial Software Systems
+ Smart Manufacturing
+ Simulation and Modeling
+ Operations Research

* Evidence of strong teaching capability at the university level.
* A record of scholarly achievement appropriate to rank, including publications in reputable peer\-reviewed journals.
* The ability to contribute to curriculum development and interdisciplinary academic initiatives.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and academic leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 Preference will be given to candidates with:
   

  

* An established research profile in AI\-enabled Engineering applications.
* Experience in developing or teaching courses that combine engineering, software, and analytics.
* Experience supervising graduate students, especially at the MSc or PhD level.
* A track record of securing competitive research funding.
* Industry or applied research experience in areas such as manufacturing systems, logistics, healthcare systems, supply chain analytics, digital transformation, or smart operations.
* Experience building collaborations with research centers, government entities, and industry partners.
* Professional proficiency in programming, computational tools, or industrial software platforms such as Python, R, MATLAB, CPLEX, Gurobi, AnyLogic, Arena, Power BI, SQL, or related systems.

Through its educational and student services programming, the University serves the intellectual, cultural, and personal growth of all members of its community. AIU offers degree programs in Engineering, Architecture, and Design, and Business Administration where the language of instruction is English.

data.jd_text:
Job description:
   

  


  
 



**Role Overview** 




 As the Head of AI Strategy \& Product, you will be the lead architect of the organization’s "Autonomous Reasoning Layer." This is a high\-impact, cross\-functional role that combines
 **Strategic Management Consulting** 
 ,
 **Financial Engineering** 
 , and
 **AI Systems Design** 
 .
 



 You will not just build bots; you will identify, prioritize, and secure funding for the high\-value use\-cases that redefine our competitive advantage. Your mission is to move the organization from a "Passive" data culture to an "Active" agentic ecosystem where
 **Generative AI (Orchestration)** 
 and
 **Classical AI (Machine Learning)** 
 collaborate to drive multi\-million dollar business outcomes.
 



  
 



 Location : Kuwait/Dubai
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Use\-Case Discovery \& Value Consulting (The Consultant)** 



* **Portfolio Strategy:** 
 Act as an internal consultant to Business Unit leaders, mapping "Logic Workflows" where human reasoning and massive data complexity collide.
* **Predictive\-Agentic Mapping:** 
 Identify opportunities where
 **Classical ML outputs** 
 (e.g., Lead Scoring, Demand Forecasts, Churn Propensity) can be utilized by
 **Multi\-Agent "War Rooms"** 
 to trigger immediate action.
* **Prioritization:** 
 Develop a proprietary framework (e.g., RICE or Impact vs. Feasibility) to evaluate technical readiness vs. business value, ensuring the team works on the most impactful "Agentic Alpha" projects.



**2\. Business Case \& Funding (The Value Engineer)** 



* **Capital Securitization:** 
 Partner with
 **Finance and the CFO** 
 to build robust ROI models for AI initiatives, moving beyond "efficiency" to "value creation" metrics like margin expansion and churn reduction.
* **TCO Management:** 
 Define the Total Cost of Ownership for agentic stacks, including LLM token consumption,
 **Snowflake** 
 compute (SPCS/Cortex), and specialized solver licensing.
* **Funding Pitches:** 
 Present priority initiatives to the Executive Steering Committee, translating complex technical architectures into compelling financial narratives to secure resource allocation.



**3\. Systems Architecture \& Product Leadership (The Architect)** 



* **Data Science Integration:** 
 Oversee the development of
 **Predictive Models** 
 and
 **Causal Inference engines** 
 (e.g., Propensity, LTV, Elasticity) that serve as high\-fidelity inputs for the agents.
* **Orchestration Strategy:** 
 Lead the design of multi\-agent topologies (e.g., Supervisor/Worker or Peer\-to\-Peer), defining the interaction between
 **Analyst, Strategist, Critic, and Auditor** 
 nodes.
* **Stack Integration:** 
 Oversee the synergy between the
 **Intelligence Layer** 
 (
 **ThoughtSpot Spotter** 
 ), the
 **Data Layer** 
 (
 **Snowflake** 
 ), and the
 **Action Layer** 
 (
 **Boomi** 
 or middleware).
* **Agent\-Model Interaction:** 
 Define how Agents "consume" ML model outputs, deciding when to use a Snowflake Cortex ML function versus a custom\-hosted XGBoost or PyTorch model.
* **Reflective Logic:** 
 Design "Reflection Loops" and "Debate Cycles" to ensure AI decisions are self\-correcting and high\-quality.



**4\. Governance \& Performance (The Enforcer)** 



* **Risk \& Guardrails:** 
 Define the "Auditor" constraints and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) triggers to ensure the system operates within legal, ethical, and brand boundaries.
* **Auditability:** 
 Own the "Reasoning Trace" in platforms like
 **LangSmith** 
 to explain to stakeholders why agents made specific decisions during complex multi\-step processes.
* **Feedback Loops:** 
 Implement mechanisms where the results of an Agent's action are fed back to retrain and improve the underlying Classical ML models.



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Experience \& Background** 



* **Professional Pedigree:** 
 8\+ years of experience in Management Consulting (MBB/Big 4\), Quantitative Finance, or Senior AI Product Management.
* **Technology Agnostic Orchestration:** 
 Deep conceptual understanding of multi\-agent frameworks. Experience with
 **LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel,** 
 or custom\-built state machines is highly valued.
* **Modern Data Stack Mastery:** 
 Proven experience working within the
 **Snowflake** 
 ecosystem (Cortex, Snowpark Container Services) and utilizing
 **ThoughtSpot Spotter** 
 for Natural Language to Insight (NL2I) agentic analysis.
* **Mathematical Literacy:** 
 Comfortable discussing
 **Mathematical Optimization** 
 (Linear/Integer Programming) and how to "instrument" these solvers as tools within an agentic graph.



**Core Competencies** 



* **The "Translator":** 
 Ability to explain a non\-linear "State Graph" to a non\-technical CEO while debating Python\-based constraint logic with a Data Engineer.
* **Financial Modeling:** 
 Expert\-level ability to build NPV/ROI models for transformational technology spend.
* **Systems Thinking:** 
 The ability to see business processes as a series of states, transitions, and feedback loops.



**The "Agentic War Room" Vision** 



1. **Analyst (ThoughtSpot Spotter \+ Predictive ML):** 
 Establishes the ground truth and predicts the statistical future.
2. **Scout:** 
 Gathers external market context and sentiment.
3. **Strategist:** 
 Formulates the plan using
 **Causal Inference** 
 and instruments the
 **Mathematical Optimizer** 
 .
4. **Critic:** 
 Uses
 **Scenario Simulation** 
 and
 **Monte Carlo Stress Testing** 
 to challenge the plan's resilience.
5. **Auditor:** 
 Ensures the final recommendation is safe, compliant, and profitable.
6. **Supervisor:** 
 Manages the orchestration flow within the
 **Snowflake** 
 environment.

We are recruiting a Senior Backend Architect (Real\-Time Systems) for one of our clients, a well\-known information technology company based in Muscat, Oman.
   

  





**About Our Client:**




 Our client is a leading information technology company based in Muscat, Oman, known for delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions across various industries. With a strong focus on quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, the company specializes in developing customized software, digital transformation solutions, and scalable platforms tailored to meet evolving business needs.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Design and own the end\-to\-end architecture for a real\-time, event\-driven backend serving
* Define data models and streaming topologies
* Create blueprints for stateful stream processing
* Architect for deterministic low latency (\<50ms p99\) by optimizing garbage collection, lock\-free data structures, and CPU caching behavior
* Design data partitioning and replication strategies for both hot and warm storage
* Set coding standards for non\-blocking I/O
* Lead architectural reviews to ensure real\-time SLAs are met under peak load
* Create runbooks for real\-time debugging (async stack traces, latency flame graphs)


 Requirements
   

  

* 8\+ years of backend development, with 3\+ years specifically in real\-time or low\-latency systems
* Strong hands\-on backend architecture and system design experience
* Proven experience building or leading high\-concurrency, low\-latency systems
* Strong understanding of concurrency, race conditions, atomic operations, consistency, idempotency, and fault tolerance
* Experience with real\-time or event\-driven systems
* Experience designing systems where response time under load is critical
* Strong backend development experience in Golang and Python
* Experience with caching, in\-memory data stores, relational databases, APIs, queues, and event\-driven architecture
* Experience with WebSocket or similar real\-time communication mechanisms
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, orchestration, and production\-grade backend deployment
* Ability to stay hands\-on technically while also leading engineers and making architectural decisions



  




**Strongly Preferred:**
* Experience measuring and optimizing latency under load
* Familiarity with p95/p99 latency, load testing, performance tuning, and scaling
* Experience with production monitoring, bottleneck analysis, and incident handling
* Experience in distributed systems where correctness and speed both matter



  




**Preferred Backgrounds:**
 Candidates with experience in the following types of platforms will be preferred:
   

* Betting/Sportsbook
* Gaming Backend
* Trading/Fintech Transaction Systems
* Live Scoring
* Messaging/Chat Systems
* Ride dispatch/Allocation Systems
* Other Real\-time, Transaction\-heavy platforms



  




**Note:**

 We are specifically looking for a candidate who has worked on systems where many users or events happen at the same time, and the backend must process them correctly, consistently, and quickly under load.
   

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

* Competitive Salary
* Employee Benefits as per the Oman Labour Law

 Manager, Asset Integrity

 OQEP\-Operated Assets

**Reporting to:** 
 Head of Technical Services
 



  





**Job purpose** 




 To lead and oversee Asset Integrity across OQEP operated assets, ensuring the safe, reliable, and compliant operation of facilities and pipelines. The role owns asset integrity standards and inspection governance, addressing complex technical issues across core engineering disciplines to sustain mechanical availability and operational continuity. Through the development and execution of robust inspection, corrosion, and materials, frameworks aligned with international industry standards, the position safeguards static equipment, piping, and pipelines integrity. The role ensures risk\-based decision\-making, regulatory compliance, and technical assurance to protect people, environment, and asset value—ultimately supporting operational excellence, asset longevity, and sustainable business performance for OQEP.
 



 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



**Main tasks and responsibilities** 




  




* Ensure systematic and timely inspections and recommendations to maximize static equipment \& piping mechanical availability
* Identify and implement specialized inspection programs to minimize intrusive inspections and maximize equipment mechanical availability
* Coordinate with technical services and project delivery departments to provide input based on observations from failures for continuous improvement and design specifications
* Monitoring of individual performance and KPI’s for timely update and feedback to team members and management.
* Developing staff development plan and coaching programs
* Leading and advance digital transformation initiatives for Asset Integrity and corrosion
* Ensure a safe working environment in compliance with all company and governmental rules and regulations



  





**Integrity (Wells Integrity, Static Integrity, Pipeline Integrity)** 



* Execute all necessary asset integrity management related activities to ensure timely integrity support for maintenance, external contractors, operation, planning and others as appropriate
* Ensure establishment and implementation (RBI) Risk Based Inspection programs and plans which ensure focused and optimized inspections in order to optimize inspection and maintenance costs through a focused process and system
* Oversee the Inspection, analysis \& recommendations maximizing interval between intrusive inspections equipment,
* Ensure the inspection contains the highest standards as per procedures, specifications, applicable and codes
* Oversee and ensure compliance to WIMS (Well Integrity Management System) guidelines/ system for the well life cycle for OQEP.
* To supervise well problems related to integrity, recommend cost\-effective investigative and/or corrective measures
* Reviewing the compliance to the WIMS standards in all fields and recommending areas of improvement to enhance compliance
* To supervise Well Integrity Testing (WIT) \& Subsurface Integrity Testing (SIT) maintenance \& testing plans as per OQEP requirements and follow up on actions.
* To develop \& implement well integrity KPI
* Budget estimation for all integrity aspects of wells, pipelines, and static.
* Support and supervise recommendation of major repairs to fixed equipment and piping.
* Ensure maintaining auditable record system of inspection and inspection results



  





**Corrosion \& Material Selection** 



* Ensure procedures and systems in place for systematic failure analysis to achieve reduced repeat failures and defect elimination
* Provide technical support and guidance regarding the cost\-effective selection of materials, corrosion mitigation, corrosion monitoring strategies to ensure the technical integrity of the materials applied in subsurface and surface hydrocarbon production, processing and transportation systems throughout their design life.
* Review corrosion monitoring programs to identify and recommend timely actions to improve mechanical availability.
* Overseeing corrosion monitoring and control programs and systems to ensure plant and equipment meet the required company standards, applicable codes of practice department strategies and company policy.
* Lead the technical interaction with different department on subject related to Materials and Corrosion. Expertise on various materials, like CS, SS, DSS and non\-metallics like RTP and GRP.
* Establish systems and procedures to ensure internal project QA/QC related to Materials, Corrosion, and Integrity to minimize failures due to poor quality.
* Monitor and improve the quality of Materials, Corrosion, and Integrity including the design of quality standards, inspection of materials, equipment, processes and develop quality Control system with corrective actions;



  





**Key interactions** 




**Internal:** 
 Upstream
 



**External:** 
 Contractors, Vendors \& Suppliers
 



**Notable Working Conditions.** 
 Field Operations and office environment, Moderate to intensive computer screen use.
 



**Education requirements** 




 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or related.
 



**Language requirements** 




 Excellent knowledge of written, read, and spoken English (required) \| Arabic \- Native (desirable).
 



  





**Background and Experience:** 



* 8\+ years of experience in relevant position
* Adaptable and motivated general management strategist who relishes challenges.
* working knowledge of MCE, D\&D, E\&I
* Must have industry certifications such as ASME, API, NDT or NACE/AMPP
* Knowledge in software applications like APM and CMMS etc.
* Knowledge of:
* Corrosion Monitoring Techniques \& Corrosion Inhibitors and Corrosion Control Measures
* Coating And Cathodic Protection
* NACE, ASME and other industry codes
* RBI, RCA and Defect Elimination.
* Risk Assessments, HAZOPS \& Safety
* Good knowledge in QA/QC, ISO 9001, ISO 1400 and HSE plans
* Knowledge \& experience in NDT \& specialized equipment inspection techniques.
* Certification Holder of National Association of Corrosion Engineers (NACE/AMPP) certification is an advantage
* Knowledge of inspection, corrosion engineering, welding, materials and QA / QC.



 .
 



**Competencies and Skills:** 




 Soft skills:
 


* Supervisory skills.
* Strong Communication skill verbal and written
* Personal and Team Accountability
* Acute Observation / Inspection skills
* Accurate Reporting skills
* Effective planning and organizing skills
* Proficient at interpreting Technical Drawings
* Problem Solving Skills
* Result orientation
* Planning and Organizing



  





 Technical skills:
 


* Computer knowledge in MS Office applications like MS Word, MS Excel, etc.
* Proficient at interpreting Technical Drawings
* SOP interpretation
* Knowledge of engineering best practices
* Good knowledge and expertise of SAP (PM \& MM \& FM Modules) Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)
* Good knowledge in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and HSE plans.

 Keen to take a market leadership position, GCG\-DDS has made the strategic decision to expand its horizons into two focused areas of operation with each carrying a new corporate identity under the umbrella of GCG’s holding company – The Ghobash Group.
   

  

 Now known as GCG ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS, the company focuses on Enterprise Information Management, Digital Transformation, and Interactive Smart Solutions, and guides our clients with the most comprehensive portfolio of business information management technology in the UAE

data.jd_text:
The
 **Senior Business Analyst** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between strategic business objectives and technical execution. This role is dedicated to analyzing complex business challenges, identifying high\-value opportunities for optimization, and providing actionable recommendations that align with the organization’s long\-term growth strategy. The Senior Business Analyst functions as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, a collaborator with cross\-functional teams, and a guide for translating business needs into technical solutions.
   

  

 This position requires the ability to evaluate and interpret large amounts of business data, processes, and workflows, then turn insights into concrete recommendations. The Senior Business Analyst ensures that organizational initiatives are supported with robust analysis, well\-defined requirements, and effective stakeholder engagement. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and technology, the Senior Business Analyst supports both the delivery of projects and the advancement of operational excellence across the enterprise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business Requirements Gathering and Documentation
* Lead the end\-to\-end collection, clarification, and documentation of business requirements for complex, high\-impact projects spanning multiple departments or regions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business units to ensure requirements are accurately defined, prioritized, and agreed upon.
* Translate strategic objectives into detailed functional and non\-functional requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Produce clear, structured documentation such as requirements specifications, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria that can be easily understood by technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Business Process Evaluation and Optimization
* Assess existing business processes, systems, and workflows to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate re\-engineering initiatives that streamline processes, eliminate redundancies, and drive measurable operational improvements.
* Develop process models, workflow diagrams, and performance dashboards to map current and future\-state processes.
* Collaborate with process owners and subject matter experts to ensure recommended improvements are realistic, cost\-effective, and aligned with best practices.
* Solution Design and Support
* Work closely with IT teams, solution architects, and vendors to validate proposed solutions against documented business requirements.
* Actively contribute to solution design workshops by offering insights from both a business and user perspective.
* Support development and testing phases by clarifying requirements, resolving ambiguities, and validating deliverables against agreed specifications.
* Ensure that proposed solutions are scalable, sustainable, and capable of meeting both current and future business demands.
* Stakeholder Engagement and Facilitation
* Act as the primary liaison between business users, technical teams, and external partners to ensure alignment on objectives, scope, and deliverables.
* Facilitate workshops, focus groups, and one\-on\-one sessions with stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and refine solutions.
* Build strong relationships with senior leadership and functional heads to ensure their strategic needs are reflected in project outcomes.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing clear communication, realistic timelines, and proactive updates on project progress.
* Data Analysis and Business Case Development
* Conduct in\-depth data analysis to identify trends, measure performance, and evaluate potential solutions.
* Utilize tools such as Excel, SQL, and business intelligence platforms to generate insights that inform decision\-making.
* Build robust business cases and feasibility studies that articulate the value, risks, costs, and benefits of proposed initiatives.
* Present findings and recommendations in a way that is accessible to both technical and non\-technical audiences, ensuring decision\-makers have the information they need to act with confidence.
* Reporting and Communication
* Prepare comprehensive reports, presentations, and dashboards for senior management, highlighting progress, risks, and opportunities.
* Ensure all project\-related communication is clear, concise, and tailored to the audience—whether executives, project managers, or technical staff.
* Develop standardized templates and reporting mechanisms that enhance transparency and consistency across projects.
* Serve as a thought partner to leadership by providing insights on market trends, industry benchmarks, and organizational performance.
* Mentorship and Team Development
* Provide mentorship, guidance, and coaching to junior business analysts and other team members.
* Share knowledge of best practices, tools, and methodologies to uplift the overall capability of the analysis function.
* Lead by example in stakeholder management, analytical rigor, and professional conduct.
* Support the professional development of team members by creating opportunities for learning and growth.
* Continuous Learning and Industry Awareness
* Stay informed on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to business analysis and digital transformation.
* Participate in professional communities, attend relevant seminars/webinars, and engage with thought leadership material.
* Proactively suggest innovative approaches and tools that can enhance Classera’s business analysis practices.
* Ensure that personal knowledge and skills remain current, enabling the delivery of high\-quality, future\-ready solutions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) is highly desirable, reflecting advanced business and analytical knowledge.
* Strong academic grounding in business process analysis, organizational behavior, information systems, or project management.
* Formal certifications (such as CBAP, PMI\-PBA, or Agile BA) are considered an advantage.


**Experience Requirements**
* Minimum of 5–7 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Demonstrated track record of leading large\-scale or complex business analysis projects across multiple functions or geographies.
* Proven success in eliciting, documenting, and managing requirements for technology\-enabled transformation initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience in business process modeling, optimization, and re\-engineering.
* Experience working in diverse industries such as EdTech, FinTech, or enterprise technology is preferred.
* Evidence of having delivered measurable improvements in efficiency, cost reduction, or user satisfaction as a direct result of business analysis work.

We Are Hiring: Senior Specialist \- Strategy \& Performance
 



 Location: Muscat – Head Office
 



 Reports to: Board Office
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Senior Specialist – Strategy \& Performance will support the Board Office in driving strategic oversight, performance monitoring, and governance across SalamAir. The role focuses on enabling the Board and executive leadership with structured insights, performance analytics, and tracking of strategic initiatives. The position plays a critical role in ensuring alignment between Board\-approved strategy, management execution, and performance outcomes through robust reporting, analysis, and governance support.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  





**Board \& Strategic Oversight** 



* Support the Board Office in tracking execution of Board\-approved strategies and key initiatives.
* Assist in preparation of Board and committee materials, including performance reports and strategic updates.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality of information presented to the Board.
* Monitor follow\-up on Board decisions and action items across the organization.



  





**Performance Management \& Reporting** 



* Develop and maintain Board\-level performance dashboards covering financial, operational, and strategic KPIs.
* Track performance against approved business plans, budgets, and strategic targets.
* Conduct variance analysis and highlight key risks, gaps, and performance drivers.
* Support preparation of monthly and quarterly Board performance packs.



  





**Governance \& Accountability** 



* Support implementation of governance frameworks linking strategy, KPIs, and management accountability.
* Ensure alignment between corporate scorecards, departmental KPIs, and Board expectations.
* Assist in establishing structured performance review mechanisms with clear accountability tracking.
* Support monitoring of cross\-entity performance within the airport ecosystem.



  





**Strategic \& Financial Analysis** 



* Support evaluation of strategic initiatives, investments, and business cases submitted for Board consideration.
* Analyze financial and operational data to provide insights to the Board Office and senior leadership.
* Contribute to development of performance metrics linking financial outcomes with operational drivers.



  





**Process Improvement \& Reporting Enhancement** 



* Identify opportunities to improve Board reporting quality, clarity, and efficiency.
* Support automation and standardization of reporting and performance tracking tools.
* Enhance data integrity and consistency across reporting sources.



  





**Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Coordinate with Finance, Commercial, Operations, and Corporate teams to gather data and insights.
* Engage with senior stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate reporting to the Board Office.
* Support alignment between management reporting and Board\-level requirements.



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field.
* ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) – Fully Qualified / Affiliate (Mandatory).



  









**Required Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and performance reporting tools.
* Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, Board\-level insights.
* Strong understanding of financial reporting, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
* Excellent written and presentation skills (Board\-quality materials).
* High attention to detail and accuracy.



  









**Preferred Skills** 



* 3–5 years of experience in strategy, financial analysis, consulting, or audit.
* Experience in Big Four firms or similar professional environments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to performance management, governance, or Board reporting is an advantage.

 The HR Manager is responsible for leading the human resources function within the steel manufacturing company, ensuring the development and implementation of HR strategies, policies, and programs that support the organization's objectives. This role requires strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, as well as in\-depth knowledge of HR best practices and labor laws. The HR Manager will play a key role in recruiting and retaining top talent, fostering a positive work environment, and driving employee engagement and performance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop, review, and implement company HR policies and procedures to ensure alignment with Omani labor laws and international best practices.
* Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements in all HR processes, including audits, reporting, and documentation.
* Oversee the collection, management, and protection of employees' personal data in line with data privacy regulations.
* Lead communication of HR policies, updates, and programs to all employees; act as a key point of contact for HR\-related matters.
* Supervise and ensure the accuracy of payroll processing for employees in Oman, in collaboration with Finance and external vendors.
